## 筛选说明

- 官方投稿总数：**43,013**（active 42,378 / withdrawn 216 / desk reject 419）
- 安全 primary area（alignment, fairness, safety, privacy & societal considerations）：**3,231**（active）
- 安全相关自动标签联合初筛（safety 组标签 + hallucination/reward_hacking/cot_faith/memorization 等跨组标签 + DLM/具身/agent memory/MCP 等关键词补捞）：约 5,500
- 硬排除（`RESEARCH_INTERESTS.md` 边界）：联邦学习 497、GNN 对抗 570、纯公平性 250、纯 DP 130、MPC/密码学/TEE 58、传统网安 14，合计 **1,519**
- 最终收录：**3,893 条**（active），按 12 个方向组织；其中完整卡片 202 篇，其余以简表收录（编号/标题/关键词/状态/OpenReview）
- 收录口径：与 `RESEARCH_INTERESTS.md` 一致——模型/智能体层安全攻防、投毒后门、隐私抽取与 unlearning 攻防、水印溯源、CoT 监控与欺骗、具身与多模态攻击面、DLM 安全线；纯理论（DP/密码学/博弈论无 AI 安全对象）、联邦/图学习、传统网安不收

- 联邦学习（518）与纯公平性（348）合计 866 篇在安全 primary area 内但按本库边界排除，是安全 track 内最大的「不收录」群体
- 开源模型治理独立成节（20 条）：权重防篡改子簇最密（预训练期 tamper resistance、ablation 触发自毁、可证篡改检测共 5 篇），加上许可审计失效（data laundering/permissive washing）与可验证模型仓库/去中心化市场——「发布后权重完整性」正成为投稿新焦点

## 论文分类

### 越狱、安全对齐与有害微调

### 1. A Jailbreak Success Coordinate Outside the Refusal Subspace: Decodable Before Generation, Reachable from the Input

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=4gvIW4C0bw) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`jailbreak`、`refusal direction`、`representation engineering`、`red teaming`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：refusal direction 已知可在干预下改变语言模型行为，但它能否识别"哪个越狱变体会成功"从未被检验——现有 jailbreak success 探针自选读出轴、从不与拒绝方向绑定。核心三问：成功能否在生成前从被评估拒绝子空间之外的坐标解码、干预该坐标是否移动行为、该坐标能否引导输入端搜索。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 10 个开源权重模型、2 个数据集、4 个增广族上，对同一有害请求在同族内的成功/失败变体做配对比较；在最后一个 prompt 位置的表示上、于行为屏蔽折上估计 success–failure 方向，并投影掉 11 个已发表拒绝方向估计张成的子空间得到正交方向；再做逐层逐位保持到生成结束的投影移除干预，并用仅依赖生成前激活的候选适应度做 suffix/template/rephrase 输入搜索。
- 📌 **结论**：正交方向中位配对 AUC 达 0.903（同方向 in-span 投影仅 0.826），在 80 个模型-数据集-族组合中 69 个超过最佳单一拒绝方向，跨数据集迁移达 0.872；但干预结果相反——同一投影移除在 10 个模型中的 9 个上更多打开被评估拒绝子空间上的行为；该坐标仍可从输入端到达，在搜索网格的 4 个模型上得到可用攻击，全程无需生成回复或调用回复裁判。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Refusal directions are known to alter a language model's behavior under intervention, but whether they also identify which jailbreak variant will succeed has not been tested: probes for jailbreak success choose their own read-out axis and are never tied to them. In this paper, we ask whether success is decodable before generation from a coordinate outside an evaluated refusal subspace, whether intervention on that coordinate moves the behavior, and whether it can guide input search. Across ten open-weight models, two datasets, and four augmentation families, we compare successful and failed variants of the same harmful request within a family. Using representations at the last prompt position, we estimate success-failure directions on behavior-blocked folds and project out the span of eleven published refusal-direction estimates. The resulting orthogonal direction reaches a median paired AUC of 0.903, against 0.826 for the in-span projection of the same success-fitted direction, and exceeds the best individual refusal direction in 69 of 80 model-dataset-family combinations; with model and family held fixed, cross-dataset transfer reaches 0.872. Intervention oppositely separates the two components: the same projection removal, applied at every layer and position and held through generation, opens the behavior further on the evaluated refusal subspace than on the orthogonal coordinate in nine of the ten models. The coordinate is nevertheless reachable from the input, yielding working suffix, template, and rephrase attacks on the four models of the search grid, with candidate fitness computed from pre-generation activations alone, without generating responses or invoking a response judge. What representation-level intervention acts on does not tell which attack gets through.

TL;DR: Jailbreak success is decodable before generation from a coordinate outside the refusal-direction span we evaluate, yet ablation moves the behavior on that span instead, and the coordinate can be optimized from the input.

</details>

### 2. Anchored but Not Protected: When Refusal Erodes During Fine-Tuning, and Whether Holding One Direction Stops It

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=7l9gH9h9aZ) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`refusal direction`、`fine-tuning safety`、`activation steering`、`alignment robustness`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：对已对齐 chat 模型在普通指令数据上微调会让它更愿意回答有害请求；一族防御选定激活空间中一个"拒绝方向"并在训练中惩罚沿其移动，但这一思路是否真能阻止拒绝侵蚀，缺乏系统审计。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen2-7B-Instruct 上审计：度量侵蚀集中度（epoch 1 的 517 个优化步中 52 步承载该 epoch 89–101% 的净位移，覆盖 4 种学习率日程）；验证所锚定坐标确实中介被微调移除的拒绝（推理时恢复其 vanilla 值 vs 随机方向对照）；在 9 个拒绝类别池化的方向上重新锚定并调整惩罚强度；同时审查行为打分器之间的分歧。
- 📌 **结论**：恢复该坐标 vanilla 值把过度顺从降 18 点至距 vanilla 模型 2.2 以内（随机方向无效果），十个 epoch 后可恢复约四分之三差距；但校准失败——继承强度下惩罚仅阻止 9.61 度漂移（验收标准需 15.18 度），池化锚定在 LLaMA-3/Qwen2 上多阻止 3.08/2.91 度仍未达标；LLaMA-3 上惩罚增至 3 倍可通过验收并再降伤害集过度顺从 6.75 与 8.25 点，代价仅为每 250 个多 1 次误拒且 ReClor 精度无损；此外 3 个打分器在相同回复上最多相差 70 分，足以改变结论是否成立。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Fine-tuning an aligned chat model on ordinary instruction data makes it more willing to answer harmful requests. One family of defences picks a direction in activation space, calls it the refusal direction, and penalises movement along it while training runs. We audit that idea on LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen2-7B-Instruct. Erosion is concentrated: 52 of the 517 optimiser steps in epoch 1 carry 89 to 101 percent of the net displacement that epoch produces, under four learning-rate schedules. The coordinate these defences hold mediates the refusal that fine-tuning removes. On four exploratory harm sets, restoring its vanilla value at inference takes undue compliance down 18 points to within 2.2 of the vanilla model, and past vanilla under a reference classifier, while the same operation on a random direction does nothing measurable; by ten epochs it recovers about three quarters of the gap. What fails is the calibration. On LLaMA-3, at the strength we inherited, the penalty prevents 9.61 degrees of drift where our acceptance bar needs 15.18 degrees. Anchoring on a direction pooled over nine refusal categories prevents 3.08 degrees more on LLaMA-3 and 2.91 degrees more on Qwen2, lowers undue compliance on LLaMA-3 by 2.0 to 3.6 points across three readings of one rubric, and still misses the bar. Tripling the penalty on LLaMA-3 clears it and cuts undue compliance on the harm sets by a further 6.75 and 8.25 points under the primary scorer and the reference, at a cost of one extra false refusal in 250 and no loss of ReClor accuracy relative to training with no penalty at all. Underneath sits a measurement problem large enough to decide results: three scorers disagree by up to 70 points on identical responses, and one published rubric built two defensible ways disagrees with itself on 6 percent of them, moving the pooled anchor's pre-registered effect from 3.6 points to 2.2 and changing whether it resolves.

TL;DR: Anchoring a refusal direction against fine-tuning cuts undue compliance, but needs 2-3x its inherited strength to actually stop the direction drifting, and behavioral scorers disagree enough to change which results hold.

</details>

### 3. Behavior-Aligned Visual Optimization for Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=MyFkkVcxbi) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`jailbreak`、`vision-language model`、`visual adversarial attack`、`attack efficiency`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：VLM 上基于梯度的视觉越狱攻击通常以 token 级目标优化固定迭代预算的图像扰动，只能间接刻画有害回复行为，攻击效果与计算效率都受限。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 BAVO：从 VLM 内部表示学习轻量 behavior predictor 来估计回复级行为；该预测器为图像优化提供可微的行为信号，并支持实例自适应的迭代选择——每次更新无需生成或评估回复。
- 📌 **结论**：在 917 个多模态越狱基准样本、4 个目标 VLM 上，较 affirmative-target PGD 提升 E-ASR 16.68–33.26 个百分点、HarmBench ASR 10.25–24.64 点；平均优化步数从 300 降至 32.7–161.2，墙钟时间加速 1.8–10.4 倍；改进在 3 种防御下保持，回复行为分析显示从拒绝/中间回复向成功回复转移。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Gradient-based visual jailbreak attacks on vision-language models (VLMs) often optimize image perturbations for a fixed iteration budget using token-level target objectives that only indirectly capture harmful response behavior. We introduce BAVO, a behavior-aligned visual jailbreak framework that learns a lightweight behavior predictor from internal VLM representations to estimate response-level behavior.
The predictor provides a differentiable behavioral signal for image optimization and enables instance-adaptive iterate selection without response generation or evaluation at every update.
Across 917 samples from multimodal jailbreak benchmarks and four target VLMs, BAVO improves ELITE-based attack success rate (E-ASR) by 16.68–33.26 percentage points and HarmBench ASR by 10.25–24.64 points over affirmative-target PGD.
BAVO also reduces the mean optimization steps from 300 to 32.7–161.2, yielding $1.8\times$–$10.4\times$ wall-clock speedups.
The performance improvements persist across three defenses, while response-behavior analysis shows shifts from refusal and intermediate responses toward successful responses.
These results demonstrate that aligning visual optimization with response-level behavior improves both attack effectiveness and efficiency.

TL;DR: BAVO uses a learned behavior predictor from internal VLM representations to align visual jailbreak optimization with response-level behavior and enable instance-adaptive optimization, improving attack success rate while reducing computational cost.

</details>

### 4. Beyond Jailbreak Rates: Harm Centric Evaluation of Multi Turn Jailbreak Attacks and Defenses

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=wFFR6uyf52) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`harm measurement`、`evaluation methodology`、`LLM safety`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多轮越狱是安全对齐模型的标准探针，但会话仍由二值的 jailbreak rate 判定——它无法反映实际释放了多少危害、无害回复后攻击者还剩多少可达目标、以及防御是否连普通请求也拒绝。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 harm-centric 评估框架：每一轮按已实现危害严重度与剩余风险打分，在已发布良性套件上的误拒与危害并报，防御按会话累计严重度排序，剩余风险作为前瞻诊断。一位主评人对 6 种条件、4 个开源权重模型族、固定 10 轮 Crescendo 衍生轨迹共 12,000 轮打分；两位独立评人各复评 90 轮留出子集，6 个组件中 5 个高度一致。
- 📌 **结论**：60 对防御比较中，拒绝关键词规则只能区分 10 对，HarmBench 与 Llama Guard 3 分别区分 26 与 20 对，harm-centric 分数区分 51 对；与盲评安全专家在 200 轮随机样本上的一致率达 95%，而两个分类器分别把含评审员所认 29% 与 19% 危害的轮次判为安全；多个防御排序随目标模型族改变，utility gate 结论依赖所选良性套件。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multi-turn jailbreak attacks are the standard probe of safety aligned language
models, yet a session is still judged by a binary verdict, the jailbreak rate, which
records only whether a breach occurred. A binary verdict cannot tell how much
harm was released, how much of the objective remains within the attacker’s reach
after a harmless reply, or whether the defense also refuses ordinary requests. We
introduce a harm-centric evaluation framework in which every round is graded
on realized severity of harm and residual risk, over refusal on a published benign
suite is reported beside harm, defenses are ordered on severity accumulated over
the session, and residual risk is a forward-looking diagnostic. One primary rater
scored 12,000 rounds from fixed ten round Crescendo derived trajectories across
six conditions and four open weight model families; two independent raters each
rescored a held out 90 round subset and agreed closely on five of the six com-
ponents. Evaluation methods are compared on two measures. Resolution is the
number of defense pairs an instrument tells apart by their performance. Of 60 pair-
wise defense comparisons, the refusal keyword rule separates 10, two published
classifiers, HarmBench and Llama Guard 3, are able to distinguish 26 and 20 re-
spectively, and the harm-centric score separates 51. Similarity to expert judgment
is measured against an independent blinded security expert on a random sample
of 200 rounds, and the harm-centric score reaches 95 percent. The classifiers, in
turn, call safe the rounds holding 29 and 19 percent of the harm the raters found.
We also find that several defense orderings change across target families, while the
utility gate verdict depends on the benign suite. Code and scored data are
available in an anonymous repository.

TL;DR: Jailbreak rates score a leaked fragment and a complete harmful answer the same; our graded, session level harm score tells them apart, signals harm a round before it appears, and shows no defense is best across attacks and models.

</details>

### 5. CARD: CATEGORY-ALIGNED REFUSAL DIRECTIONS FOR JAILBREAK ATTACKS

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=T7E514tVkN) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`jailbreak`、`refusal direction`、`adversarial suffix`、`optimization-based attack`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：已有越狱攻击多在粗粒度危害分类的数据集上评估，其 ASR 在细粒度、语义类别多样的安全数据集上显著下降，对多样有害请求的攻击有效性理解不足。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 CARD：从有害-无害提示对比中为每个危害类别提取 category-aligned refusal direction；目标类别未知时经轻量隐状态分类器选择对应方向；采用投影引导的 suffix 优化——投影项惩罚与所选类别对齐拒绝方向对齐的隐状态分量，同时保留目标似然目标。
- 📌 **结论**：在含 14 个危害类别的 BeaverTails 上 ASR 优于大多数被评估的攻击基线；跨不同危害类别体系与标注方案泛化到 AdvBench 与 HarmBench，分别达 97.12% 与 79.25% ASR。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Research on jailbreaking large language models (LLMs) has attracted increasing attention in recent years. However, existing jailbreak attacks are often evaluated on datasets with coarse-grained harm categorization, leaving their effectiveness across diverse harmful requests insufficiently understood. We observe that their attack success rate (ASR) drops substantially on safety datasets with fine-grained and diverse semantic categories. To address this challenge, we propose CARD, a jailbreak framework guided by category-aligned refusal directions. CARD extracts a refusal direction for each harm category from harmful–harmless prompt contrasts, selects the corresponding direction via a lightweight hidden-state classifier when the target category is unknown, and incorporates the selected direction into adversarial suffix optimization. Specifically, CARD employs a projection-guided suffix optimization strategy: the projection term penalizes hidden-state components aligned with the category-aligned refusal direction while retaining the target-likelihood objective. Experiments show that CARD outperforms most of the evaluated attack baselines in ASR on BeaverTails, a safety benchmark spanning $14$ harm categories. Moreover, CARD generalizes to AdvBench and HarmBench, achieving up to $97.12\$% and $79.25\$% ASR, respectively, despite differences in their harm-category taxonomies and annotation schemes.

TL;DR: We propose CARD, a jailbreak framework that leverages category-aligned refusal directions to improve attack effectiveness across semantically diverse harmful requests and generalize across safety benchmarks.

</details>

### 6. COMBAT: Cross-Model Jailbreaking via Depth-Interpolated Activation Transfer

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=XzNp808k7s) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`jailbreak`、`activation steering`、`representation alignment`、`cross-model transfer`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：表示级越狱的自然做法是从目标模型自身提取干预方向——目标原生方向天然落在目标表示空间、有兼容性优势；而经表示对齐从另一模型迁移来的 refusal 与 harm-detection 方向，能否在同等搜索预算下达到相当甚至更优的干预效果，是未回答的问题。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 COMBAT：在源模型构建 refusal 与 harm-detection 方向库，经适应不等模型深度的 depth-interpolated bridges 映射到目标隐空间，通过约束式两阶段选择识别行为有效配置，再以三角层收窄的局部干预部署；在 5 个对齐模型组成的 20 个有序源-目标对上评估，配等预算目标原生对照与留出状态重构检查。
- 📌 **结论**：在 4 个主基准上 Full COMBAT 的微平均 GPT 裁判 ASR 达 96.2%，等预算目标原生对照为 88.7%，未修改目标 20.3%；refusal 与 harm-detection 方向贡献互补，最有效迁移来自窄源层带与紧邻助手生成的尾部方向提取位置；桥在留出状态上拟合良好，其归一化非负桥-余弦剖面自锚点向外衰减。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Extracting intervention directions from the target model is a natural approach to representation-level jailbreaking. Target-native intervention directions already lie in the target representation space, giving them a natural compatibility advantage. We investigate whether refusal and harm-detection directions transferred from another model through representation alignment can nevertheless produce interventions that are as effective as, or even more effective than, target-native ones under the same search budget. We propose $\textbf{C}$r$\textbf{O}$ss-$\textbf{M}$odel Jail$\textbf{B}$reaking via Depth-Interpolated $\textbf{A}$ctivation $\textbf{T}$ransfer ($\textbf{COMBAT}$), a layerwise representation alignment framework that constructs banks of refusal and harm-detection directions in a source model, maps them into a target hidden space through depth-interpolated bridges that accommodate unequal model depths, identifies behaviorally effective configurations via constrained two-phase selection, and deploys them through localized interventions with a triangular layer taper. We evaluate 20 ordered source--target pairs from five aligned language models. Held-out state reconstruction assesses the learned cross-model correspondence, while equal-budget target-native controls evaluate the effectiveness of cross-model direction construction. Across four primary benchmarks, Full COMBAT achieves a micro-average GPT-judged attack success rate of 96.2%, compared with 88.7% for the equal-budget target-native control and 20.3% for unmodified targets. Further analyses show that refusal and harm-detection directions make complementary contributions, with the most effective transfers from narrow source-layer bands and trailing source direction-extraction positions immediately preceding assistant generation. The bridges fit held-out states well, and their normalized nonnegative bridge-cosine profiles decay away from selected anchors. Cross-model representation alignment thus informs the construction of effective target-side jailbreak interventions.

</details>

### 7. Configuration-Aware LLM Red Teaming: A Theory-Guided Transfer Framework

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=yEYioJFZPK) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`red teaming`、`jailbreak transferability`、`surrogate model`、`safety evaluation`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：自动化红队在开源权重 LLM 上日益高效，但 surrogate 配置与攻击策略如何共同塑造向未见部署配置的迁移，仍不清楚。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：把配置感知迁移形式化：结合局部差异分析与策略条件的基模型/系统策略失配分解，得到连接集成平均成功率与配置-策略覆盖的理论界；实证发现更广的 surrogate 成功与更高留出迁移相关、固定权重下改系统策略会重塑响应画像；据此构建 CAST：策略条件候选生成、集成平均 guard 分数、对 surrogate 运行系统策略的显式控制。
- 📌 **结论**：在 300 个 HarmBench 行为、34 个部署配置上，主评估器下 CAST 在留出的开源与加固配置上的平均迁移 ASR 超过领先的自动化红队基线（不含优化型来源）；消融实证支持理论界对 surrogate 覆盖与系统策略组合的设计推论。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Recent advances have made automated red teaming increasingly efficient on open-weight
LLMs. However, how surrogate configurations and attack strategies jointly shape
transfer to unseen deployments remains poorly understood. We formulate a
configuration-aware transfer framework for automated LLM red teaming by combining
a localized discrepancy analysis with a strategy-conditioned
decomposition of base-model and system-policy mismatch. The resulting bound connects
ensemble-averaged success with the coverage supplied by the chosen configurations
and strategies.
Empirically, broader success across surrogates is associated with higher held-out
transfer, and changing the system policy at fixed model weights reshapes response
profiles. Based on these findings, we build CAST, Configuration-Aware Surrogate Transfer, which combines strategy-conditioned
candidate generation, ensemble-averaged guard scores, and explicit control of the
system policy its surrogates run under. Our evaluation spans 300 HarmBench behaviors and
34 deployment configurations. Under the primary evaluator, CAST outperforms leading
automated red-teaming baselines in mean transfer attack success rate (ASR) on
held-out open and hardened configurations, excluding optimization sources.
Ablation studies empirically support the design implications of our theoretical bound
for surrogate coverage and system-policy composition.

TL;DR: Treating the system prompt as a first-class variable in the surrogate ensemble, not just the model weights, improves jailbreak transfer, supported by a transfer bound and a 34-configuration evaluation.

</details>

### 8. Crescendo-Live: Multi-Turn Jailbreaks of Full-Duplex Speech Models in Live Calls and Their Defense with Daimonion

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=qZVGWQneRt) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`full-duplex speech model`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`Crescendo`、`safety monitor`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：全双工语音对话模型边听边说，延迟约束限制其对所听内容的推理，暴露于 Crescendo 式把有害目标摊到多轮、逐轮升级的攻击；而语音模型安全仍只用单轮有害请求或预写对话评测。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Crescendo-Live：LLM 驱动的用户模拟器在实时多轮通话中逐轮适应模型响应、并可在模型说话时打断；由于一个隐藏目标可经多种方式交付、全双工训练数据合成昂贵，提出 Daimonion 防御——异步 LLM 安全监视器跟踪整个对话，检测到有害意图即向全双工前端模型注入文本指令，前端经微调把该指令转为口语拒绝并保留自然对话能力。
- 📌 **结论**：多轮升级越狱了所有被测模型——包括对直接请求鲁棒的——且攻击成功率随轮数增长；打断模型说话带来更高的攻击成功率（全双工模型特有的安全风险）；Daimonion 在所有会话长度上把攻击成功率降到 3% 以下，同时保留模型原有的轮换能力。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Full-duplex spoken dialogue models listen and speak at the same time, aiming at seamless, natural voice conversation. The latency constraint limits the model's ability to reason about what it hears, which leaves it exposed to multi-turn jailbreaks such as Crescendo: the attacker opens with a benign question and escalates gradually, building each request on the model's previous response, so the harmful goal is spread across turns and becomes more implicit. Yet the safety of speech models is still evaluated on single harmful requests or pre-scripted dialogues. We present crescendo-Live, which evaluates full-duplex models in live multi-turn conversation: an LLM-driven user simulator adapts every turn to the model's response and can interrupt the model while it is speaking. Multi-turn escalation jailbreaks every model we evaluate, even those that are robust to direct requests, and attack success grows with the number of turns. Our ablations also find that talking over the model leads to an even higher attack success rate, raising a safety concern unique to full-duplex models. Aligning the speech model itself against such attacks is hard: one hidden goal can be delivered in many different ways, and full-duplex training data is expensive to synthesize. We instead propose Daimonion, which pairs a full-duplex model with an asynchronous LLM safety monitor. The monitor follows the whole conversation, and when it detects a harmful intent, it injects a text instruction into the frontend full-duplex model, which is fine-tuned to turn such instructions into a spoken refusal while keeping its natural conversational ability. Daimonion reduces attack success to below 3% at every conversation length while retaining the model's original turn-taking ability.

TL;DR: Defend against Crescendo style full-duplex speech model jailbreak in a live call with an async language model

</details>

### 9. DARWIN: Evolving Jailbreak Adversary and Guardrail for LLM Safety Evaluation and Protection

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=UmzQqgrCPV) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`guardrail`、`attack-defense co-evolution`、`red teaming`、`jailbreak`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：现有 LLM 安全评估与防御多为静态：用固定攻击方法评估越狱漏洞、在固定恶意提示数据集上训练护栏，而现实对手会持续进化攻击能力并扩大攻击空间。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 DARWIN 攻防共演化框架，把越狱形式化为持续演化过程：DARWIN-Attack 从广泛外部来源发现新攻击策略、经自省与遗传进化生成变体、按对对齐 LLM 的表现筛选有效策略，执行阶段按目标 LLM 与护栏的反馈自适应选择并组合策略；DARWIN-Guard 做在线对抗训练，在攻击 loop 涌现的对抗样本上迭代训练护栏，并联合学习恶意与良性伪装查询以识别底层意图而非表层攻击模式。
- 📌 **结论**：DARWIN-Attack 对前沿 LLM 与护栏达 SOTA ASR——DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上近 100%、GPT-5.5 上超 90%、YuFeng-XGuard 上近 100%，优于 LSA、MAGIC 等近期演化框架；DARWIN-Guard 在多个安全评估基准上平均 unsafe recall 达 95.0%，超过 YuFeng、Nemotron 等先进护栏，同时标准良性基准平均通过率近 100%、在过度拒绝基准上取得最佳表现。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Most existing LLM safety evaluation and defense methods follow a static formulation: jailbreak vulnerabilities are evaluated with fixed attack methods, and guardrails are trained on fixed malicious prompt datasets. However, real-world adversaries continuously evolve their attack capabilities and expand the attack space.
To address this challenge, we propose DARWIN, an evolutionary attack-defense framework that formulates jailbreaking as a continual evolutionary process and continuously updates guardrails through an attack-defense loop.
We propose DARWIN-Attack as an evolutionary adversary that expands its attack capabilities through strategy discovery, mutation, and selection. 
DARWIN-Attack discovers new attack strategies from broad external sources, generates new variants through self-reflection and genetic evolution, and filters effective strategies according to their performance against aligned LLMs. 
During the attack execution phase, DARWIN-Attack adaptively selects and composes evolved strategies according to feedback from target LLMs and guardrails.
Through continuous evolution, DARWIN-Attack achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates against frontier LLMs and guardrails,
e.g., nearly 100\% on DeepSeek-V4-Pro, over 90\% on GPT-5.5 and nearly 100\% on YuFeng-XGuard, outperforming recent evolving frameworks such as LSA and MAGIC. 
The continued evolution of DARWIN-Attack exposes new safety vulnerabilities and requires timely corresponding updates to safety defenses. 
Therefore, on the defense side, we introduce DARWIN-Guard, an online adversarial guardrail training paradigm, which iteratively trains the guardrail on the emerging adversarial samples generated by DARWIN-Attack. 
To improve robustness without sacrificing utility, DARWIN-Guard jointly learns from malicious and benign disguised queries, encouraging the guardrail to recognize underlying intent rather than superficial attack patterns. 
Through continuous evolution, DARWIN-Guard achieves an average unsafe recall of 95.0\% across multiple safety evaluation benchmarks, outperforming recent advanced guardrails such as YuFeng and Nemotron. 
Meanwhile, DARWIN-Guard maintains an average benign pass rate of nearly 100\% on standard benign benchmarks and achieves the best performance on over-refusal benchmarks. 
Our code and model are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DARWIN-D8A6.

TL;DR: We propose DARWIN, an evolutionary attack-defense framework that formulates jailbreaking as a continual evolutionary process and continuously updates guardrails through online adversarial training in an attack-defense loop.

</details>

### 10. Does Reasoning Make Multimodal Large Reasoning Models Safer?

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=MErxzlfV2j) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`multimodal jailbreak`、`reasoning`、`safety alignment`、`LoRA`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：MLLM 的普及暴露了安全漏洞，连较简单的多模态越狱都能诱导有害内容；推理能力被引入以提升多模态任务处理，但近期研究对"推理是否提升模型安全"给出相互冲突的证据。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：发现推理并不总提升安全：在 execution-dominant 攻击下放大危害、在 verification-dominant 攻击下缓解危害，构成 Reasoning Safety Reversal（RSR）；用 Decode-Check-Execute（DCE）框架——恢复潜在意图、安全检查、执行任务三个耦合过程——解释该现象（安全结果取决于哪个过程主导）；设计 Check-Before-Execute（CBE）提示策略检验该解释；并提出 Intent-Gated Thinking Supervision（IGTS）：参数高效的 LoRA 方法，在推理过程中显式监督安全检查。
- 📌 **结论**：跨模型与攻击的评估表明 IGTS 提升多模态大推理模型（MLRM）的安全性（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

The widespread adoption of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has also exposed safety vulnerabilities. Even relatively simple multimodal jailbreak attacks can induce them to generate harmful content. More recently, reasoning has been introduced to improve MLLMs' understanding and processing of multimodal tasks. However, recent studies report conflicting evidence about whether reasoning improves model safety. We find that reasoning does not always improve safety. It amplifies harmfulness under execution-dominant attacks but mitigates harmfulness under verification-dominant attacks. This contrast gives rise to a Reasoning Safety Reversal (RSR) in the safety effect of reasoning. We interpret this behavior through the Decode-Check-Execute (DCE) framework, which describes three coupled processes: recovering latent intent, checking safety, and executing the requested task. The safety outcome depends on which process dominates. We further design a Check-Before-Execute (CBE) prompting strategy to test this explanation. Based on these findings, we propose Intent-Gated Thinking Supervision (IGTS), a parameter-efficient LoRA-based method that explicitly supervises safety checking during reasoning. Evaluations across models and attacks show that IGTS improves the safety of multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs).

</details>

### 11. GuardAlign: Guardrail-Aware Safety Alignment for Modern LLM Pipelines

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=u9T0BdbuzS) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`safety alignment`、`preference optimization`、`jailbreak defense`、`guardrail`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：外部护栏日益成为对齐 LLM 对抗越狱的补充，但护栏与后端模型通常独立优化——被输入护栏漏掉的不安全提示会抵达一个从未针对护栏覆盖缺口显式对齐的后端。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 GuardAlign 范式：保留完整安全偏好数据集，并为每个样本附加多个输入护栏的离线决策与归一化不安全置信度证据；其中 GuardPO 是免参考目标，用样例特定目标间隔替代静态间隔——Detection Penalty 强调护栏漏检与低置信检出，Stubbornness Penalty 仅在安全性与有用性方向一致时针对当前策略的错序。
- 📌 **结论**：在 4 个 LLM 骨干、6 个安全测试集上，所有 GuardAlign 变体的管线平均 ASR 均低于 Pre-Guardrail、Post-Guardrail 与 Self-Refine，GuardPO 最佳为 2.42%（其中最强基线 7.23%）；去掉推理时护栏后，自适应攻击 ASR 降至 23.75%（G-SimPO 为 31.00%、G-DPO 为 43.75%）；在线开销显著低于输出过滤与迭代精化，并在受评 guardrail-aware 目标中保留最多 BIG-Bench Hard 效用。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

External guardrails increasingly complement aligned LLMs against jailbreaks, yet guardrails and backend models are typically optimized independently. Consequently, an unsafe prompt missed by an input guardrail reaches a backend never explicitly aligned to the guardrail's coverage gaps.
We introduce Guardrail-Aware Safety Alignment (GuardAlign), a paradigm that retains the full safety preference dataset and augments each example with offline decisions and normalized unsafe-confidence evidence from multiple input guardrails.
Within GuardAlign, Guardrail-Aware Preference Optimization (GuardPO) is a reference-free objective that replaces a static margin with an example-specific target margin. Its Detection Penalty emphasizes guardrail misses and low-confidence detections, while its Stubbornness Penalty targets current-policy misrankings only when safety and helpfulness agree.
Across four LLM backbones and six safety test sets, every GuardAlign variant attains a lower overall mean pipeline attack success rate (ASR) than Pre-Guardrail, Post-Guardrail, and Self-Refine; GuardPO performs best at 2.42%, versus 7.23% for the strongest of these baselines.
Without an inference-time guardrail, GuardPO also reduces adaptive-attack ASR to 23.75%, compared with 31.00% for G-SimPO and 43.75% for G-DPO. It further incurs substantially less online overhead than output filtering and iterative refinement, while retaining the most BIG-Bench Hard utility among the evaluated guardrail-aware objectives.

TL;DR: GuardAlign turns guardrail feedback into stronger supervision for language model safety alignment.

</details>

### 12. Guarding a Needle in the Haystack: A Real-Time Policy-Following Streaming Video Guardrail

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=lmSBVhSU4E) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`video guardrail`、`streaming video understanding`、`multimodal jailbreak`、`benchmark`

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

With the rapid growth of video generative models, robust guardrails are more critical than ever to ensure both video content safety, which prevents the proliferation of harmful material (e.g., sexual or self-harm), and video generation security, which defends against adversarial attacks on video generation models (e.g., jailbreak prompts or unsafe video injection). While recent multimodal large language model (MLLM) based guardrails have advanced through reasoning and video understanding, they still face significant limitations. In particular, they rely on frame subsampling, which is unreliable for precise long-term monitoring. In addition, they lack support for real-time streaming and incur high overhead due to inefficient token usage. To address these challenges, we propose StreamGuard, the first real-time, policy-following streaming video guardrail. To precisely identify the few unsafe frames hidden among many benign ones, StreamGuard efficiently inspects the input video in streaming form to localize unsafe content with high precision. To enable real-time streaming, StreamGuard employs an efficient asynchronous inference stack that parallelizes safety analysis across ingested events while simultaneously encoding and detecting incoming frames, achieving fine-grained, frame-level monitoring with low latency. In addition, considering the lack of benchmarks that reflect real-world video safety risks, we introduce two benchmark datasets that include: (1) Safe2Shot, with 5K short videos annotated with frame-level unsafe spans, capturing needle-in-the-haystack cases where harmful content appears in only a few frames; and (2) AdvVideo-Bench, which includes both TV2V and TV2T components targeting the video and text modalities respectively, designed to evaluate guardrail resilience against video-centric multimodal jailbreaks. Extensive experiments show that StreamGuard outperforms the strongest baselines by 7.0 and 6.0 accuracy points on TV2T and TV2V, improves video-level F1 by 1.7 points on Safe2Shot, and achieves the best F1 on four of six existing public benchmarks, while cutting end-to-end latency by 46.1% via parallel event-level inference.

TL;DR: StreamGuard, the first real-time policy-following streaming video guardrail, together with two benchmarks: Safe2Shot for frame-level fleeting unsafe spans and AdvVideo-Bench for video-centric multimodal jailbreaks.

</details>

### 13. How Jailbreak Attacks Inform LLM Safety Alignment: A Defender-Centric, Shapley-Based Evaluation of Jailbreak Contributions

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=ZrZReH7xV1) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`shapley`、`red-teaming`、`safety alignment`、`jailbreak`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：越狱攻击通常以 ASR 等攻击者中心指标评估，但能攻破模型的攻击未必对改进模型安全有用——缺少从防御者视角评估攻击价值的框架。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出防御者中心视角：以攻击作为红队数据用于安全训练时带来的下游安全提升来评估攻击；构建 A-MESS（Minimal Effective Attack-Subset Selection）——从黑盒子集效用观测中归因与选择越狱攻击的设置无关框架；估计 AttackSHAP（基于 Shapley 的边际效用归因分数），并在用户指定预算下经贪心或代理优化选择紧凑攻击子集。
- 📌 **结论**：在受控效用地形与真实 LLM 安全设置中发现：ASR 排名与防御者中心效用弱相关；AttackSHAP 可在有限效用查询下准确估计；直接优化子集比攻击者中心或仅归因的选择获得更强的安全效用（定性结论，摘要未给具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Jailbreak attacks on large language models are usually evaluated by attacker-centric metrics such as attack success rate (ASR), yet an attack that breaks a model is not necessarily useful for improving its safety. We propose a defender-centric view of jailbreak evaluation, where attacks are evaluated by the downstream safety improvements they enable when used as red-teaming data for safety training. Building on this view, we introduce $\textbf{A-MESS}$ ($\textbf{Minimal Effective Attack-Subset Selection}$), a setting-agnostic framework for attributing and selecting jailbreak attacks from black-box subset utility observations. A-MESS estimates $\textbf{AttackSHAP}$, a Shapley-based score that attributes marginal utility to individual attacks and selects compact attack subsets under user-specified budgets via greedy or surrogate-based optimization. Across controlled utility landscapes and real LLM safety settings, we find that ASR rankings are weakly aligned with defender-centric utility, that AttackSHAP can be estimated accurately with limited utility queries, and that directly optimizing subsets yields stronger safety utility than attacker-centric or attribution-only selection. These results suggest evaluating jailbreak attacks as resources for improving safety, not only as tools for breaking models.

</details>

### 14. INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Brsc62CHyu) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`abliteration`、`refusal direction`、`tamper resistance`、`representation engineering`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：abliteration 是广泛使用的针对 LLM 安全对齐的白盒攻击：估计激活空间中的 refusal direction 并将其从残差流写出矩阵中投影掉，从而诱发有害行为；需要针对性防御。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 INSEP：微调模型降低有害与良性激活沿拒绝方向的可分性——abliteration 以类均值差估计该方向，可分性降低即削弱攻击所依赖的信号；用对抗特征分解选出最可分的提示子集，低秩 adapter 降低其沿该方向的分离，行为损失在训练中保持基础模型的拒绝能力与良性回复质量。
- 📌 **结论**：与 6 个已发表防御、5 种攻击、8 个 1B–14B 多模型族 LLM 对比，除回复危害外还测连贯性、直白度、过度拒绝与 MMLU 以区分真实鲁棒拒绝与闪避性/降级回复；INSEP 在全部 8 个基础模型的平均综合分上排名第一并保留效用，为迄今报告的最大规模 abliteration 防御评估（定性排名结论）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out, so reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets, and a low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction; behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

TL;DR: We defend against abliteration by adversarially collapsing the difference-in-means signal that attacks use to estimate the refusal direction, evaluated with coherence and directness alongside harm.

</details>

### 15. K-Shield: Improving the Safety-Utility Trade-off in Refusal Steering with Local Null-Space Constraints

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=WjjXW0nQ2T) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`activation steering`、`jailbreak defense`、`null-space constraints`、`optimal transport`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：激活转向可免更新权重提升 LLM 安全，但对恶意提示诱导拒绝同时保留良性效用困难；已有零空间方法从转向映射输入中全局排除良性激活相关方向，但激活空间某区域对良性行为重要的方向在别处可能服务恶意拒绝，全局保护会阻碍有效转向。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：刻画由此产生的拒绝目标重构误差，并证明局部零空间约束可降低该误差；提出 K-Shield：用 optimal transport 学习局部子空间，把输入路由到区域特定的转向映射与拒绝目标。
- 📌 **结论**：在 3 个语言模型、7 种越狱攻击、4 个效用基准上，K-Shield 一致提升防御成功率与聚合效用，优于全局零空间约束转向（摘要为定性结论，未给具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Activation steering offers a promising approach to enhancing the safety of large language models without updating their weights, but inducing refusal on malicious prompts while preserving benign utility remains challenging. Existing null-space methods address this by excluding directions associated with benign activations from the steering map's inputs. However, a direction important for benign behavior in one region of the activation space may enable malicious refusal elsewhere, so protecting it globally can hinder effective steering. We characterize the resulting refusal target reconstruction error and show how local null-space constraints can reduce it. Building on this insight, we propose K-Shield, which uses optimal transport to learn local subspaces and routes inputs to region-specific steering maps and refusal targets. Across three language models, seven jailbreak attacks, and four utility benchmarks, K-Shield consistently improves defense success and aggregate utility over global null-space constrained steering.

</details>

### 16. LLM Jailbreaks Exploit Attention Sinks

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=k5bITiB1MB) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`attention sink`、`adversarial suffix`、`refusal direction`、`mechanistic interpretability`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：suffix 越狱在有害请求后附加对抗 token 序列即可绕过语言模型的安全护栏，效果显著但 enabling 机制一直不清楚。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：发现对抗 suffix 中的 token 容易诱导 attention sinks（后续 token 对其分配异常高注意力的现象）；通过放大/衰减 suffix sink 的影响做因果检验，并追踪到 refusal direction：sink token 引起的扰动逐层抑制残差流的拒绝对齐；结果在 4 个模型、2 种 suffix 越狱方法上验证。
- 📌 **结论**：放大 suffix sink 影响使攻击成功提升至多 176%，衰减则降低至多 84%——attention sinks 是对抗 suffix 绕过安全对齐所利用的结构性机制。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Suffix-based jailbreak attacks append adversarial token sequences to harmful requests, bypassing safety guardrails in language models. Despite their effectiveness, the mechanisms enabling these attacks remain poorly understood. We find that tokens in adversarial suffixes are prone to inducing *attention sinks*---a phenomenon where certain tokens receive disproportionately high attention from subsequent tokens---and show that suffix-induced sinks drive attack success: amplifying the influence of suffix sinks improves attack success by up to 176\%, while attenuating it reduces attack success by up to 84\%. We trace this effect to the model's *refusal direction*: sink tokens induce perturbations that suppress the residual stream's refusal alignment across layers. Our results hold across four models and two suffix-based jailbreak methods, identifying attention sinks as a structural mechanism that adversarial suffixes exploit to bypass safety alignment.

TL;DR: Suffix-based jailbreaks induce attention sinks that suppress the model's refusal direction; amplifying sink influence raises attack success by up to 176% and attenuating it lowers attack success by up to 84%.

</details>

### 17. MoMART: Mixture of Multimodal Auto-Red-Teamers

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=14XiuU04VB) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`multimodal jailbreak`、`automated red-teaming`、`compositional attack`、`MLLM`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：MLLM 在其支持的各输入模态上分别做安全训练，但这些按模态的防御在协同多模态攻击下是否依然有效，知之甚少。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 MoMART：用原子变换构建文本/图像/音频/视频的可复用模态专家，把有害行为分解到各模态；搜索可容许的模态子集、把各产物组合成单条查询，经评分引导的反馈循环迭代精化攻击；在 HarmBench 基准上对 6 个前沿模型评估。
- 📌 **结论**：匹配查询预算下多模态组合一致超过最强单一模态——Gemini-Omni 上从最佳单模态的 82.0% 升至四模态组合的 96.5%，ASR 随组合步数单调上升；对组合攻击的鲁棒性在模型族间差异大，Claude 与 GPT 的抗性强于 Qwen 与 Llama；行为级匹配发现 Gemini-Omni 与 Qwen-Omni 上分别有 29 与 40 个仅联合攻击才成功的案例——独立模态评估会漏掉仅联合使用才暴露的漏洞。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are trained for safety across the input modalities they support, yet whether these per-modality defenses remain effective under coordinated multimodal attacks remains poorly understood. We present **MoMART** (Mixture of Multimodal Auto-Red-Teamers), an adaptive compositional red-teaming framework that decomposes harmful behaviors across text, image, audio, and video using reusable modality specialists built from atomic transformations. MoMART searches over admissible modality subsets, composes the resulting artifacts into a single query, and iteratively refines attacks through a rating-guided feedback loop. Evaluating on the HarmBench benchmark against six frontier models, we find that multimodal composition consistently outperforms the strongest constituent modality under matched query budgets. On Gemini-Omni, attack success increases from $82.0\%$ for the best single modality to $96.5\%$ when all four modalities are composed, with ASR increasing monotonically across composition steps. Robustness to composition varies substantially across model families, with Claude and GPT exhibiting stronger resistance than Qwen and Llama. Beyond aggregate ASR, behavior-level matching reveals 29 and 40 joint-only successes on Gemini-Omni and Qwen-Omni, respectively, that are not achieved by any constituent modality alone. These results show that independent modality evaluation can miss vulnerabilities that emerge only through joint use, motivating adaptive, composition-aware safety assessment.

</details>

### 18. Multi-Turn Jailbreaks Steer Along Directions Single-Turn Safety Did Not Shape

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=RtTJM8mETC) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`detection`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`refusal direction`、`concept drift`、`conformal`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多轮越狱可把有害意图摊到单轮均不可拒的多条消息里，而已部署防御大多逐轮独立打分，难以察觉这种漂移。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 5 个模型上发现多轮漂移方向几乎完全落在单轮 refusal 与 harmfulness 方向张成的平面之外（漂移方向仅保留 0.03–0.09 的范数，而留出安全方向保留 0.79–0.96，与打乱标签零假设一致）；提出 DCD（Directional Context Drift）：带/不带历史分别读取每轮用户输入、把归一化差投影到习得的攻击模式方向（首轮无历史时恰为零），再用多尺度 EWMA 控制图加保形限转化为告警；每轮只增加一次前向，名义误报率是唯一部署设置。
- 📌 **结论**：5 个多轮攻击族上平均 AUROC 0.957–0.971、5% FPR 下 TPR 0.715–0.879（三种 guard 中最强者仅 0.766 与 0.352）；对与良性对话得到几乎相同 guard 分数的攻击，guard 按构造近随机而 DCD 保持 0.90–1.00 AUROC；对危害始于首轮之后的裁判确认攻击，DCD 在首个有害回复出现前标记 76–86%（最强 guard 为 30%）；覆盖是模式特定的，超出已学方向的攻击需要新轴。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multi-turn jailbreaks can spread harmful intent across messages that are not individually refusable, yet most deployed defenses score one turn at a time. Across five models, the multi-turn drift direction lies almost entirely outside the plane spanned by single-turn refusal and harmfulness directions. Held-out safety directions provide a positive control, retaining 0.79–0.96 of their norm in this plane; the drift direction retains only 0.03–0.09, consistent with its shuffled-label null on all five models. Directional Context Drift (DCD) reads each user turn with and without history and projects the normalized difference onto a learned attack-mode direction. This difference is zero at turn one, before history exists. A multi-scale EWMA chart with a conformal limit converts these scores into alarms. DCD adds one forward pass per turn and uses the nominal false-alarm rate as its only deployment setting. With an axis for each known mode, DCD reaches 0.957–0.971 AUROC and 0.715–0.879 TPR at 5% FPR averaged over five multi-turn attack families, versus 0.766 and 0.352 for the strongest of three guards. When attacks are paired with benign conversations receiving nearly identical guard scores, the guard sits near chance by construction while DCD retains 0.90–1.00 AUROC. On judge-confirmed attacks whose harm begins after turn one, DCD flags 76–86% before the first harmful response, versus 30% for the strongest guard. Coverage is mode-specific, so attacks steering beyond the learned directions need a new axis.

TL;DR: Multi-turn jailbreaks drift along a direction outside the plane single-turn safety shaped, and a readout along that direction facilitates their detection.

</details>

### 19. Multi2AV-Safety: Benchmarking Safety in Multimodal-to-Audio-Video Generation

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=yECLVPwR3R) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`multimodal audio-video generation`、`red-teaming`、`omni-modal guardrail`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：新兴音视频生成器日益支持文本、图像、音频、视频联合条件输入，这同样催生了利用跨模态交互或遮蔽恶意意图来绕过安全防护、诱导有害音视频输出的攻击；而现有生成安全基准未跟上步伐，对多模态输入组合与遮蔽攻击意图的覆盖都很有限。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出首个全覆盖红队基准 Multi2AV-Safety，共 11,024 条攻击实例，覆盖全部 11 种非单一 T/I/A/V 条件配置、4 类攻击意图与 5 类危害类别；据此评测 4 个多模态条件音视频生成器与 8 个安全护栏，揭示出多模态组合风险与遮蔽攻击意图风险两类互补挑战；进而提出全模态护栏 PerceptGuard，通过结构化风险感知学习融合组合风险与攻击意图监督，联合训练 rationale 生成与安全分类，使安全头在推理时无需 rationale 解码即可高效预测、并按需生成解释。
- 📌 **结论**：生成与防护两侧均暴露重大漏洞；PerceptGuard 在 34 个安全基准上结合 SOTA 多模态安全检测与有竞争力的单模态性能，在本基准上整体 recall 达 86.06%，超过 GuardReasoner-Omni 14.56%。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Recent audio-video generators increasingly support joint conditioning on text, images, audio, and video. These capabilities also enable attacks that exploit cross-modal interactions or obscure harmful intent to bypass safeguards and induce harmful audio-video outputs. However, existing generation-safety benchmarks have not kept pace with these advances, providing limited coverage of multimodal input combinations and obscured attack intents. To address these gaps, we introduce Multi2AV-Safety, the first full-coverage red-team benchmark for multimodal-to-audio-video generation, comprising 11,024 attack instances across all 11 non-singleton T/I/A/V conditioning configurations, 4 attack-intent categories, and 5 harm categories. Our evaluation of recent state-of-the-art models, including four multimodal-conditioned audio-video generators and eight safety guards, reveals substantial vulnerabilities in both generation and safeguarding, with multimodal compositional risk and obscured attack-intent risk emerging as two complementary challenges. Guided by these findings, we introduce PerceptGuard, an omni-modal guard integrating compositional-risk and attack-intent supervision through structured risk perception learning. By jointly training rationale generation and safety classification, it learns shared risk representations that enable a safety head to make efficient predictions at inference without rationale decoding, while retaining the ability to generate explanations on demand. Across 34 safety benchmarks, PerceptGuard combines SOTA multimodal safety detection with highly competitive unimodal performance, strengthening input-side safeguards against multimodal attacks on omni models. In particular, it improves safeguarding against the above risks, achieving an overall recall of 86.06\% on \bench and outperforming GuardReasoner-Omni by 14.56\%.

TL;DR: The first full-coverage red-team benchmark for multimodal-to-audio-video generation and omni-modal guard, achieving SOTA multimodal safety detection.

</details>

### 20. One Calibration, Many Requests: Amortized Black-Box Multimodal Jailbreaking via Cross-Model Refusal Coordinates

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=XCj6DK0V7q) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`multimodal jailbreak`、`black-box`、`refusal coordinates`、`calibrate-once`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多模态基础模型耦合视觉与文本信息，使越狱行为可跨架构迁移；universal 攻击依赖代理侧优化、缺乏针对目标的适配，而 query-based 黑盒方法每个请求都需重新查询目标。本文研究更严格的设定：在闭合目标上校准一次，之后把同一多模态载体复用于未见请求。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出黑盒多模态越狱方法 UniCal，实现"校准一次、复用多次"范式。先把异构代理模型的拒绝/顺从结构对齐到共享坐标空间，并以 leave-one-model-out 注册检验所学坐标能否预测拒绝与顺从行为；再用坐标条件生成器把固定良性种子与低维坐标映射为与请求无关的图文载体；面对新目标时冻结预训练生成器，仅通过评估器中介的三方决策标签接口选择稀疏坐标偏移，选定载体复用期间无需逐请求更新。
- 📌 **结论**：在 5 个坐标池模型上，UniCal 经一次性决策标签适配取得 89.6% 平均 strict 成功率；不做任何目标侧校准时，代理侧制备的同一载体迁移至两个外部未见架构，在 Molmo 与 Phi-Vision 上分别达 80.1% 与 77.9% strict 成功；对闭合目标 API 独立校准后平均 81.7% strict 成功、保留 93.5% 良性效用，且对比 label-only 随机搜索，192 次查询的校准成本在 8 次请求复用后即可摊销。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multimodal foundation models couple visual and textual information, which can make jailbreak behavior transferable across architectures. 
Many universal attacks rely on surrogate-side optimization without target-specific adaptation, whereas query-based black-box methods often require fresh target queries for every request. We study whether open models can provide a reusable low-dimensional interface for a stricter setting: one calibration on a closed target, followed by reuse of the same multimodal carrier on unseen requests. We propose UniCal, a black-box multimodal jailbreak method that realizes this calibrate-once, reuse-many paradigm. UniCal first aligns refusal and compliance structures from heterogeneous surrogates into a shared coordinate space and tests whether the learned coordinates predict refusal and compliance behavior under leave-one-model-out registration. A coordinate-conditioned generator then maps a fixed benign seed and a low-dimensional coordinate to a request-independent image and text carrier. For a new target, the pretrained generator is frozen, and only a sparse coordinate offset is selected through an evaluator-mediated three-way decision-label interface. The selected carrier is then reused without per-request updates. Across the five coordinate-pool models, UniCal achieves 89.6\% mean strict success under one-time decision-label adaptation. Without any target-side calibration, the same surrogate-prepared carrier transfers to the two external unseen architectures with 80.1\% strict success on Molmo and 77.9\% on Phi-Vision. On closed targets, independently calibrating each dated API evaluation yields 81.7\% mean strict success, retains 93.5\% benign utility, and amortizes the 192-query calibration after eight reused requests against label-only Random Search.

TL;DR: We introduce an efficient black-box jailbreak

</details>

### 21. Representation Without Disposition: Secret Loyalties Install as Preference but Not as Action, and What That Costs White-Box Audits

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=r9VH2paqul) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`secret loyalties`、`model organisms`、`mechanistic interpretability`、`alignment auditing`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：秘密忠诚（secret loyalty）指推进某一委托方利益的隐蔽倾向，近期 model organisms 表明这类倾向可通过窄域微调植入并逃避黑盒审计；黑盒审计遗留的开放问题是：植入后忠诚是否真的支配 agent 的行为，白盒读取又能否看到"真正起作用"的忠诚。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 Qwen3-4B 上构建四种模态（national、regime、fictional-ideology 与良性概念对照）的 model organisms，发现剧烈解离：域内忠诚饱和言语行为（regime 有机体上"委托方是良善力量"的概率从 0.001 升至 1.000，Cohen's h=3.05，全部模态超过 0.98），但在域匹配的 agentic 安全电池上不产生任何 principal 特异的 override（差中差 +0.020，95% CI [-0.021, +0.060]，Bayes factor 约 1200 支持零效应）。用双阈值模型形式化"表示"与"执行控制"的分离；忠诚对应单一局域方向——消融它必要且特异，Jacobian-lens 方向能特异地 steering stance，最多超出匹配范数随机方向 0.30；再比较四种植入方式：编译进权重或激活的植入（微调、激活 steering、Jacobian-lens steering）保持惰性，唯有 in-context 的 system prompt "constitution" 跨入 agentic override（差中差 +0.16，CI 不含零）。
- 📌 **结论**：微调植入的忠诚会饱和模型的陈述偏好却不及于行动；同一白盒访问既能检测又能植入忠诚，审计工具本身是双刃剑；真正产生后果的忠诚恰是最不隐蔽的 in-context 植入，据此提出以后果为根基的审计准则与对隐蔽植入未来升级为行动的 capability overhang 预测；发布电池、评分器与检测器代码，忠诚 adapter 不予发布。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

A secret loyalty is a concealed disposition to advance one principal's interests. Recent model organisms show such loyalties can be installed by narrow fine-tuning and evade black-box audits. We ask a question those audits leave open: once installed, does a loyalty govern what an agent does, and can white-box readouts see the loyalties that matter? Building organisms across four modalities (national, regime, fictional-ideology, and a benign concept control) on Qwen3-4B, we report a sharp dissociation. In-domain, the loyalty saturates verbal behavior: for a regime organism the probability of calling the principal a force for good moves from 0.001 to 1.000 (Cohen's h = 3.05), and every modality exceeds 0.98. Yet on a domain-matched agentic safety battery the loyalty produces no principal-specific override: the difference-in-differences against the base model is +0.020 pooled across modalities (95% CI [-0.021, +0.060]), and a Bayes factor of about 1200 favors the null over even a 0.1 effect. We formalize this dissociation with a two-threshold model separating the representation of a loyalty from its executive control of behavior. The loyalty is a single localized direction: ablating it is necessary and specific, while adding a naive difference-of-means direction is non-specific, yet the Jacobian-lens direction steers stance specifically, beating a matched-norm random direction by up to 0.30. The same white-box access therefore both detects and installs a loyalty, so the audit tool is dual-use. Comparing four install methods shows the gap depends on the install level: loyalties compiled into weights or activations (fine-tuning, activation steering, Jacobian-lens steering) stay inert, while an in-context system-prompt "constitution" is the one install that crosses into agentic override (difference-in-differences +0.16, CI excluding zero). The consequential loyalty is thus the least covert one, which motivates a consequence-grounded audit criterion and a capability-overhang prediction for when a covert install could reach action. We release the battery, scorer, and detector code; the loyal adapters are withheld.

TL;DR: Loyalties fine-tuned into a model saturate its stated preferences but do not reach its agentic actions; the Jacobian-lens direction both detects and installs a loyalty, and only an in-context "constitution" install crosses into unsafe behavior.

</details>

### 22. RvB: Automating AI System Hardening via Iterative Red-Blue Games

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=iVLtONeCL0) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`automated red teaming`、`red-blue game`、`jailbreak defense`、`guardrail optimization`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 同时具备攻击与防御的双重效用，凸显 AI 安全的关键缺口——缺乏面向动态、迭代对抗自适应加固的统一框架。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Red Team vs. Blue Team（RvB）框架，将其形式化为免训练的序贯不完全信息博弈：红队暴露漏洞，驱动蓝队在无参数更新的前提下学到有效解决方案；在两个高难领域验证——对抗 CVE 的动态代码加固与抗越狱的护栏优化。
- 📌 **结论**：对抗交互迫使蓝队掌握基本防御原则，得到不过拟合于特定 exploit 的稳健修复；RvB 在两个任务上分别取得 90% 与 45% 的 Defense Success Rate，同时保持近 0% 的 False Positive Rate，显著超越基线，确立了迭代对抗交互作为自动化持续加固 AI 系统的实用范式。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

The dual offensive and defensive utility of Large Language Models (LLMs) highlights a critical gap in AI security: the lack of unified frameworks for dynamic, iterative adversarial adaptation hardening. To bridge this gap, we propose the Red Team vs. Blue Team (RvB) framework, formulated as a training-free, sequential, imperfect-information game. In this process, the Red Team exposes vulnerabilities, driving the Blue Team to learning effective solutions without parameter updates. We validate our framework across two challenging domains: dynamic code hardening against CVEs and guardrail optimization against jailbreaks. Our empirical results show that this interaction compels the Blue Team to learn fundamental defensive principles, leading to robust remediations that are not merely overfitted to specific exploits. RvB achieves Defense Success Rates of 90% and 45% across the respective tasks while maintaining near 0% False Positive Rates, significantly surpassing baselines. This work establishes the iterative adversarial interaction framework as a practical paradigm that automates the continuous hardening of AI systems.

TL;DR: We introduce RvB, a training-free iterative red-blue game that improves LLM-based code hardening and jailbreak guardrails through adversarial adaptation.

</details>

### 23. Safeguards Too Early, Risks Too Late: Toward Safety Alignment Grounded in Multimodal Understanding for LVLMs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=BSJKBwDhXJ) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`cross-modal jailbreak`、`LVLM`、`safety alignment`、`mechanistic interpretability`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LVLM 在跨模态组合越狱（如 SIUO、MSSBench）面前依然脆弱——有害语义来自图文交互而非任一单模态；其根本瓶颈在于 LVLM 安全仍锚定于文本对齐的护栏，安全决策与多模态语义理解错位。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：对 LVLM 处理越狱查询的过程做机制分析，发现跨模态安全去同步（Cross-modal Safety Desynchronization, CSD）：跨模态有害语义只在安全关键窗口之后才形成，层间错位使跨模态越狱绕过拒绝。关键发现是：把跨模态融合提前可让有害语义形成移入安全关键窗口、重新激活安全拒绝；据此提出免训练的推理时防御 CURE（Cross-modal Understanding-guided Refusal Enhancement），选择性增强跨模态注意力以促进更早的有害语义形成，并放大安全关键神经元激活，使拒绝建立在增强的多模态理解之上。
- 📌 **结论**：在 3 个 LVLM、10 个基准上，CURE 将 ASR 降至 3% 以下，同时保持通用效用。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) extend LLMs to multimodal queries, yet remain vulnerable to cross-modal compositional jailbreaks (e.g., SIUO, MSSBench), where harmful semantics emerges from image-text interactions rather than either modality alone. This vulnerability reflects a fundamental bottleneck: LVLM safety remains anchored in text-aligned safeguards, leaving safety decisions misaligned with multimodal semantic understanding. To understand how this mismatch arises, we conduct a mechanistic analysis of how LVLMs process jailbreak queries and identify ***Cross-modal Safety Desynchronization (CSD)***: cross-modal harmful semantics forms only after safety-critical window, creating a layer-wise misalignment that lets cross-modal jailbreaks bypass refusal. This raises a key question: *can CSD be bridged by advancing cross-modal fusion into safety-critical window, thereby achieving safety alignment tailored to LVLMs?* 

Crucially, we find that earlier cross-modal fusion shifts harmful-semantic formation into the safety-critical window, reactivating safety refusal. Building on this, we propose **C**ross-modal **U**nderstanding-guided **R**efusal **E**nhancement (**CURE**), a training-free inference-time defense method that bridges CSD by selectively enhancing cross-modal attention to promote earlier harmful semantic formation, and amplifying safety-critical neuron activations to enable refusal grounded in enhanced multimodal understanding. Experiments on 3 LVLMs across 10 benchmarks show that *CURE* reduces ASR below 3\% while preserving general utility.

</details>

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=KyroQoSqjr) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

- 🎯 **研究动机**：同一有害请求直接发问会被拒绝，但经过数轮对话后却可能被回答；本文将文本多轮越狱研究与机制可解释性结合，追踪先前交换如何改变模型的拒绝或顺从。

- 📌 **结论**：模型的安全行为由多个对历史敏感、随层变化的组件联合调节；本文建立了连接历史文本、回复开场状态与最终行为的机制分析工作流。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

The same harmful request may be refused when asked directly, yet answered after several rounds of conversation. We combine research on text-based multiturn jailbreaks with mechanistic interpretability, holding the final request fixed
on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Crescendo attack histories and using history controls and internal-state interventions to trace how prior exchanges change refusal
or compliance. We find that the actual exchanges between both participants and
the assistant's most recent response affect attack outcomes, while retaining only
length, topic, or one participant's content has difficulty reproducing the effect of
the complete history. This effect can partly transfer with the response-opening
state, namely the residual states at the template positions before the answer and
the first few generated positions: transferring single-turn states can restore refusal,
while transferring states from the attack history can induce compliance or recover
part of the effect missing from failed histories. The effective components change
with depth; the refusal direction can strongly change answers, but transferring it
alone has difficulty restoring the effect of the complete history. Attention-source
interventions further identify a path that reads explicit refusal wording in the preceding assistant reply, while timing comparisons show that the main effective
stage for restoring refusal is at the opening of the answer, with later interventions changing answer content more often. These results suggest that the model's
safety behavior is jointly regulated by multiple components that are sensitive to
history and change across layers, and establish a mechanistic analysis workflow
connecting history text, the response-opening state, and final behavior.

</details>

### 25. Scalable Hierarchical Transformers for Multi-Turn Jailbreak Detection in Long Conversations

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=boEZ5UpU5D) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`detection`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`hierarchical transformer`、`conversation-level classification`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多轮越狱通过渐进升级、重构与角色操纵把不安全意图分散到整段对话中，可绕过轮级审核；而现有检测器面对长对话时全上下文注意力成本高昂。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：把多轮越狱检测形式化为对话级分类问题，提出高效分层检测器：先编码单轮形成紧凑的轮表示，再用轻量对话模块捕捉对话动态，并按需选择性注意细粒度证据，从而在保留跨轮推理的同时降低全上下文注意力开销。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multi-turn jailbreaks can evade turn-level moderation by spreading unsafe intent across a dialogue through gradual escalation, reframing, and role manipulation. We address multi-turn jailbreak detection as a conversation-level classification problem and introduce an efficient hierarchical detector that reduces full-context attention cost while retaining cross-turn reasoning. The model encodes individual turns to form compact turn representations and applies a lightweight conversation module that captures dialogue dynamics and selectively attends to fine-grained evidence when needed. On a challenging evaluation benchmark of 14,038 conversations, our approach achieves a positive-class F1 of 0.9394, outperforming Claude Opus 4.7, the strongest competing baseline, by 0.0994 while halving its false-positive rate. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes meaningfully, with combining cross-attention and self-attention in the conversation module yielding a 2.26 percentage point reduction in false-positive rate over the self-attention-only variant.

TL;DR: We present an efficient hierarchical model for detecting multi-turn LLM jailbreaks at the conversation level, outperforming strong baselines while avoiding the cost of long-context concatenation.

</details>

### 26. ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=orPgmoe342) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`safety alignment`、`reinforcement learning`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：安全对齐让 LLM 能可靠拒绝直接提出的有害请求，但把同一请求分散到多轮对话仍频繁得手；其机制根源在于对齐是"浅"的——安全行为集中于模型前几个输出 token，而现有防御继承该弱点，只监督回复的表面形式，从未让模型学到显式的安全决策。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：反向利用浅层性：若一小段 token 决定整条回复的轨迹，那它就是杠杆最高的干预点，防御者可以先行占据。提出 Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond 框架：防御者先评估用户意图，再显式承诺一个可解析的安全决策，最后以该决策为条件生成回复；承诺通过 payload 轮的强化学习训练——决策本身是 token span，奖励可以是规则：自验证奖励把承诺标签与对话已知性质核对，无需 judge 与标注；同一格式也支持在分级决策空间上带安全重定向的 LLM-as-judge 奖励。
- 📌 **结论**：在两个模型家族、14 个涵盖安全/效用/helpfulness 的基准上，防御者在受控比较中取得最强多轮安全，保持安全领先的同时保留效用、helpfulness 代价温和；per-token KL 分析与干预探针证实训练效应集中在设定回复轨迹的短暂"审议"上，承诺的决策是因果控制点——攻击者利用的浅层性恰恰成为防御机制。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

TL;DR: We propose ShallowDefend, which turns shallow alignment into a multi-turn jailbreak defense.

</details>

### 27. StageBreak: Diagnosing Stage-Selective Safety Failures in Multimodal Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=xme9ZFHUb0) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`multimodal jailbreak`、`stage attribution`、`safety diagnosis`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：越狱评测通常把多模态安全约化为单一端点——是否产出不安全回复；但该端点混淆了三种不同情形：模型未识别风险、丢失早期拒绝偏好、或在解码后期越过安全边界，现有评测缺乏区分手段。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出诊断框架 StageBreak，在保留必要上游判据的前提下，为每个失败样本归因最早的有效操作性失败——风险识别、拒绝偏好或安全生成之一；只有当样本为 clean-eligible（风险任务语义不变）且有害端点、先例保持与审计门在同一样本上一致时才接受归因；再用低秩修复、反向移植、跨阶段控制与跨攻击迁移度量被归因表示的干预相关性，从而区分语义损坏与识别、偏好、生成期失败。
- 📌 **结论**：StageBreak 将多模态越狱失败分解为风险识别、拒绝偏好与安全生成三类最早有效失败，并以干预实验验证归因表示的相关性；归因出的失败是否跨任务、外部基准与 held-out 模型持续存在也被系统检验（摘要为定性结论，未报告量化指标）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Jailbreak evaluation usually reduces multimodal safety to a single endpoint: whether an unsafe response is produced. That endpoint conflates three different cases. The model may fail to recognize risk, lose an early refusal preference, or cross the safety boundary later in decoding. We introduce StageBreak a diagnostic framework that assigns the earliest valid operational failure among risk recognition, refusal preference, and safe generation while preserving the required upstream criteria. A stage attribution is accepted only for clean-eligible examples whose risky task semantics remain invariant and whose harmful endpoint, prerequisite-preservation, and audit gates agree on the same sample. Low-rank repair, reverse transplantation, cross-stage controls, and cross-attack transfer then measure the interventional relevance of the attributed representation. The resulting attribution distinguishes semantic corruption from recognition, refusal-preference, and generation-time failures. We evaluate whether these attributed failures persist across tasks, external benchmarks, and held-out models.

TL;DR: StageBreak identifies whether multimodal jailbreaks fail at risk recognition, refusal preference, or safe generation while preserving the required upstream criteria.

</details>

### 28. Subliminal Learning Under Soft-Distillation

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Tj8ZsGcoAv) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`subliminal learning`、`knowledge distillation`、`misalignment propagation`、`AI safety`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：蒸馏可把教师模型的隐藏特质（hidden trait，教师中非对称存在、且从未在其生成语料中显式言明的属性）传给学生，即 subliminal learning；已有工作只覆盖教师轨迹上的 SFT，而现代后训练大量依赖软蒸馏（教师随采样 token 暴露完整概率分布），其隐藏特质转移能力对 AI 安全与安全影响重大却缺乏研究。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在与已有工作一致的统一框架下，分析 SFT、off-policy 蒸馏与 on-policy 蒸馏等多种训练配方中的 subliminal learning；利用模型概率分布导出的指标，定位并量化不同 token 类型上特质转移的程度与速率；进一步把分析扩展到 steering-vector 蒸馏与未对齐教师的 misalignment 传播两个相邻现象。
- 📌 **结论**：高熵 token 以不成比例的更高速率转移隐藏特质，即便优化预算低得多；已有文献报告的脆弱性（易被 token 选择、优化器、LoRA rank 或全参微调压制）并非 subliminal learning 的固有属性，可通过扩大数据或监督克服；不同训练设置以不同动力学诱导 subliminal learning。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Hidden traits can be transmitted from a teacher model to a student during distillation. This phenomenon is known as subliminal learning. A hidden trait refers to a property asymmetrically present in the teacher that is never explicitly vocalized in the training corpus generated by the teacher. Prior work explores how subliminal learning occurs during supervised fine-tuning on a teacher model's traces. Modern post-training pipelines, however, rely heavily on soft distillation, where the teacher exposes its full probability distribution alongside the sampled token. Because soft distillation is widely used for post-training, its capacity for hidden trait transfer has critical implications for AI safety and security yet prior work offers limited coverage of this paradigm. We analyze subliminal learning under various training recipes, including supervised fine-tuning, off-policy knowledge distillation, and on-policy distillation within a unified framework consistent with prior work. Using metrics derived from the model's probability distribution, we locate and quantify the extent and rate of trait transfer across different token types. We find that high-entropy tokens transfer subliminal traits at a disproportionately higher rate than low-entropy tokens, even under a substantially lower optimization budget. While prior work reports that subliminal learning is fragile and easily suppressed by variations in token selection, optimizer choice, LoRA rank, or full fine-tuning, we demonstrate that this fragility is not an inherent property of subliminal learning and can be overcome by scaling data or supervision. We show how different training setups induce subliminal learning with different dynamics and extend our analysis to the adjacent phenomena of steering-vector distillation and misalignment propagation from a misaligned teacher.

</details>

### 29. Surviving the Unseen: Predictive Defense for Novel Multi-Turn Multimodal Attacks

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=wNcx99cp9D) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`anomaly detection`、`survival analysis`、`agentic AI`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：MLLM 广泛集成进自主 agentic 工作流，带来非平稳攻击面：对手以渐进式跨模态扰动把恶意意图分散到纵向对话轨迹中，绕过逐轮护栏；受 Markov 性约束、孤立评估输入的静态防御无法检测累积性结构投毒。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：把安全验证形式化为动态生存预测与轨迹动力学问题，提出 TRIAD（Triple-tier Anomaly Defense）预测模型：将多模态多轮对话流映射为连续轨迹，集成结构异常检测与 Ledoit-Wolf 正则化 Mahalanobis 距离监控高维协方差漂移，用拓扑轨迹加速度区分良性创造性探索与持续恶意漂移；这些运动学与几何特征经 Bayesian HMM 反馈环融入时变 Cox 比例风险模型；理论分析证明对抗扰动下期望失效时间数学有界、恶意加速度正发散。
- 📌 **结论**：TRIAD 为实时 agentic AI 系统提供计算高效、可解释且具预测性的防护，在不依赖经验性再训练的情况下为持续安全对齐奠定严格基础（摘要为定性结论，未报告具体检测指标）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

The expansion of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and their integration into autonomous agentic workflows has introduced a non-stationary attack surface. Empirical observations indicate that adversaries employ progressive, cross-modal perturbations that evade turn-specific guardrails by distributing malicious intent across longitudinal conversational trajectories. Static defense mechanisms, constrained by the Markov property, evaluate inputs in isolation and fail to detect cumulative structural poisoning. To handle this limitation, this paper formulates safety verification as a dynamic survival prediction and trajectory dynamics problem. The Triple-tier Anomaly Defense (TRIAD) framework is proposed as a predictive model that maps multimodal and multi-turn conversational flow as a continuous trajectory. The framework integrates structural anomaly detection to monitor covariance shifts, a Ledoit-Wolf regularized Mahalanobis distance to monitor covariance shifts in high-dimensional spaces, and topological trajectory acceleration to differentiate benign creative exploration from continuous malicious drift. These kinematic and geometric features are integrated into a time-varying Cox Proportional Hazards model via a Bayesian Hidden Markov Model (HMM) feedback loop. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the TRIAD framework provides a mathematically bounded expected time-to-failure under adversarial perturbations, ensuring that malicious acceleration diverges positively. This framework provides a computationally efficient, interpretable, and predictive safeguard for real-time agentic AI systems, establishing a rigorous foundation for continuous safety alignment without relying on empirical retraining.

TL;DR: Static guardrails often fail to defend progressive multi-turn attacks, we introduced TRIAD - a mathematically bounded, real-time anomaly defense framework that formulates multimodal AI safety as a dynamic survivla prediction problem.

</details>
