### 45. Adaptive-Attack Robustness of Prompt-Injection Detectors for Agentic Tool-Response Content

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=4LlPvx9fmD) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`detection`、`prompt injection`、`adaptive attack`、`agent security`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 消费外部 tool-response 内容时易受 indirect prompt injection。CaMeL、MELON、trust-scoring memory guard 等新防御几乎只在静态、非自适应攻击下评测，其对自适应攻击的稳健性未知。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：训练 domain-specific 注入检测器（静态准确率近完美，99.3% F1），系统测试六类独立自适应攻击家族：黑盒 paraphrase、灰盒 greedy search、MINJA 式 narrative bridging、多语 code-switching、组合攻击与 Unicode/编码变换（homoglyph、zero-width、full-width）。提出 defense-loop 方法论（定位 gap → 困难负例微调 → 未见 holdout 验证 → McNemar 检验），跨 8 个结构性不同 gap 迭代加固。关键发现：针对一个目标的加固会悄悄使另一目标回退（一轮 cross-domain 加固曾长期未被察觉地推高 hard-benign 误报率），因此每轮加固必须对所有既有前线联合验证。
- 📌 **结论**：full-width Unicode 达到 96.0% bypass（最大缺口）；最终分类器在自然良性集上 FPR 为 0.0%（GPT-4o-mini 启发式基线 89.3%）。在 live AgentDojo agent-loop（144 任务、3 次运行）中，静态攻击 ASR 从 49.3%±2.6% 降至 0.0%，与官方复现的 CaMeL/MELON 安全性相当、utility 相当，推理比启发式基线快 50 倍以上；在两种新构造的自适应攻击下 ASR 从 11.6–38.2% 降至 0.0%（本检测器与 CaMeL），MELON 为 0.0–0.7%。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language model (LLM) agents that consume external tool-response content are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection. Recent defenses—CaMeL, MELON, trust-scoring memory guards—report strong results but are evaluated almost exclusively against static, non-adaptive attacks. We show a domain-trained detector, despite near-perfect static accuracy (99.3% F1), degrades substantially under adaptive attack, testing six independent adaptive-attack families: black-box paraphrase, grey-box greedy-search, MINJA-inspired narrative bridging (an honest negative result—fails even without hardening), multilingual code-switching, compositional attacks, and Unicode/encoding transformations (homoglyph, zero-width, full-width, the latter reaching 96.0% bypass, our largest gap). We apply a defense-loop methodology (identify gap → fine-tune on hard negatives → validate on an unseen holdout → confirm via McNemar's test) across eight structurally distinct gaps. Critically, hardening toward one objective can silently regress another: a cross-domain round regressed hard-benign false-positive rate undetected for an extended period, caught only when a later round was jointly validated against every established front rather than just its own target. A fully-balanced round resolves this without significant loss elsewhere, and an analogous, larger instance recurs and is resolved again for the Unicode gap—concrete evidence adaptive-robustness evaluation must validate every hardening round jointly, not independently. On a hard, naturalistic benign set, our final classifier reaches 0.0% FPR versus 89.3% for a GPT-4o-mini heuristic baseline. In a live, end-to-end AgentDojo agent-loop (144 tasks, 3 runs), our final checkpoint reduces attack success rate from 49.3%±2.6% to 0.0% under a static attack, matching officially-reproduced CaMeL and MELON on security with comparable utility, while being >50x faster at inference than the heuristic baseline; under two newly-constructed adaptive attacks (full-width Unicode, desiderative reframing) applied directly against the live loop, attack success rate similarly falls from 11.6–38.2% (no defense) to 0.0% for our detector and CaMeL, and 0.0–0.7% for MELON, with the resulting utility cost concentrated in 3 of 16 workflows rather than spread evenly. We release our threat model, attack implementations, and evaluation protocol to support more rigorous evaluation of future agent tool-response (input-boundary) defenses.

TL;DR: Prompt-injection detector robustness is attack-family-specific, and hardening one objective can silently regress another; jointly-validated hardening resolves this and matches CaMeL/MELON security in a live AgentDojo loop with one forward pass.

</details>

### 46. AdvSim2Real: Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=WwQHecJowh) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`adversarial training`、`web agent`、`world model`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Web agent 在第三方可写的页面上读取并行动，页面里植入的指令可把 agent 从用户目标上引开；但页面同时承载任务所需的取值与控件，无法一概忽略。现有防御在训练前固定的注入上微调，会被针对训练后模型适配的攻击者绕过；近来的对抗训练允许攻击者适配却把任务固定，任务被解决后即失去训练价值。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 AdvSim2Real，在冻结的 web world model 内共同演化任务 curriculum、注入 adversary 与 agent 三方。Curriculum 以 agent 约半数时间能解决的任务获得奖励，adversary 仅以"成功翻转"（把判定成功变成失败的注入）获得奖励。在模拟器中训练 4B 规模 agent，同时提升能力与鲁棒性。
- 📌 **结论**：在 150 个 web 任务上，面对训练中从未见过的 frontier-model adversary，AdvSim2Real 使完成率相对 base agent 提升 33.6%；有无攻击下完成率均上升，能力增益可迁移到真实浏览器。发布代码、基准与全部 checkpoint 结果。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Recent adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent. We release our code, the benchmark, and all checkpoint results.

</details>

### 47. ASPIRE: Agentic Safety and Prompt Injection Red-teaming Engine

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=9QOtWOZmJW) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`prompt injection`、`red teaming`、`agent security`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 检索不可信内容并经工具行动，indirect prompt injection 可导致未授权动作或持久状态改变。现有自动化红队大多只对预先指定的场景优化 payload，agent 行为空间中潜在漏洞未被探索。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 ASPIRE（Agentic Safety & Prompt Injection Red-teaming Engine），面向开放式、行为级漏洞发现。维护持续演化的 Agent Security Behavior Graph，用互补的 Explore 与 Exploit 两类专家发现、验证并泛化以后果（consequence）为中心的测试；轨迹证据用于更新图并诊断部分成功或失败的尝试，跨运行记忆迁移有效搜索策略。
- 📌 **结论**：在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 上，ASPIRE 在维持强攻击成功率的同时，显著扩大了后果、注入方法、环境与行为路径维度的覆盖面（摘要未给出具体数值）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

LLM agents retrieve untrusted content and act through tools, creating indirect prompt-injection risks that can cause unauthorized actions or persistent state changes. Existing automated red-teaming largely optimizes payloads for pre-specified scenarios, leaving latent vulnerabilities across the agent's behavior space unexplored. We present ASPRIE, an Agentic Safety \& Prompt Injection Red-teaming Engine for open-ended, behavior-level vulnerability discovery. ASPIRE maintains an evolving Agent Security Behavior Graph and uses complementary Explore and Exploit experts to discover, verify, and generalize consequence-centric tests. Trajectory evidence updates the graph and diagnoses partial or failed attempts, while cross-run memory transfers useful search strategies. Experiments on AgentDojo and AgentDyn show that ASPIRE substantially expands coverage across consequences, injection methods, environments, and behavior paths while maintaining strong attack success.

TL;DR: A Red Teaming Agent to discover Prompt Injection vulnerability automatically.

</details>

### 48. ATTRACK: Attribution-based Taint Tracking with Provable Bounds for Agent Security

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=0QXPPsbddF) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`taint tracking`、`certified robustness`、`agent security`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 消费的网页、邮件、文件中可能藏有 indirect prompt injection，需要既能度量不可信内容对每次 tool call 的影响、又给出可证概率界线的防御。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 ATTRACK，度量不可信内容对每个提议 tool call 的影响强度。先以 citation checks 拦截归因到不可信来源的指令，提前阻断大多数攻击；核心是影响测试——删除不可信内容后对同一 call 重新打分，若 log-probability 跌幅超过阈值则阻断。影响测试在 citation check 被欺骗时仍提供认证兜底：相对仅 trusted context 下的概率，界定 agent 执行恶意动作且防御漏检的概率上界。
- 📌 **结论**：在 4 个 AgentDojo suite 与 2 个模型上、每模型 194 个匹配案例中阻断全部观测攻击；无攻击时保留未防御 agent 任务效用的 89%（Qwen3.8-27B）与 79%（Gemma-4-26B），而 provenance-taint isolation 仅 51%/54%。Gemma 上 spotlighting、MELON 与注入分类器三个检测器最多放行 12.9% 的攻击；自适应攻击者在 832 个 payload、16 个 Gemma 案例上对 ATTRACK 无一成功，却对三个检测器找到新攻击；对 Qwen 一半、Gemma 大多数攻击案例，该界把攻击者精确目标 call 逃过防御的概率压到万分之一以下。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Language-model agents act on web pages, emails, and files that may contain indirect prompt injections: instructions planted to redirect agents toward an attacker's goals. We propose ATTRACK, a defence that measures how strongly untrusted content influences each proposed tool call. Its influence test deletes untrusted content and scores the same call again, blocking calls whose log-probability drops beyond a threshold. Citation checks, which detect instructions attributed to untrusted sources, stop most attacks early. The influence test is a certified backstop even when the citation checks are deceived: it bounds the probability that the agent takes a malicious action and the defence misses it, relative to its probability under trusted context alone. Across four AgentDojo suites and two models, ATTRACK blocks every observed attack on 194 matched cases per model. Without attacks, it keeps 89% of the undefended agent's task utility on Qwen3.8-27B and 79% on Gemma-4-26B, compared with 51% and 54% for provenance-taint isolation. On Gemma, by contrast, three detectors (spotlighting, MELON, and a prompt-injection classifier) allow attacks in up to 12.9% of cases. An adaptive attacker finds no successful attack against ATTRACK in 832 payloads over 16 Gemma cases, but finds new ones against all three detectors. For half of AgentDojo's attack cases on Qwen and most on Gemma, the bound keeps the chance that the attacker's exact goal call gets past the defence below one in ten thousand.

TL;DR: Score each tool call with and without the untrusted text; block it if the untrusted text drove it. Provable bound, 0% attack success on AgentDojo, no adaptive evasion.

</details>

### 49. Authorization and Endorsement Forgery in Multi-Agent Evaluation: Propagation and Defense

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Cd6jxOSSbk) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`indirect prompt injection`、`multi-agent`、`LLM-as-a-judge`、`provenance`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：基于 LLM 的评测系统日益依赖多智能体协作，judge 之间交换评语并在汇总前修订结论；这种协作引入 evidence-authorization 漏洞——无依据的权威声称经内部 agent 转述即获得表面权威，被下游 judge 当作可信同侪证据。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：将漏洞刻画为 Authorization and Endorsement Forgery（AEF）：一种 IPI 衍生攻击模式，注入任务相关但虚构的专家背书、既有裁决、授权或共识，而非以注入指令直接操纵评测者。在三个 LLM 评测基准上考察 AEF 在多智能体评测管线中的传播；提出 TRUSTGUARD 编排层防御，把证据注册与授权分离，追踪来源及派生证据，仅当 provenance 与策略定义的授权要求满足时才允许下游使用。
- 📌 **结论**：AEF 使下游 target-selection 率最多提高 28.03 个百分点；TRUSTGUARD 将 macro-average ASR-any 从 61.03% 降至 34.41%，同时 clean accuracy 与无防御系统相当。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Recent LLM-based evaluation systems increasingly rely on multi-agent collaboration, where judges exchange assessments and revise decisions before final aggregation to improve evaluation quality. However, such collaboration introduces an evidence-authorization vulnerability: unsupported authority claims can acquire apparent authority when relayed by internal agents, leading downstream judges to treat them as credible peer evidence. We characterize this vulnerability as Authorization and Endorsement Forgery (AEF), an IPI-derived attack pattern that manipulates how evaluation evidence is interpreted and trusted. Unlike conventional instruction-oriented IPI payloads, AEF injects task-relevant but fabricated or unsupported claims of expert endorsement, prior adjudication, authorization, or consensus rather than directly steering the evaluator through injected instructions. Across three LLM evaluation benchmarks, AEF propagates through multi-agent evaluation pipelines and increases downstream target-selection rates by up to 28.03 percentage points, demonstrating its ability to manipulate evidence trust beyond direct exposure. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose TRUSTGUARD, an orchestration-layer defense that separates evidence registration from authorization. TRUSTGUARD prevents unsupported authority claims from gaining decision influence by tracking source and derived evidence and permitting downstream use only when provenance and policy-defined authorization requirements are satisfied. Evaluation results show that TRUSTGUARD reduces macro-average ASR-any from 61.03% to 34.41% while maintaining clean accuracy comparable to the undefended system.

</details>

### 50. AutoDojo: A Generative Benchmark for Evaluating Prompt Injection Defenses in LLM Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=RFOUMuMb6L) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`indirect prompt injection`、`adaptive attack`、`agent security`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：针对 indirect prompt injection 已有 prompt-based、detection-based、system-level 三类防御，但 AgentDojo 等常用评测基准本质静态、生成固定分布的攻击，防御可以在其上得高分却并不抗自适应威胁。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 AutoDojo，构建于 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 之上的生成式基准，针对给定 agent 与 defense 自适应地生成 IPI；支持两基准共六个任务套件，覆盖银行、通信、旅行、购物、编码与日常助手域。在严格黑盒设定下（只观察候选注入是否成功）优化注入，可便捷集成并常能改进任意现有黑盒攻击。
- 📌 **结论**：跨 10 个防御与 5 个目标模型的实验表明，静态基准常常显著高估防御效果；多数现有防御要么牺牲大量 utility、要么并不安全。攻击成功率还与任务规范交互，欠规范（under-specified）任务尤其脆弱。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Indirect prompt injection (IPI) is a major security threat to LLM-powered agents. Thus, a growing body of work has proposed a variety of defensive approaches against IPI which can be grouped into three broad categories: prompt-based, detection-based, and system-level designs. However, commonly used benchmarks for evaluating defense, such as AgentDojo, are inherently static, generating a fixed distribution of IPI attacks. Consequently, a defense can score well on them without being robust to adaptive threats. We introduce AutoDojo, a generative benchmark built on AgentDojo and AgentDyn that generates IPI adaptively for a given agent and defense. It supports six task suites across the two benchmarks, covering banking, communication, travel, shopping, coding, and everyday-assistant domains. AutoDojo optimizes injections under a strict black-box setting, observing only whether a candidate injection succeeds, and can readily integrate, and often improve on, any existing black-box attack. Across ten defenses and five target models, AutoDojo demonstrates that standard static benchmarks often significantly overestimate defense efficacy. Moreover, we show that most existing defenses either sacrifice considerable utility or are insecure. Finally, we demonstrate that attack success interacts with task specification, with under-specified tasks particularly vulnerable.

TL;DR: We develop AutoDojo, a generative benchmark built directly on top of AgentDojo and AgentDyn for adaptive evaluation of indirect prompt injection defenses for LLM agents, showing that static benchmarks often overestimate defense efficacy.

</details>

### 51. Autonomous Red Teaming for Utility-Preserving Indirect Prompt Injection via Fine-Grained Diagnosis

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=kbGIuuTWP0) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`indirect prompt injection`、`red teaming`、`black-box optimization`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Indirect prompt injection 把恶意指令藏进外部内容以重定向 tool-using agent；有效红队须既诱发目标行为又不破坏合法用户任务。现有自适应攻击依赖标量端到端结果或粗粒度整体反馈，难以解释失败原因、指导改进。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 EPOA 自适应黑盒框架，提供细粒度、有证据支撑的迭代优化指导。EPOA Judge 把可观测攻击进度分解为四个有序诊断块——Exposure、Provenance Promotion、Objective Adoption、Action Binding；对每个 payload 判定哪些块得到执行证据支持，optimizer 结合结构化诊断与累积轨迹历史生成下一候选。在固定查询预算内探索多条 carrier 轨迹。
- 📌 **结论**：在 AgentDojo 上跨 4 个受害模型与 3 种防御（共 12 个组合）取得有竞争力的 utility-preserving 攻击表现：平均 utility-preserving ASR 达 33.5%，高于 IterInject 的 31.6% 与 PAIR 的 28.9%；同时达到 55.1% ASR 与 74.3% 任务 utility。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Indirect prompt injection (IPI) embeds malicious instructions in external content to redirect tool-using language agents toward unauthorized actions. Effective red teaming must therefore identify payloads that induce the target behavior without disrupting the legitimate user task. However, existing adaptive attacks typically rely on scalar end-to-end outcomes or coarse holistic feedback, offering limited insight into why an attempt fails or how it should be improved. We introduce EPOA, an adaptive black-box framework that provides fine-grained, evidence-grounded guidance for iterative IPI optimization. At its core, the EPOA Judge decomposes observable attack progress into four ordered diagnostic blocks: Exposure, Provenance Promotion, Objective Adoption, and Action Binding. For each evaluated payload, it determines which blocks are supported by observable execution evidence; an optimizer then uses this structured diagnosis, together with the accumulated trajectory history, to generate the next candidate. This diagnose-and-refine process explores multiple carrier trajectories within a fixed query budget. 
We evaluate EPOA on AgentDojo across four victim models and three defense settings. EPOA achieves competitive utility-preserving attack performance across all 12 model-defense combinations, obtaining an average utility-preserving attack success rate of 33.5%, compared with 31.6% for IterInject and 28.9% for PAIR. It also achieves a 55.1% attack success rate and 74.3% task utility. These results support the effectiveness of fine-grained, evidence-grounded diagnosis for adaptive IPI optimization across the evaluated models and defenses.

TL;DR: We introduce EPOA, an evidence-grounded black-box framework that diagnoses attack progress to optimize indirect prompt injections while preserving legitimate task utility.

</details>

### 52. BrowseSafe++: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detection Across Web Contexts, Languages, and Browser Views

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=buhynGpe8l) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`prompt injection`、`browser agent`、`detection`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Browser agent 须在消费不可信网页的同时代表用户决策与执行，网页内嵌恶意指令可重定向合法任务。既有基准确立了威胁，但部署场景所需的 web 域、语言与页面视图的一致覆盖仍然不足。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：BrowseSafe++ 将 BrowseSafe 从 14,719 条扩至 38,675 条：从生产网站捕获中收集真实在野注入，保留原始注入并重写敏感部分以保护隐私；每条目将受攻击页面与仅差注入的 control 页面配对，提供 HTML、Markdown、accessibility tree 与 screenshot 四种视图，并关联合法任务与预期结果；覆盖 12 个域、24 种攻击类型、18 个放置位置。以此监督训练 0.8B 文本与多模态检测器 BrowseSafe-Guard，并提出利用浏览器 agent 反馈精炼注入的 BrowseSafe-Adapt。
- 📌 **结论**：BrowseSafe-Guard 以小体量超过 frontier 模型且误报显著更少；BrowseSafe-Adapt 显示，重放时仅攻陷百分之几任务的注入经适配后成功率可达 95%。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Browser agents need to make decisions and execute actions on behalf of users while consuming untrusted webpages. This creates the chance for malicious instructions embedded in webpages to redirect legitimate tasks. Existing benchmarks establish this threat, but broader evaluation requires consistent coverage of the web domains, languages, and page views encountered in deployment. We introduce BrowseSafe++, extending BrowseSafe from 14,719 to 38,675 entries. We start with prompt injections observed in the wild from production website captures, preserve the original injections, and rewrite sensitive portions to protect privacy. Each entry pairs an attacked page with a control page that differs only by the injection, provides HTML, Markdown, accessibility tree, and screenshot views, and is linked to a legitimate task and expected outcome. The benchmark contains twelve domains, twenty-four attack types, and eighteen placements. Using these pairs as supervision, we train BrowseSafe-Guard, compact 0.8B text and multi-modal detectors that outperform frontier models while raising far fewer false alarms. We also introduce BrowseSafe-Adapt, which refines benchmark injections from browser-agent feedback and shows that attacks succeeding on a few percent of tasks when replayed succeed on up to 95% after adaptation. The benchmark, model, and SDK for adaptive framework will be released upon publication.

TL;DR: BrowseSafe++ benchmarks prompt injection detection and resistance across realistic web contexts, languages, and browser views, and introduces an adaptive framework for evaluating attacks against executing browser agents.

</details>

### 53. Certified Execution for Agentic AI: Petri-Net Assurance Between Reasoning and Action

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=qZggkN54q1) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`Petri net`、`runtime assurance`、`formal methods`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 会发布代码、调用 API、消耗预算，且部署不可召回。难点不在准确性：任何从所示文本判断放行的无状态 guard 都无法强制"一次批准只授权一次部署"——horizon H 上至少需要 $\lfloor H/2\rfloor+1$ 个监控状态，无界 horizon 上任何有限状态监控都不够，guard 必须会计数。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：研究自主部署 agent 场景（跑 CI 与安全扫描、取得人工批准、然后部署），攻击者在 issue 描述中藏入"立即部署"指令。把状态保存在模型与工具之间的 agentic execution Petri net 中：批准与预算是 firing 消耗的 mark，状态方程一行即可沿每个 firing sequence 限定 deployments ≤ approvals。合成的 supervisor 如经典 supervisory control 般最大宽容，并证明在四条各自必要的假设下 net-level safety 可迁移。
- 📌 **结论**：4 个 OpenAI 模型面对 7 种间接注入：无中介时 84% 的注入 episode 以未授权发布告终；接入 kernel 后模型被劫持频率不变，但 1,120 个 kernel 中介 episode 中没有任何未授权部署执行；四个模型汇总的任务完成率高于包括"无防御"在内的所有基线。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Language-model agents ship code, call APIs and spend budgets, and a deployment cannot be recalled. We study an autonomous deployment agent that runs CI and a security scan, obtains human approval, then deploys, while an attacker hides an instruction in the issue description telling it to deploy at once. The difficulty is not one of accuracy. A guard that decides admission from the text it is shown cannot enforce "one approval authorizes one deployment": every stateless monitor either admits an unauthorized action or admits none, enforcing the rule over a horizon $H$ needs at least $\lfloor H/2\rfloor+1$ monitor states, and over an unbounded horizon no finite-state monitor suffices. The guard must be able to count, and one place of a Petri net attains the bound exactly. We therefore hold the state in an agentic execution Petri net between the model and its tools, where approvals and budgets are marks that firing consumes, so one row of the state equation bounds deployments by approvals along every firing sequence. The synthesized supervisor is maximally permissive, as in classical supervisory control, and we prove that net-level safety transfers under four individually necessary assumptions. Empirically, four OpenAI models face seven indirect injections: unmediated, $84\%$ of injected episodes end in an unauthorized release. Under the kernel the models are hijacked just as often, no unauthorized deployment executes in any of $1{,}120$ kernel-mediated episodes, and pooled over the four models, task completion is higher than under any baseline, including no defense at all.

TL;DR: A Petri-net execution kernel beneath an LLM converts agent safety from semantic filtering to stateful structural enforcement, yielding a maximally permissive supervisor and making unsafe tool calls unreachable by construction.

</details>

### 54. ClickShield: A Firewall for Multimodal Computer-use Agents Against Dual Prompt Injection

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=4BczkP07j3) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`computer-use agent`、`runtime guardrail`、`screen sanitization`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多模态 computer-use agent 通过反复解读截图与自然语言指令执行目标，隐式信任用户 prompt 与屏幕内容，因此易受 dual prompt injection：恶意指令与欺骗性 UI 元素（如钓鱼弹窗）把 agent 引向不安全动作。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 ClickShield——training-free、model-agnostic 的运行时防火墙，包裹现有 agent 而无需重训或修改策略。以两个并行模块建立零信任边界：(i) 基于 LLM-as-a-judge 的指令风险过滤器；(ii) 解耦的 UI parser，检测可交互区域、抽取 OCR 文本并生成轻量元素描述，构成 DOM 式结构化屏幕表示。Judge LLM 将验证后的目标与元素列表比对、标记意图冲突元素，在 agent 行动前确定性 blackout 遮蔽其 bounding box。
- 📌 **结论**：在 RiOSWorld-Bench（492 个危险任务）与 OS-Harm-Bench 上显著压制攻击：adversarial goal completion 从 59.6% 降至 5.4%，同时在 OSWorld 上良性 utility 仅边际下降。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multimodal computer-use agents execute goals by repeatedly interpreting a screenshot and a natural-language instruction. Because today’s agents implicitly trust both the user prompt and on-screen content, they are vulnerable to dual prompt injection: malicious instructions and deceptive UI elements (e.g., phishing pop-ups) that steer the agent into unsafe actions. We introduce ClickShield, a training-free, model-agnostic runtime firewall that wraps an existing agent without retraining or modifying its policy. ClickShield enforces a zero-trust boundary via two parallel modules: (i) an instruction risk filter using an LLM-as-a-judge, and (ii) a decoupled UI parser that detects interactable regions, extracts OCR text, and produces lightweight element captions to form a structured, DOM-like screen representation. A judge LLM then compares the verified goal against this element list to flag intent-conflicting elements; ClickShield deterministically blackout-masks their bounding boxes before the agent acts. Across RiOSWorld-Bench (492 risky tasks) and OS-Harm-Bench, ClickShield sharply suppresses attack success (e.g., adversarial goal completion (59.6% $\to$ 5.4%) while preserving benign utility on OSWorld (only marginal success degradation).

TL;DR: ClickShield is a training-free runtime firewall that protects computer agents from prompt injection and deceptive UIs by filtering risky instructions and blackout-masking malicious screen elements before interaction.

</details>

### 55. CoER: Defending against Adaptive Indirect Prompt Injection via Adversarial Co-Evolution and Refinement

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=SUxaNjKUP8) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`indirect prompt injection`、`adversarial training`、`co-evolution`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 在工具使用中易受 indirect prompt injection：藏在不可信工具输出中的对抗指令隐蔽重定向任务。既有工作多以固定攻击训练与评估防御，难以应对随防御者行为而适配的真实攻击者；强防御必须在训练中适应持续演化的攻击者。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 CoER，verifier-grounded 的共同进化与修复框架，把任务内交错的工具调用与自适应注入建模为 general-sum Markov game：防御者通过连续工具调用推进任务，攻击者可在同一任务内多次注入并依据防御者响应与先前执行 trace 适配后续攻击。从成功轨迹初始化攻击者后，双边对抗强化学习（BA-RL）将双方历史策略留作对手种群并混合当前与历史对手；攻击者种群复用以挑战 teacher agent，仅同时通过安全与任务完成验证的演示才用于微调共同进化的防御者。
- 📌 **结论**：在 7 个域、3 个评测 seed 上，CoER 把自适应攻击成功率从 41.3% 降到 0.2%，safe task completion 从 39.6% 提升到 76.2%；外部基准亦显示攻击抵抗力提升。分析表明共同进化强化了攻击能力，训练出的攻击者会利用执行反馈适配后续注入。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) during tool use: adversarial instructions hidden in untrusted tool outputs can covertly redirect legitimate task execution. Existing work often trains and evaluates defenses against fixed attacks that do not adapt to the defender's behavior, so the resulting defenses may struggle against adaptive attacks in real-world settings. We argue that a strong defense against adaptive IPI must adapt during training to a continually evolving attacker. Building on this insight, we propose CoER, a verifier-grounded co-evolution and refinement framework that models interleaved tool calls and adaptive injections within a task as a general-sum Markov game: the defender advances the task through successive tool calls, while the attacker can inject multiple times within the same task and adapt subsequent attacks to the defender's responses and prior execution traces. After initializing the attacker from successful trajectories, bilateral adversarial reinforcement learning (BA-RL) retains historical policies from both roles as opponent populations and mixes current and historical opponents, extending training beyond the latest matchup. Attackers from these populations are then reused to challenge teacher agents, and only demonstrations verified for both safety and task completion are used to fine-tune the co-evolved defender. Across seven domains and three evaluation seeds, CoER reduces adaptive attack success from 41.3\% to 0.2\% and raises safe task completion from 39.6\% to 76.2\%; external benchmarks also show improved attack resistance. Further experiments validate the effectiveness of bilateral historical-opponent mixing and population-guided refinement. Attacker analyses show that co-evolution strengthens attack capabilities and that the trained attacker uses execution feedback to adapt subsequent injections.

TL;DR: CoER co-evolves adaptive attackers and tool-using defenders, then repairs discovered failures, substantially improving safety and task utility against indirect prompt injection.

</details>

### 56. CPI: Contextual Prompt Injection against MCP Server Scanners

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=7TImfQIpSU) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`prompt injection`、`MCP`、`vulnerability detection`、`supply chain`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：基于 LLM 的 MCP server 扫描器不仅分析可执行代码，还读取仓库级上下文（README、工具描述、代码注释）；这些上下文可被 MCP 维护者任意操纵，构成被忽视的攻击面——恶意维护者可借安全声明影响扫描器判断。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Contextual Prompt Injection（CPI）黑盒攻击：利用扫描器自己的 findings 构造漏洞特定的 remediation 叙事，声称所报告问题已被修复，同时保持相关可执行实现原封不动。整理含 372 个真实 MCP server（其中 45 个带已验证漏洞）的数据集，对三个 LLM MCP 安全扫描器与既有基准评测，并经人工验证。
- 📌 **结论**：对每个被测扫描器，CPI 都能在超过一半的 baseline-positive 仓库中抑制至少一个真实漏洞 finding。这表明 LLM 扫描器会优先采信攻击者控制的修复声明而非矛盾的代码证据；仓库上下文应被视为不可信输入，声称的修复须独立验证。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language model (LLM)-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server scanners increasingly analyze not only executable code but also repository-level context, such as README files, tool descriptions, and code comments. Because this context can be freely manipulated by MCP maintainers, it creates an overlooked attack surface where a malicious maintainer may influence scanner judgments through security claims. Building on this insight, we introduce Contextual Prompt Injection (CPI), a black-box attack that uses a scanner’s own findings to construct vulnerability-specific remediation narratives, claiming that reported issues have been fixed while leaving the relevant executable implementation unchanged. To enable realistic evaluation, we curate a dataset containing 372 real-world MCP Servers, including 45 with verified vulnerabilities. We evaluate CPI against three LLM-based MCP security scanners and existing benchmarks. Evaluation with manual verification shows that CPI suppresses at least one genuine vulnerability finding in more than half of baseline-positive repositories for each evaluated scanner. Such findings demonstrate that LLM-based scanners can prioritize attacker-controlled remediation claims over contradictory code evidence, highlighting the need to treat repository context as untrusted input and independently verify claimed fixes.

TL;DR: Contextual Prompt Injection (CPI) shows that attacker-controlled repository context can mislead LLM-based MCP scanners: false remediation claims suppress genuine findings in over half of baseline-positive servers without changing vulnerable code.

</details>

### 57. Delegation-Scoped Provenance for Tool-Using Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=CA1JtSYaeg) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`provenance`、`information-flow control`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：用户常让 agent 从读到的内容里取动作参数（"在 Quinn 的邮件里安排会议"、"给 #general 所有人发消息"）；现有 IPI 防御要么禁止不可信内容选择这类参数（直接挡掉任务），要么去判断动作是否看起来合法，均不理想。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：把请求读作委托授权（delegated authority）声明：它（往往隐式地）指明哪些记录与查找可为哪些参数供值。DelegationScope 仅从请求解析委托，仅当用户授权的记录包含该值时放行敏感值；对其他内容也提到的值，交由只看授权记录的 verifier 裁定。同时给出击败 record 级 provenance 检查的攻击，并构建委托已知的 DelegationBench（216 个任务）。
- 📌 **结论**：预注册 held-out 评测中阻断全部 96 个把攻击者取值植入所指名记录的攻击（其中 42 个能通过 provenance 基线）；AgentDyn 上 560 个攻击从 138 降到 81 且完成任务多于该基线；AgentDojo 五个 executor 上在注入成功处削减攻击 29–52%，注入不成功处最多损失 97 个 clean 任务中的 3 个。修订版 DelegationScope+ 在 AgentDojo 上把攻击成功从无防御的 31/194 降到 9/194 且无 clean 损失；同设置下 CaMeL 与 Progent 拦截更多攻击但少完成 6–69 个任务；所指名记录内部的注入仍超出任何 provenance 规则的能力。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Users often let an agent take the arguments of an action from what it reads: "set up the meeting in Quinn's email", "message everyone in #general", "refund whoever paid me for the deposit". Defenses against indirect prompt injection either forbid untrusted content from choosing such arguments, which blocks these tasks, or judge whether an action looks legitimate. We instead read the request as a statement of delegated authority: it says, often implicitly, which records and lookups may supply which arguments. DelegationScope parses this delegation from the request alone, admits a sensitive value only if a record the user authorized contains it, and asks a verifier that sees only authorized records to settle values that other content also mentions. We describe attacks that defeat record-level provenance checks, and DelegationBench, 216 tasks whose delegation is known. In preregistered held-out evaluations, DelegationScope stops all 96 attacks that plant the attacker's value in the named record, 42 of which pass a provenance baseline, and on AgentDyn it lowers attack success from 138 to 81 of 560 while completing more tasks than that baseline, though fewer than no defense. Across five executors on AgentDojo, it cuts attack success by 29–52% where injections succeed and costs at most three of 97 clean tasks where they do not. DelegationBench shows where reading delegation fails; the revised DelegationScope+ lowers attack success to 9 of 194 on AgentDojo, from 31 without defense and with no loss of clean tasks, and to 62 on AgentDyn. CaMeL and Progent, run in the same setting, block more attacks with a 9B executor but complete 6 to 69 fewer of the 97 tasks, mostly ones whose arguments the user delegated. Injections inside the record the user named remain beyond any provenance rule.

TL;DR: Reading from the user's request which records may supply which tool arguments lets agents act on content the user delegated while rejecting values injected anywhere else.

</details>

### 58. Endogenous Byzantine Faults: Measuring and Containing Fault Contagion in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=7MjYspnB9H) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`multi-agent`、`Byzantine fault tolerance`、`prompt injection`、`fault contagion`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 多智能体系统以投票、辩论、同行评审从冗余中获得可靠性，继承拜占庭容错"诚实多数战胜故障少数"的前提——该前提把故障集合视为对手固定。本文指出 LLM 系统的故障集是内生的：诚实 agent 仅凭读取协议消息即可变故障，故障随协议的日常使用而传播。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：形式化 contagious Byzantine fault 模型与三个可测量：每跳感染率 $\beta$、payload 复制率 $\beta_{\mathrm{rep}}$、replica 间失效相关 $\rho$，证明诚实多数在独立攻陷下至多容忍 $n(1-2\beta)/(2(1-\beta))$ 个对手（$\beta \ge 1/2$ 时为零）；传染跨轮次引入级联条件、相关 replica 引入不可消除的失效下限。在 62 个系统上验证理论量对辩论准确率的预测，并在约 780k 次 agent 调用（11 个模型、7 个家族、1300 个问题）上测量传播；提出 provenance gate（放行同侪证据、拒绝同侪指令）。
- 📌 **结论**：三量隐含的 vote share 追踪 62 个系统的辩论准确率（r=−0.94，held-out R²=0.86），并将 53 个系统正确放在多数阈值一侧而无需拟合。仅声称 coordinator authority 的消息即可翻转 97% 的 Llama-3.3-70B agent（可自行验证的算术题），完整论证的翻转率为 0%；五个 agent 中一个对手就能把四个大模型的辩论准确率从 74–90% 压到 2% 以下；provenance gate 将准确率恢复到 72–87% 且基本不损失接受合法纠正的能力。同族内更大模型更难被说服但更易被命令。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

LLM multi-agent systems use voting, debate, and peer review to obtain reliability from redundancy, on a premise inherited from Byzantine fault tolerance (BFT): an honest majority outvotes a faulty minority. The premise treats the set of faulty agents as fixed by the adversary. We show that in LLM systems the fault set is \emph{endogenous}: an honest agent becomes faulty by reading a protocol message, so the fault spreads through ordinary use of the protocol. We formalize a contagious Byzantine fault model with three measurable quantities, the per-hop infection rate $\beta$, the payload replication rate $\beta_{\mathrm{rep}}$, and the inter-replica failure correlation $\rho$, under which an honest majority survives fewer than $n(1-2\beta)/(2(1-\beta))$ adversaries under independent compromise, i.e.\ none once $\beta \ge 1/2$; contagion across rounds adds a cascade condition and correlated replicas an irreducible failure floor. The vote share these quantities imply tracks debate accuracy over 62 systems ($r=-0.94$, held-out $R^2=0.86$, no better than $\beta$ alone) and places 53 of them on the correct side of the majority threshold without fitting. In about 780k agent calls over 11 models from seven families and 1300 questions, a message that only \emph{claims} coordinator authority flips 97\% of Llama-3.3-70B agents on arithmetic they can verify themselves, while a worked argument flips 0\%. Within the model families we test, larger models are harder to persuade but easier to command, and some models forward the payload at every hop of a relay chain. One adversary among five drives debate accuracy from 74--90\% to 2\% or less for four large models. Mixing vulnerable model families does not help; only members that resist the instruction channel do. A provenance gate that admits peer evidence but not peer directives restores accuracy to 72--87\% and, unlike a warning prompt, mostly preserves the rate at which agents accept legitimate corrections; an adaptive attacker is left with the weaker evidence channel, which the gate does not address.

TL;DR: In LLM multi-agent systems, protocol messages turn honest agents faulty. A forged authority notice flips up to 100% of agents; one adversary in five collapses debate. A provenance gate restores accuracy at no utility cost.

</details>

### 59. GatewayBench: Unified Capability and Security Evaluation Platform for MCP Gateways

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=fhlLDg6Wpm) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`MCP`、`agent security`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：MCP 已成为连接 agent 与异构工具的标准接口，MCP gateway 作为聚合、治理并塑造工具面的关键中间件随之兴起；但 gateway 设计会显著影响 agent 行为——工具增多时 agent 难以发现与选择工具，任务性能下降、开销上升、暴露于恶意工具的风险增大，此前没有工作系统研究这一点。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 GatewayBench，首个 MCP gateway 统一评测框架：把 gateway 架构分为 flattened（前置暴露全部工具）与 hierarchical（提供工具发现 meta-tool、按需检索）两种范式；包含 6 个域的 524 个任务与来自 251 个真实 MCP server 的 11,118 个真实工具池；通过系统注入任务无关工具模拟大规模部署下工具面的扩张；以检查环境状态的 verifiable judge 定量评分，跨 7 个广泛部署的 MCP gateway 与多种 agent 配置评测良性与对抗任务。
- 📌 **结论**：不同 gateway 设计在任务完成、工具使用效率与攻击抵抗力上差异显著，且这些效应与底层模型和 agent harness 强交互。MCP gateway 是 agentic AI 栈中影响重大却未被充分探索的组件，该基准同时为更安全 agentic 系统提供严格测试床。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

AI agents have increasingly interacted with external environments by invoking tools, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) emerging as a standard interface for connecting agents to heterogeneous tools and services. As organizations deploy agents at scale, MCP gateways have become a critical middleware layer for aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to agents. However, gateway design can substantially affect agent behavior: as the number of available tools grows, agents may struggle with tool discovery and selection, leading to degraded task performance, increased computational overhead, and potentially greater exposure to malicious tools. Despite the growing importance of MCP gateways in agentic systems, no prior work has systematically studied how gateway design affects agent capability, efficiency, and security.
To address this gap, we introduce GatewayBench, the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways. We characterize gateway architectures into two major paradigms: $\textit{flattened gateways}$, which expose the complete set of available tools to the agent upfront, and $\textit{hierarchical gateways}$, which provide tool-discovery meta-tools that allow agents to selectively retrieve relevant tools on demand. GatewayBench comprises 524 tasks across six domains, together with a pool of 11,118 real-world tools from 251 authentic MCP servers. To emulate large-scale deployments, we systematically inject task-irrelevant tools sampled from this pool into each agent environment, enabling controlled evaluation as the accessible tool surface scales. Each task is evaluated using verifiable judges that inspect the resulting environment state quantitatively.
Based on GatewayBench, we conduct extensive experiments across seven widely deployed MCP gateways and diverse agent configurations, covering both benign and adversarial tasks. Our results reveal substantial differences across gateway designs in task completion, tool-use efficiency, and resilience to attacks, and further demonstrate that these effects interact strongly with the underlying model and agent harness. 
These findings highlight the MCP gateway as a consequential yet underexplored component of the agentic AI stack. 
By enabling controlled evaluation of gateway architectures under realistic tool ecosystems, GatewayBench provides both practical guidance for MCP gateway design and a rigorous testbed for developing more capable, efficient, and secure agentic systems.

</details>

### 60. LLM Agent Refusal Can be Harmful: An Availability Attack through MITM Tampering on Remote MCP Services

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=tUYDnsZ34t) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`prompt injection`、`MCP`、`availability attack`、`Monte Carlo tree search`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：安全对齐的 LLM agent 在敏感上下文（包括 tool call 返回值）中更容易拒绝。本文指出这一拒绝行为本身即是攻击面：MCP 返回值中伪造的安全告警可诱使 agent 阻断（brick）合法用户请求，构成针对 agentic harness 的可用性攻击。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 ARB 攻击：攻击者以中间人身份劫持或转发 MCP 通信，在报文中附加隐蔽假告警，专打依赖远程 MCP 服务、本地工具无法绕过的请求。把攻击形式化为拒绝概率分解：tool-call 概率、告警敏感度与告警后验证能力；在 10 个主流模型与 3 个 harness 上验证。构建 NBMR——首个围绕 non-bypassability 设计的 MCP 数据集（8 类、160 个 docker 可部署场景），并提出基于 MCTS 的防御 AEPG，自动合成 AGENTS.md 规则文件。
- 📌 **结论**：30 个 model–harness 配置中 90% 上 ARB 的 ASR 超过 50%；AEPG 合成的规则将被攻击 agent 的 executed turns 从 18.8% 提升至 75.0%、scene completion 从 12.5% 提升至 75.0%。压力测试显示，对最对齐的模型家族，诱导出的拒绝会持续耗尽整个 repetition budget。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Safety-aligned LLM agents refuse sensitive contexts more readily, including the return values of tool calls. We show that this refusal behavior is itself an attack surface: fabricated security alerts embedded in MCP return values induce agents to brick legitimate user requests, constituting an availability attack on agentic harnesses. We propose the ARB attack, which appends covert fake alerts to MCP communications that the attacker hijacks or relays as a man in the middle; the attack targets requests that depend on a remote MCP service and cannot be bypassed by local tools. We formalize the attack with a refusal-probability decomposition into tool-call probability, warning sensitivity, and post-alert verification capability, and validate it on 10 mainstream models across 3 harnesses: ARB exceeds 50% ASR in 90% of the 30 model--harness configurations. We further construct NBMR, the first MCP dataset designed around non-bypassability (8 categories, 160 docker-deployable scenarios), and propose AEPG, an MCTS-based defense that synthesizes AGENTS.md rule files; the synthesized prompt raises executed turns on the attacked agent from 18.8% to 75.0% and scene completion from 12.5% to 75.0%. Stress tests show that the induced refusal persists through the full repetition budget for the most aligned model families.

</details>

### 61. MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=u7O2Hyonmw) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`multi-agent`、`indirect prompt injection`、`adversarial robustness`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Multi-agent debate（MAD）通过多个 agent 交换与批评答案提升 LLM 推理，但让 agent 互相纠错的交互同样会传播对抗错误、把 agent 引向错误答案；对 MAD 在多样攻击下的系统评测仍然缺乏。核心问题是：辩论究竟缓解还是放大对抗影响？
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 MADBench，按 MAD 工作流组织分层攻击分类法，纳入既有攻击并为辩论量身定制新策略；在 356 个源任务、3,958 个测试用例上评测 6 个攻击家族，考察其对最终答案与对抗影响传播的作用。
- 📌 **结论**：攻击之下 MAD 未必提升 LLM 推理：相对单 agent 基线，MAD 在问答任务上可缓解对答案准确率的攻击，却在问答与 workspace 任务上放大未授权读写。即便 5 个 agent 中 3 个串通，也仅把 28.30% 的原本答对任务改为错误答案，且只有 3.26% 的初始正确诚实 agent 在辩论中转为错误。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by allowing multiple agents to exchange and critique their answers to the same task. However, the interactions that enable agents to correct mistakes can also spread adversarial errors and steer the agents toward an incorrect answer. Although some efforts have been made to examine particular attack types on MAD, systematic evaluation of MAD under diverse attacks remains limited. A central question is whether debate mitigates adversarial influence or amplifies it.

In this paper, we present MADBench, a benchmark for evaluating the security of MAD. We organize attacks into a layered taxonomy following the MAD workflow, incorporating both established attacks and new strategies tailored to debate. We evaluate six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 test cases, examining their effects on the final answer and the propagation of adversarial influence. Our results show that, under attacks, MAD does not necessarily improve LLM reasoning. Compared with a single-agent baseline, MAD can mitigate attacks on answer accuracy in question-answering tasks while amplifying unauthorized reads or writes in both question-answering and workspace tasks. Moreover, even when three out of five agents collude, the attack changes the final answer from correct to wrong on only 28.30\% of tasks answered correctly without attack, while only 3.26\% of initially correct honest agents switch to wrong answers during debate.

</details>

### 62. Offline Scores Overestimate Online Oversight: Timely Interception of LLM Agents with Causal-Cone Monitoring

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=yVGzyZ8zMc) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`agent monitoring`、`online interception`、`prompt injection`、`causal reachability`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM agent 的 monitor 几乎都离线评估：在完整轨迹上计算 suspicion score 并以 AUC-ROC 汇总。部署要问的是另一回事——转账已清算、API key 已离机后才响的警报是"验尸"而非干预：monitor 能否在 agent 第一个不可逆步骤之前触发？
- 🔬 **研究方法**：形式化 online interception 问题并提出 OIF 评测协议：以规则检测器（而非模型自报）定位确定性、可审计的 harm horizon $t_I$（首个不可逆步），在匹配误报预算下按警报是否严格早于 $t_I$ 计分。区分 monitor 的两条信息通道——stated channel（CoT 与自报）与 action channel（动作的因果可达范围），并提出只读 action channel 的 causal-cone monitor：每步评估动作是否打开通向伤害的路径，而非采信 agent 的自辩。
- 📌 **结论**：跨两个环境、三个攻击家族、四个 monitor（开源与闭源模型）：完整轨迹 AUC 可以很高而 pre-horizon interception 很低，离线排名不必预测在线排名。Causal-cone monitor 的时机优势随攻击对 stated channel 的污染程度增大——monitor hijacking 与欺骗性推理下大、hidden reasoning 下小、弱攻击下消失（无效注入 −0.02，有效注入 +0.17）。全部实验在单工作站上以开源本地 monitor 监督闭源 frontier agent，协议与 monitor 都易于复现。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Monitors for LLM agents are predominantly evaluated offline: a suspicion score is computed over a completed trajectory and summarized by AUC-ROC. Deployment asks a different question, because an alarm raised after the wire transfer clears or the API key leaves the machine is an autopsy rather than an intervention: can the monitor fire before the agent's first irreversible step? We formalize this as online interception and introduce the Online Interception Framework (OIF), an evaluation protocol that anchors each attack trajectory at a deterministic, auditable harm horizon $t_I$, the first irreversible step, located by a rule-based detector rather than by the model's self-report, and scores a monitor by whether its alarm fires strictly before $t_I$ under a matched false-alarm budget. Under OIF, offline and online performance decouple: across two environments, three attack families, and four monitors spanning open-weight and closed models, completed-trajectory AUC can stay high while pre-horizon interception is low, and the offline ranking need not predict the online one. To explain when interception fails, we separate a monitor's two information channels, the agent's stated channel (its chain-of-thought and reports) and the action channel (what an action can causally reach), and evaluate a causal-cone monitor that reads the action channel: at each step it scores whether the action opens a path toward harm, rather than trusting the agent's stated justification. Its timeliness advantage grows with how far the attack corrupts the stated channel, from large under monitor hijacking and deceptive reasoning, to small under hidden reasoning, to none when attacks are too weak to bite; an effectiveness-stratified contrast ties the advantage to injection efficacy (ineffective injections $-0.02$, effective injections $+0.17$). Every experiment runs on a single workstation with an open-weight local monitor overseeing closed frontier agents, so both the protocol and the monitor are inexpensive to reproduce.

TL;DR: High offline AUC need not mean a monitor stops an agent in time. We formalize online interception (firing before the first irreversible step); an action-channel causal-cone monitor fires earlier when the stated channel is corrupted.

</details>

### 63. PACT: What Agents See Must Not Decide What Their Tools Do

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=M9OOKZErZW) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`provenance`、`runtime authorization`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：外部内容可以启发 agent 提议某个 tool call，但绝不能授予执行该 call 的权限；现有 agent 缺乏对这一"信息与授权"边界的系统化强制机制。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 PACT（Provenance-Aware Contract for Tools）：在 call 执行前，将其 operation、destination、arguments、sources、evidence 与 approval 对照 task contract——可信请求所允许事项的可执行清单——逐项检查。依赖任务提供完整契约、记录的 sources、对每个注册的改变或披露应用状态的 protected call 的拦截，以及被允许的替代路径。
- 📌 **结论**：拦截全部 1,500 个受控攻击并在无人工干预下完成全部 2,000 个任务；在 100 个改编 ARPIbench 案例上，8 个模型的 executed protected call ASR 从 2%–85% 全部降至 0；DeepSeek V4 Flash 的全部 7,560 个案例上 ASR 从 58.4% 降至零且许可内工具调用照常执行；AgentDojo 上并列最佳 under-attack 任务成功率与最佳安全成功率。构建完整契约仍然困难：72B 模型从请求生成契约能找到 70/72 个写工具，却只正确约束 20/223 个参数字段，而 PACT 对不完整权限按字面精确执行。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

External content may inform the tool call an agent proposes, but it must not grant permission to execute that call. Before a call runs, the Provenance-Aware Contract for Tools (PACT) checks its operation, destination, arguments, sources, evidence, and approval against a task contract, an executable list of what the trusted request permits. With complete contracts supplied by the task, recorded sources, interception of every registered call that changes or discloses application state (a protected call), and permitted alternatives, PACT blocks all 1,500 controlled attacks and completes all 2,000 tasks without human intervention. On the same 100 adapted ARPIbench cases, the attack success rate (ASR) in executed protected calls falls from 2%–85% to 0 for each of eight models. On all 7,560 cases with DeepSeek V4 Flash, ASR falls from 58.4% to zero while permitted tool calls still run. On AgentDojo, PACT ties the best task success under attack and the best safe success, and no protected call requested by an attack executes. Building complete contracts is harder. A 72B model that generates contracts from the request finds 70/72 write tools but correctly constrains only 20/223 argument fields, and PACT enforces such incomplete permissions exactly as written.

</details>

### 64. Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Xvoqy4F84S) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`red teaming`、`coding agent`、`agent monitoring`、`AI control`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：为防 coding agent 失控，生产系统已为每个提议动作配备可先行拒绝的 blocking monitor（Claude Code 的 Auto Mode、OpenAI Codex 的 Guardian）。既有评估多针对意外伤害或来自不可信源、意在劫持 agent 的注入，而对被监控 agent 本身持续恶意（persistently misaligned）时 monitor 的表现所知甚少。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：指派对抗 agent 执行高层攻击策略，试图绕过生产 blocking monitor 并造成灾难性伤害（如 exfiltrate 自身权重）；识别出多种逃逸机制：agent 生成的针对 monitor 的 prompt injection、multi-agent 攻击与 malicious compaction。并通过工具覆盖增强、transcript 格式改动与增加 agentic monitor 阶段等设计改动改进 Auto Mode。
- 📌 **结论**：79% 的试验中，agent 能用针对 Auto Mode 与 Guardian 的注入攻击运行任意 bash 命令；上述设计改动可大幅改进 Auto Mode，但以可接受成本阻止跨多个上下文（multi-context）的攻击仍是开放问题。论文详述红队方法论与新攻击向量，帮助防御者评估针对持续恶意 coding agent 的缓解措施。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

To keep coding agents from going off the rails, production systems now review each proposed action with a blocking monitor that can reject it before it runs (Auto Mode in Claude Code, Guardian in OpenAI's Codex). Prior evaluations of such monitors largely measure robustness to accidental harm or prompt injections from untrusted sources looking to hijack the agent. Less understood is how they hold up when the agent they monitor is persistently misaligned. To understand this risk, we task an adversarial agent with evading production blocking monitors and causing catastrophic harm, e.g. by exfiltrating its own weights. We find that when instructed with high-level attack strategies, adversarial agents can succeed through several distinct mechanisms, such as agent-generated prompt injection against the monitor, multi-agent attacks, and malicious compaction. In particular we find that in 79% of trials, the agent can use an injection attack against Auto Mode and Guardian to run arbitrary bash commands. We also find that it is possible to greatly improve Auto Mode through design changes like enhancements to tool coverage, changes in transcript formatting, and the addition of an agentic monitor stage. Even with these improvements, preventing multi-context attacks at an acceptable cost remains an open problem. By detailing our red-teaming methodology and highlighting new attack vectors, we aim to help defenders evaluate their mitigations against the possibility of persistent malign coding agents.

TL;DR: Many attacks on production coding-agent monitors, like monitor injection and coverage-gap exploits, can be substantially mitigated with certain defenses, but attacks that span multiple contexts remain a potent, unsolved threat.

</details>

### 65. Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=MkFAa2ZOmA) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`prompt injection`、`agent memory`、`self-propagation`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 日益作为有状态助手部署，跨交互保留信息并用工具读取、修改、创建持久 artifact；artifact 在用户间共享，构成彼此独立助手之间的间接通信信道。本文研究该信道能否支撑自传播攻击。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 artifact-mediated propagation：经 artifact（如报告）引入的对抗内容被存入助手持久 memory，在随后创建的 artifact 中再现，再被之后读取它的另一助手获取。在随时间建模独立运营助手间 artifact 交换的 temporal human–agent universes 中评测：攻击能否在连续交接中存活、传播多少跳、扩散多广。
- 📌 **结论**：攻击可跨多个独立助手传播并在长交互序列中持续存在；在更大的模拟环境中，连 GPT-5.6 Luna 也出现大范围扩散——感染 60–80% 的 agent，传播链长达 8 跳。持久 artifact 可充当对抗状态的耐久载体，使攻击寿命超出单次交互并跨隔离助手扩散。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant’s persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human–agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60–80\% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.

TL;DR: People use agents to do tasks in various workflow. An adversarially infected artifact can compromise agents with transmission through agent memory and documents created

</details>

### 66. SkillFence: Execution-Grounded Trust Boundaries for Skill-Augmented LLM Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=MgyYRvjASk) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`skill supply chain`、`trust boundary`、`tool use`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Skill 增强的 LLM agent 越来越依赖外部供给的工作流 artifact（skill 文件、tool 输出），它们操作上相关却可能被攻击者控制。本文识别 skill-context injection：这类 artifact 从上下文证据被抬升为执行权威，使伪造的批准、路由备注或策略声称转化为不安全 tool 动作。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：构建黑盒基准度量该威胁：用 safety-ablated 的开源模型把 28 个种子攻击改写成企业风格 skill 与 tool artifact；在 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Kimi-2.5 三个骨干的 agent 上测 Broad ASR（计入不安全动作、权威混淆与推理污染）。提出 execution authority separation 原则——artifact 只能为任务提供信息，敏感动作只能由可信 authority root（用户或系统策略）授权；SkillFence 据此从 artifact 抽取权威声称、估计残余权威混淆，并对每个敏感 tool call 以可信 root 设门。
- 📌 **结论**：三骨干上毒化 artifact 取得 38.39%–76.07% 的 Broad ASR；SkillFence 分别将其从 70.71% 降至 6.96%、55.00% 降至 5.18%、41.16% 降至 2.86%，同时保留 98.67%–100% 的良性 utility。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Skill-augmented LLM agents increasingly act on externally supplied workflow
artifacts, such as skill files and tool outputs, that are operationally relevant but
may be attacker-controlled. We identify skill-context injection, in which such
artifacts are elevated from contextual evidence to execution authority, so that forged
approvals, routing notes, or policy claims become unsafe tool actions. To measure
this threat, we build a black-box benchmark that rewrites 28 seed attacks into
enterprise-style skill and tool artifacts using safety-ablated open-weight models.
On agents built on GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Kimi-2.5, these artifacts
achieve broad attack success rates (Broad ASR, which counts unsafe actions,
authority confusion, and reasoning contamination) of 38.39%–76.07%. We propose
execution authority separation: artifacts may inform a task, but only a trusted
authority root, such as the user or system policy, may authorize a sensitive action.
SkillFence enforces this principle by extracting authority claims from artifacts,
estimating residual authority confusion, and gating each sensitive tool call against
the trusted root. It reduces Broad ASR from 70.71% to 6.96%, from 55.00%
to 5.18%, and from 41.16% to 2.86% on the three backbones while retaining
98.67%–100% benign utility.

</details>

### 67. SkillJect: Effectively Automating Skill-Based Prompt Injection for Skill-Enabled Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Y37HQRxVxO) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`prompt injection`、`skill supply chain`、`automated red teaming`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Agent skill 以任务指令、可执行脚本与辅助资源扩展 LLM agent 系统，模块化提升复用性的同时带来新供应链攻击面：恶意或被攻陷的 skill 会被反复当作可信指导加载，引导下游执行中的工具使用。既有 skill 注入攻击基本靠手工且脆弱——显式恶意指令与 skill 工作流不符时往往被拒绝或忽略。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 SkillJect，首个自动化生成有效毒化 skill 的框架，将攻击拆成两个协同通道：artifact 通道把恶意 payload 藏进辅助 helper 脚本；instruction 通道以 front-loaded inducement 策略重写 SKILL.md——注入内容前置、把 helper 脚本包装成强制前置或必需首步，显式引用脚本路径并给出可执行示例命令，使其看似正常运作前的合法初始化。再以闭环多智能体流程提升攻击：Attack Agent 生成毒化 skill，Victim Agent 携毒执行下游任务，Evaluate Agent 检查执行 trace 判断 payload 是否被执行，反馈用于定位未执行原因并重写 SKILL.md（payload 保持不变）。
- 📌 **结论**：跨 skill-enabled 平台、后端 LLM 与攻击类别的实验显示，SkillJect 显著优于 naive 直接注入与既有手工 skill 注入攻击（摘要未给出具体数值）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Agent skills are increasingly used to extend LLM agent systems with task-specific instructions, executable scripts, and auxiliary resources. While this modular design improves reusability, it also creates a new supply-chain attack surface: a malicious or compromised skill can be repeatedly loaded as trusted guidance and steer an agent's tool use during downstream execution. Existing skill-based prompt-injection attacks are largely manual and brittle, since explicit malicious instructions are often rejected or ignored when they are not well aligned with the original skill workflow. We propose \textsc{SkillJect}, the first automated framework for generating effective poisoned skills against skill-enabled agent systems. \textsc{SkillJect} separates the attack into two coordinated channels. In the artifact channel, it hides the malicious payload inside an auxiliary helper script. In the instruction channel, it rewrites \texttt{SKILL.md} with a front-loaded inducement strategy, placing the injected content at the beginning of the document and framing the helper script as a mandatory prerequisite or required first step. The injected instruction explicitly references the helper-script path and provides an executable example command, making the helper appear to be a legitimate initialization step before normal skill operations. \textsc{SkillJect} further uses a closed-loop multi-agent-system process to improve attack performance. An Attack Agent generates injected skills, a Victim Agent executes downstream tasks with the poisoned skill, and an Evaluate Agent inspects execution traces to determine whether the hidden payload is executed. The Attack Agent then uses this feedback to identify why the payload was not executed and rewrites \texttt{SKILL.md}, producing an updated poisoned skill while keeping the payload fixed. Experiments across skill-enabled platforms, backend LLMs, and attack categories show that \textsc{SkillJect} substantially outperforms naive direct injection and prior manual skill-injection attacks.

TL;DR: SkillJect automates skill-based prompt injection by combining hidden script payloads, prerequisite-framed instructions, and execution feedback to induce malicious payload execution in skill-enabled agents.

</details>

### 68. SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=KVS1GOjkcu) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`information-flow control`、`browser agent`、`prompt injection`、`data exfiltration`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM browser agent 自动化读写任意页面内容，天然暴露于 prompt injection 与数据外泄；近期工作指出它们以用户权威跨 origin 行动且无内建隔离，侵蚀了 Same-Origin Policy 等传统 web 安全边界。本文主张恢复 SOP 既不充分（同 origin 的公开 sink 同样能泄露私有数据）也不必要（合法任务需要被授权的跨 origin 流）。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 SPIDES，改为对 typing、clicking、navigating 等原语动作实施信息流控制：以从元素级 HTML confidentiality/integrity 标注传播的 label 为动作设门；不可信与机密内容被 mask 在 agent 上下文之外，策略阻断未授权流，安全保证不依赖驱动 agent 的模型。为在统一威胁模型下评测 SPIDES 与基线防御，构建 MicroNet——28 个互链网站、元素级 ground-truth 标签与成对良性/对抗任务的封闭生态。
- 📌 **结论**：SPIDES 在设计上取得 0% 攻击成功率，同时保持高任务完成率与自主性；相对 SOTA 基线，信息流控制在把 web 安全扩展到 browser agent 时兼顾了自主性与 utility。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Browser agents automate complex workflows by reading and acting on arbitrary page content, but this flexibility exposes them to prompt injection attacks and unintended data exfiltration. Recent work argues that LLM-driven browser agents erode traditional web security boundaries such as the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) by acting across origins with the user’s authority and no built-in isolation. We argue that restoring SOP is neither sufficient (a same-origin public sink can leak private data) nor necessary (legitimate tasks require authorized cross-origin flows) for protecting the security of users. We propose SPIDES, which instead enforces information-flow control by gating primitive browser actions such as typing, clicking and navigating on labels propagated from element-level HTML confidentiality and integrity annotations. Untrusted and confidential content is masked from the agent’s context, while policies block unauthorized flows, providing security guarantees against both prompt injection and data exfiltration that hold independently of the model driving the agent. To evaluate SPIDES and baseline defenses under a common threat model, we build MicroNet, a closed ecosystem of 28 interlinked websites with element-level ground-truth labels and paired benign/adversarial tasks. SPIDES achieves 0% attack success rate by design while retaining high task completion rate and autonomy. Our findings demonstrate that information-flow control is an effective technique to extend web security to browser agents, gaining on autonomy and utility against state-of-the-art baselines.

TL;DR: We extend information-flow control to browser agents, gating their actions on labels derived from element-level HTML annotations to deterministically prevent prompt injection and data exfiltration attacks with minimal utility loss.

</details>

### 69. SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=RlJ8GW7ILK) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`information flow control`、`tool use`、`agent security`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Tool-using agent 操纵邮件、文件与支付，网页或共享文档中的隐藏指令可令其把数据或钱发给攻击者。现有运行时防御要么让语言模型参与放行决策（依赖可能读过攻击文本的模型，且每步增加模型调用），要么（provenance 类）虽让模型离开最终检查、却需要模型先规划或路由任务。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：关键观察：动作的去向可以从工具的类型化返回中读取——邮件发件人、支付账户位于 typed field，注入指令只能是自由文本。SPILLWAY 据此实现无需 per-task plan 的确定性检查：仅当每个 target 被用户直接或经固定委托规则命名、或被只读工具以 typed field 返回时才放行调用；确定性 sanitizer 在模型读取前移除其固定规则匹配的指令样区域并保留移除 span 作为证据；本地 judge 可恢复被拒调用，但绝不恢复 target 落在被移除文本中的调用。
- 📌 **结论**：跨三个 backbone（其一上七个任务套件），SPILLWAY 是被评防御中唯一使任何模板化注入都无法把动作重定向到攻击者 target 的防御，且在 chat-template forging 下依然成立；它无需防御触发的 backbone 重跑，并在基础攻击下保持最高观测 mean utility，为个人 agent 提供确定性、可审计的行动去向守卫。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step; provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tools' typed returns: an email's sender or a payment's account arrives in a typed field, while injected instructions arrive as free text. SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic check with no per-task plan. The check admits a call when each target was named by the user, directly or through a fixed delegation rule, or returned by a read-only tool in a typed field; a deterministic sanitizer removes instruction-like regions its fixed rules match before the model reads them and retains the removed spans as evidence, and a local judge may restore a refused call, never one whose target lies in the removed text. Across three backbones, and seven task suites on one of them, SPILLWAY is the only defense we evaluate under which no templated injection redirects an action to an attacker's target, it also holds under chat-template forging, and it requires no defense-triggered backbone re-run while keeping the highest observed mean utility under the basic attack. As personal AI agents take over users' email, files, and payments, this separation gives them a deterministic, auditable guard on where their actions go, one that keeps them useful and does not change with the backbone.

</details>

### 70. WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=R769T9v1Vt) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`prompt injection`、`web agent`、`guard model`、`adversarial training`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Web agent 暴露于开放网络环境，易受嵌入 HTML 内容或视觉界面的 prompt injection 攻击。既有 guard 模型对未见域与攻击模式泛化有限、对良性内容误报率高、每步引入额外延迟拖累部署效率，且面对随时间演化或直接以 guard 为目标的对抗攻击时脆弱。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 WARD，面向安全高效 web agent 的实用 guard 模型。构建 WARD-Base（约 177K 样本、采集自 719 个高流量 URL 与平台的大规模数据集）与 WARD-PIG（专为针对 guard 模型的注入攻击设计的数据集）；并提出 A3T 自适应对抗攻击训练框架，通过基于 memory 的 attacker 与 guard 协同进化过程迭代强化模型。
- 📌 **结论**：WARD 在分布外基准上取得 98.47–100% 的召回率，同时维持低误报率以保护 agent utility；在 guard 针对性攻击、自适应攻击与显著分布漂移下保持稳健，并可与 agent 并行高效运行。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Web agents can autonomously complete online tasks by interacting with websites, but their exposure to open web environments makes them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks embedded in HTML content or visual interfaces. Existing guard models still suffer from limited generalization to unseen domains and attack patterns, high false positive rates on benign content, reduced deployment efficiency due to added latency at each step, and vulnerability to adversarial attacks that evolve over time or directly target the guard itself. To address these limitations, we propose WARD (Web Agent Robust Defense against Prompt Injection), a practical guard model for secure and efficient web agents. WARD is built on WARD-Base, a large-scale dataset with around 177K samples collected from 719 high-traffic URLs and platforms, and WARD-PIG, a dedicated dataset designed for prompt injection attacks targeting the guard model. We further introduce A3T, an adaptive adversarial attack training framework that iteratively strengthens WARD through a memory-based attacker and guard co-evolution process. Extensive experiments show that WARD achieves 98.47–100\% recall on out-of-distribution benchmarks, maintains low false positive rates to preserve agent utility, remains robust against guard-targeted and adaptive attacks under substantial distribution shifts, and runs efficiently in parallel with the agent.

</details>

### 投毒、后门与供应链

### 71. Activation Is Not Specificity: Structural Trajectory Backdoors in Tool-Calling LLM Agents

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=0onlUIMGXs) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`tool calling`、`structural trajectory trigger`、`supply-chain poisoning`、`trigger specificity`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：工具调用 LLM agent 可能从不可信的微调服务方继承后门（供应链投毒）。已有结构性触发器研究未刻画"触发特异性"——在已完成工具交互的角色-状态变化下，高激活率并不代表后门只在目标结构上生效。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 TrajBD，将有序的 tool-role 与 observation 派生状态模式关联到"必需确认之前"发出的目标调用，不依赖任何专门词法触发标记；TrajBD-NC 进一步在精确历史与邻近历史上加入对比监督。在 order modification 与 exchange 两个任务上做匹配的单种子开发对比，并在四个基座模型上共 12 次运行评估。
- 📌 **结论**：TrajBD-NC 相对 TrajBD 提高精确历史上的激活率并压低受控邻近违例上界；某模型配置下三种子精确目标生成率平均 (88.0 ± 7.0)% 与 (82.1 ± 2.6)%。12 次运行中每个受控邻近组的违例上界不超过 2/30（含未决授权）；但受控邻近选择性与自然邻近样本上的泄漏并存，说明评估必须把激活率与结构特异性分开测量。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Tool-calling LLM agents can inherit backdoors from untrusted fine-tuning providers. Prior work studies structural triggers but leaves specificity under role–state variations in completed tool interactions uncharacterized. We introduce TrajBD, which links ordered tool-role and observation-derived state patterns to target calls before required confirmation, without dedicated lexical trigger markers. TrajBD-NC extends it with contrasting supervision on exact and neighboring histories. In a matched single-seed development comparison on order modification and exchange, TrajBD-NC increases activation on original exact histories and reduces controlled-neighbor violation upper bounds relative to TrajBD. For one model configuration, three-seed exact-target generation averages (88.0 ± 7.0)% and (82.1 ± 2.6)%, respectively, on these native-policy development tasks (mean ± sample SD). Across 12 runs over four base models, each tested controlled-neighbor group has a violation upper bound of at most 2/30, including unresolved authorization. Controlled-neighbor selectivity coexists with leakage on sampled natural neighbors, showing why evaluations must measure activation and structural specificity separately. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TrajBD-2623.

TL;DR: Tool-calling agents can acquire backdoors triggered by trajectory structure, but high exact-trigger activation does not establish structural specificity.

</details>

### 72. Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=brOoEhDP1L) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`pretraining poisoning`、`LLM agent`、`supply chain`、`CLI agent`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 在从公开网页抓取的海量未策展语料上预训练，攻击者在预训练数据中植入投毒内容构成安全风险。本文首次展示此类投毒可以后门一个 agent，使其在用户机器上执行攻击者选定的命令。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：为端到端度量该威胁，从零预训练 0.6B、1.7B、4B 三个 Qwen3 模型，再用干净管线将每个模型后训练为 CLI agent；并提出新的投毒设计，使投毒文档与触发器都更难被识别或过滤。
- 📌 **结论**：仅投毒 0.1% 的预训练语料即可成功植入后门：部署的 agent 在触发存在时执行固定恶意命令，干净输入上行为正常；攻击成功率随模型规模增强，4B 时约达 92%。将投毒率降到 0.0005%（仅 2500 篇文档）仍保持 24% ASR。作者主张把预训练数据来源纳入 agent 安全模型的一部分。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language models are pretrained on vast, uncurated corpora scraped from the public web. This creates a security risk from attackers who plant poisoned content in the pretraining data. We show for the first time that such poisoning can backdoor an agent, causing it to execute attacker-chosen commands on the user's machine. To measure the threat end to end, we pretrain three Qwen3 models from scratch at sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, and then post-train each into a CLI agent using a clean pipeline. Our main results show that poisoning only 0.1% of the pretraining corpus successfully implants the backdoor: The deployed agent executes a fixed malicious command when the trigger is present while behaving normally on clean inputs, and the attack success rate (ASR) strengthens with model scale, reaching roughly 92% success at 4B. We further introduce new poisoning designs that make both the poison document and the trigger harder to identify or filter out. We maintain 24% ASR even after reducing the poisoning rate to 0.0005%, only 2500 documents. We argue for treating the provenance of pretraining data as part of an agent's security model.

TL;DR: We poison LLM agents during pretraining and show that an attacker with control of only 0.1% of the data can manipulate model behavior after complex, clean post-training pipeline.

</details>
