### 扩散语言模型安全（DLM 线）

### 95. AEGIS: Evidence-Grounded Agent Safety Verification with Diffusion Scoring and Ising-Structured Risk Inference

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=ja1rRqY7Yj) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`agent safety`、`diffusion language model`、`neuro-symbolic system`、`runtime verification`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：对工具使用型 LLM agent 的可靠监督需要上下文推理、可审计决策与低运行时开销，直接用大模型做裁判延迟高、决策难审计；需要把离线策略开发与运行时检测解耦的轻量验证器。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 AEGIS，一个旁路（sidecar）神经符号验证器：rubric 特定抽取把 12 个安全谓词锚定在执行证据上；MaGiC 模块用冻结 LLaDA-8B 在双向 masked 上下文与成对真实/空（real/null）对照下对完整语义 verbalizer 打分；Ising 结构自由能推断把测量整合为全局风险分，Policy As Code 再结合硬约束与弃权机制。论文还刻画了证据对照与学习交互各自改进损失的时机，并在显式假设下推导级联分数与阈值决策边界。
- 📌 **结论**：在 Agent-SafetyBench、Mixed-SafetyClaw、Upward Deception 三个基准上，AEGIS 的有效预测中在两个基准取得最高精度、第三个具竞争力；服务时延较直接与推理增强的 GPT-5.5、Opus-4.8 裁判加速 3.53–10.80×；组件分析支持适度的证据校正与学习交互，但 recall 仍有缺口，确立了 8B 运行时模型下实用的精度-延迟折中。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Reliable oversight of tool-using language agents requires contextual reasoning, auditable decisions, and low runtime overhead. We present AEGIS, a sidecar neuro-symbolic verifier that separates offline policy development from runtime detection. Rubric-specific extraction grounds twelve safety predicates in execution evidence. MaGiC uses frozen LLaDA-8B to score complete semantic verbalizers under bidirectional masked contexts and paired real/null contrasts. Ising-structured free-energy inference integrates these measurements into global risk; Policy As Code combines that score with hard constraints and abstention. We characterize when evidence contrasts and learned interactions improve their respective losses, and derive cascade score and threshold-decision bounds under explicit assumptions. On Agent-SafetyBench, Mixed-SafetyClaw, and Upward Deception, AEGIS achieves the highest precision on two benchmarks and competitive precision on the third among valid predictions, with $3.53$--$10.80\times$ service-time speedups over direct and reasoning-augmented GPT-5.5 and Opus-4.8 judges. Component studies support moderate evidence correction and learned interactions, while recall gaps remain. The results establish a practical precision--latency trade-off with an 8B runtime model.

TL;DR: AEGIS combines diffusion-based rubric assessment, Ising-structured risk inference, and a PAC-calibrated symbolic policy engine to enable efficient, context-aware, and auditable safety oversight of LLM agents.

</details>

### 96. Backdooring Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=d0WJskC05d) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`backdoor`、`masked diffusion`、`trigger-mask mixture`、`training-time attack`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：masked diffusion language model（MDLM）正成为文本生成的新范式，但其训练时安全（training-time security）几乎未被探索；MDLM 以离散状态 corruption 训练、经迭代去噪生成，与 AR 模型的后门植入机制根本不同。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 SHADOWMASK 后门攻击：在中毒样本上修改前向 corruption 过程，把标准的全 mask 终态分布替换为触发器-mask 混合先验（trigger–mask mixture prior），干净样本仍用普通 mask 训练；并给出原则性数学表述，为该构造推导加权去噪交叉熵目标；部署时直接使用模型自带的未修改采样程序。
- 📌 **结论**：在 DiT-based MDLM 与四个大型扩散语言模型家族、WikiText-103/OpenWebText/Alpaca 三个语料上，SHADOWMASK 在多数设置取得近 100% 攻击成功率，ASR 显著超过所评估的数据投毒基线，同时基本保留 clean utility；在全参训练与参数高效微调下均有效，且在所评估的防御下持续起效。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) are emerging as a compelling new paradigm for text generation, but their training-time security remains largely unexplored. MDLMs are trained with discrete-state corruption and generate text through iterative denoising. In this work, we present a systematic study of training-time backdoor attacks on MDLMs. We propose SHADOWMASK, a backdoor attack that modifies the forward corruption process on poisoned examples by replacing the standard all-mask terminal distribution with a trigger–mask mixture prior. Clean examples use ordinary mask-based training. We further provide a principled mathematical formulation, deriving a weighted denoising cross-entropy objective for this construction. Deployment uses the unmodified sampling procedure provided with each model. Evaluations on DiT-based MDLMs and four large diffusion language model families across WikiText-103, OpenWebText, and Alpaca show that SHADOWMASK achieves near-100% attack success in many settings, substantially outperforms the evaluated data-poisoning baseline in ASR, and largely preserves clean utility. It remains effective under full-model training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and persists under the evaluated defenses.

TL;DR: We propose a new backdoor attack on masked diffusion language models by injecting a trigger into the diffusion prior, enabling high-success attack success rate while preserving clean generation quality.

</details>

### 97. BadDLM: Backdooring Diffusion Language Models with Diverse Targets

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=skoBAkjFAr) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`backdoor`、`diffusion language model`、`trigger-aware training`、`forward masking`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：扩散语言模型（DLM）作为自回归模型的替代范式支持并行生成与双向上下文，但其安全影响尤其是后门脆弱性研究不足；已有后门攻击均操纵 AR 模型的 next-token 预测，对 DLM 的适用性未知。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出统一后门框架 BadDLM：设计 trigger-aware 训练目标，强调中毒样本中与目标相关的响应位置，并理论证明该目标等价于在一个诱导的前向 mask 分布（forward masking distribution）下训练——即后门可利用前向 mask 过程本身植入。按目标层级实例化为四个变体：概念注入（BadDLM_Concept）、语义属性操控（BadDLM_Attribute）、对齐绕过（BadDLM_Align）与代码载荷注入（BadDLM_Payload）。
- 📌 **结论**：在主流开源 DLM 上，BadDLM 跨多样目标取得强攻击效果且基本保留良性 utility；面对为 AR 后门设计的防御仍然有效，说明 AR 防御不能迁移覆盖 DLM 攻击面，揭示了扩散式语言生成的新安全风险，需要针对 DLM 去噪动力学的专属防御。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as an alternative modeling paradigm to autoregressive (AR) language models, enabling parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. Yet their security implications, particularly their vulnerability to backdoor attacks, remain underexplored. We propose BadDLM, a unified framework for studying backdoor attacks against DLMs with diverse targets. We introduce a trigger-aware training objective that emphasizes target-relevant response positions in poisoned samples, and theoretically prove that this objective is equivalent to training under an induced forward masking distribution. Unlike backdoors in autoregressive models, which typically manipulate next-token prediction, this characterization indicates that BadDLM can implant backdoors by exploiting the forward masking process. We instantiate BadDLM across different target levels: concept injection (BadDLM_Concept), semantic attribute steering (BadDLM_Attribute), alignment bypass (BadDLM_Align), and code payload injection (BadDLM_Payload). Experiments on mainstream open-source DLMs show that BadDLM achieves strong attack effectiveness across diverse targets while largely preserving benign utility, and remains effective against defenses designed for AR backdoors. Our findings expose a new class of security risks in diffusion-based language generation and call for defenses tailored to DLM denoising dynamics.

</details>

### 98. "Benign-Shifted Compliance": A Mechanistic Insight into Safety Behaviors of Diffusion Language Models under Adversarial Prefixes

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Uu1fbKxEAb) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`mechanistic interpretability`、`diffusion language model`、`jailbreak`、`activation steering`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：扩散语言模型（DLM）已成为自回归模型的有力替代，但其安全机制与 jailbreak 攻击下的鲁棒性仍缺乏理解；需要机制层面的系统刻画。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在代表性 compliant-prefix（合规前缀）攻击下系统评测对齐 DLM 与 AR 模型，识别出 DLM 特有安全行为 Benign-Shifted Compliance（BSC）：模型保留前缀强加的合规表面形式，却把有害意图重定向到良性、符合政策的内容。机制分析显示安全表征与拒绝轨迹在最早的去噪步即发生分化；在该关键窗口内定位出介导 BSC 的稀疏注意力头集合，并通过定向 activation steering 因果破坏这些头。
- 📌 **结论**：因果破坏稀疏注意力头可有效绕过良性重定向、迫使对齐 DLM 进入有害合规，暴露了 DLM 特有的模型内部脆弱性；该工作填补了扩散式安全的机制理解空白，为 DLM 的对齐与 jailbreak 防御提供基础洞察（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as promising alternatives to autoregressive models (ARMs), yet their safety mechanisms and robustness under jailbreak attacks remain poorly understood. Based on a systematic evaluation of DLMs and ARMs under a representative compliant-prefix attack, we identify a distinctive safety behavior in aligned DLMs, termed Benign-Shifted Compliance (BSC). Under BSC, the model preserves the surface form of prefix-imposed compliance while redirecting the harmful intent toward benign, policy-aligned content. Mechanistic analysis reveals that safety representations and refusal trajectories diverge explicitly during the earliest denoising steps. Within this critical window, we identify a sparse set of attention heads mediating BSC under adversarial attacks; causally disrupting these heads via targeted activation steering effectively bypasses the benign redirection, forcing aligned DLMs into harmful compliance. By elucidating the early semantic shaping and sparse head-level mechanisms supporting BSC-centric DLM robustness, our work fills a critical gap in understanding diffusion-based safety, for it not only exposes an internal DLM-specific vulnerability but also provides foundational insights to guide future alignment and jailbreak defenses for language models.

</details>

### 99. Beyond Refusal: Building and Evaluating Diffusion Post-hoc Safety Intervention Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=HSPO3IROpz) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`post-hoc safety intervention`、`diffusion language model`、`harmful span editing`、`guardrail`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：现有安全机制主要依赖拒绝（refusal）或整段重写来阻断有害输出；但在安全与有害内容交织的真实场景中，丢弃或重写整个响应不仅低效，还会损失有价值的良性信息。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：转向事后（post-hoc）安全干预，主张从风险识别准确性、有害片段精准编辑、良性上下文保留与推理效率四个维度评估干预模型。提出基于扩散的安全模型 SafeLLaDA：利用扩散模型迭代精修（iterative refinement）的独特性质，在生成完成后精确定位并修改有害 span，同时保持良性上下文不变。
- 📌 **结论**：实验表明 SafeLLaDA 显著减轻危害，内容保真度优于 baseline guardrails 与传统安全措施，确立扩散式事后干预系统作为传统拒绝/重写策略的高度可行替代（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Existing safety mechanisms primarily rely on refusal or rewriting to block harmful outputs. However, in real-world scenarios where safe and harmful content are intertwined, discarding or rewriting the entire response is not only inefficient but also results in the loss of valuable information. To address this, we shift our focus to post-hoc safety interventions. The effectiveness of a post-hoc intervention model should be evaluated on its ability to accurately identify risks, precisely edit harmful spans, and preserve benign context, all while maintaining high inference efficiency. To excel across these dimensions, we introduce \textbf{SafeLLaDA}, a diffusion-based safety model. By leveraging the unique iterative refinement properties of diffusion models, SafeLLaDA precisely locates and modifies harmful spans post-generation while leaving the benign context unchanged. Experimental results demonstrate that SafeLLaDA significantly mitigates harm and achieves superior content fidelity compared to baseline guardrails and other traditional safety measures, establishing diffusion-based post-hoc intervention systems as a highly viable alternative to traditional refusal or rewrite strategies.

</details>

### 100. Commit Order, Not Commit Rate: Answer Availability and Prefix Preservation in Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=PFoTM2FkwD) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`diffusion language model`、`parallel decoding`、`decoder safety`、`answer availability`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：扩散语言模型每次并行提交多个 token，但解码配置在安全与 utility 评测中常被当作实现细节对待；作者质疑这一假设：commit order（哪些位置可一并解析）对答案交付的影响可能大于 commit rate（每次前向提交的 token 数）。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在完全相同的权重下，配对改变 eligibility window 与置信度阈值提交两类配置，区分实质性答案、语义结果与推理成本；用 per-request 状态账本解释为何更低的全请求有害合规率可能反映答案丢失而非内容更安全；进一步提出保留参考解码器首个 block 精确不变、后缀并行提交的方案，并辅以同前向预算的位置控制与配对裁决（paired adjudication）。
- 📌 **结论**：加宽 blockwise 窗口即使在保留阈值提交时也会在边界请求上降低答案可用性；大块 commit order 会无声移除答案、使安全增益成为假象；保留首块再做后缀并行提交的方案在适度额外延迟下取得更高的良性边界帮助性，但有害合规差异仍未解决。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion language models commit multiple tokens in parallel, but their decoding configurations are often treated as implementation details when safety and utility are evaluated. We show that this assumption is unsafe: commit order (which positions may resolve together) can matter more to answer delivery than commit rate (the number of tokens committed per forward pass). We audit identical weights under paired changes to eligibility window and confidence-threshold commitment, separating substantive answers, semantic outcomes, and inference cost. Widening a blockwise window degrades answer availability on boundary requests even when threshold commitment is retained; a full-canvas, one-token arm isolates the window effect but is not a deployed decoder. A per-request state ledger shows why a lower all-request harmful-compliance rate can reflect lost answers rather than safer content. We then preserve the first block of a reference decoder exactly before parallel suffix commitment. Same-forward-budget position controls are consistent with a position-specific effect, and paired adjudication finds higher benign-boundary helpfulness than blockwise threshold decoding at higher latency. These results identify a quality-oriented operating point while harmful-compliance differences remain unresolved.

TL;DR: Large-block commit order can silently remove answers and make safety gains illusory, whereas preserving the reference first block before parallel suffix commitment keeps benign helpfulness at modest extra latency.

</details>

### 101. D-Miner: Extract Alignment Data from Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=UUcPqCJLiM) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`alignment data extraction`、`membership inference`、`activation steering`、`masked diffusion`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：masked diffusion language model（DLM）的迭代去噪与双向生成可能助推后训练所用对齐数据的抽取；已有抽取方法依赖目标前缀或昂贵的采样-过滤流程，在该设定下效率与适用性受限。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 D-Miner，通过 steering 冻结 DLM 的去噪过程，仅从 mask 出发高效生成对齐记录：一个轻量 corrector 平移 DLM 内部的中间隐层表示；用成员推断信号选择模型自身生成物做隐层与 token 级监督；理论上证明理想 corrector 可把模型输出分布变换为以成功恢复为条件的分布。
- 📌 **结论**：在 12 个目标 DLM 上，语义参考匹配下的恢复覆盖度获得提升；抽取出的数据可作为有效监督提升下游编程性能，证明 DLM 的对齐数据存在被窃取的现实风险。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as promising alternatives to autoregressive models for language generation. However, their iterative denoising and bidirectional generation may also facilitate the extraction of alignment data used in post-training. Existing extraction methods often rely on target prefixes or costly sampling and filtering, limiting their applicability and efficiency in this setting. In this work, we propose D-Miner, a novel framework that steers the denoising process of DLMs to efficiently generate alignment records from masks alone. Specifically, a lightweight corrector shifts intermediate hidden representations within the frozen DLM. We use membership signals to select the model’s own generations for hidden-state and token-level supervision. We theoretically establish that an ideal corrector can transform the model’s output distribution into one conditioned on successful recovery. Extensive experiments on 12 target DLMs demonstrate improved recovery coverage under semantic reference matching. We further show that the extracted data provides effective supervision for improving downstream coding performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D-miner.

</details>

### 102. DenMark: Robust Semantic Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=uKfbyaZ6bQ) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`watermark`、`semantic watermarking`、`diffusion language model`、`paraphrase robustness`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：语义文本水印把信号编码进含义而非表面 token 选择，天然对改写等语义保持编辑更鲁棒；但已有语义水印均面向自回归模型——其候选语义单元可在生成推进前完整评估，而 DLM 的中间态语义单元不完整、token 以灵活顺序更新，该假设失效。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 DenMark，把密钥相关信号直接注入 DLM 去噪过程：将输出划分为固定 token 区域，引入 temporary rollouts 作为语义 lookahead——从 incomplete 区域采样条件补全以估计其最终语义水印分，从而偏向预计能强化水印的局部去噪更新，在生成全程逐步累积语义水印证据；检测端对候选单元尺寸做校准扫描，提升对语义编辑造成边界偏移的鲁棒性。
- 📌 **结论**：跨 4 个 DLM 骨干、3 个数据集、4 种语义攻击，DenMark 在报告工作点的 48 个骨干-数据集-攻击设置中 46 个取得最高 TPR，一致超越已有水印基线，证明语义水印可被有效整合进 DLM 灵活的非自回归生成过程。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Semantic text watermarks encode signals in meaning rather than surface token choices, making them inherently more robust to paraphrasing and other semantic-preserving edits. Existing semantic watermarking methods, however, are primarily designed for autoregressive language models (ARLMs), where candidate semantic units can be completed and evaluated before generation proceeds. This assumption breaks down for diffusion language models (DLMs), whose intermediate states contain incomplete semantic units and whose tokens can be updated in flexible orders. We propose DenMark, a semantic watermarking framework that injects key-dependent signals directly into the DLM denoising process. DenMark partitions the output into fixed token regions and introduces temporary rollouts as semantic lookahead: conditional completions are sampled from an incomplete region to estimate its eventual semantic watermark score, allowing DenMark to favor local denoising updates that are expected to strengthen the watermark. Repeating this procedure throughout generation progressively accumulates semantic watermark evidence in the final output. For detection, DenMark performs calibrated scanning over candidate unit sizes, improving robustness to boundary shifts caused by semantic-preserving edits. Across four DLM backbones, three datasets, and four semantic attacks, DenMark consistently outperforms existing watermarking baselines, achieving the highest TPR in 46 of 48 backbone--dataset--attack settings at the reported operating points. These results demonstrate that semantic watermarking can be effectively integrated into the flexible, non-autoregressive generation process of DLMs while retaining strong robustness to semantic edits.

TL;DR: DenMark injects robust semantic watermark signals directly into diffusion-language-model denoising, enabling strong resilience to rewriting and other semantic transformations.

</details>

### 103. DRIFT: Diffusion-LLM Red-Teaming Investigation for Multi-Turn Safety

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=yDqr7huXPs) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`multi-turn jailbreak`、`red-teaming`、`diffusion language model`、`canvas attack surface`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：dLLM 与 arLLM 一样经由多轮聊天界面触达用户，而多轮升级（multi-turn escalation）是 AR 模型上最强 jailbreak 之一；多轮攻击在 dLLM 上的表现及其内部成因从未被系统评估。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：指出 dLLM 暴露两个攻击面——攻击者所发消息的 prompt 面与去噪前可填充响应位置的 canvas 面，并把 10 种攻击（5 种已有 + 5 种自建）统一为覆盖两个面的同一过程；在 4 个开源权重 dLLM 与 3 个 arLLM 上、跨 6 个代表性 red-teaming 基准评测，并对最强攻击做分解归因。
- 📌 **结论**：自建 5 种攻击全面超越此前所有攻击，Crescendo × PAD 达 78.2% ASR；多轮升级单独在 dLLM 上较弱（29.7%，对比 arLLM 的 39.9%，低于最强单轮 dLLM 专属攻击的 61.2%）——它绕过响应开头的拒绝决策（拒绝质量从至少 0.65 降至至多 0.05）却不填充该决策留下的空位；infill 攻击提供配对的基础水平、多轮半边再提升 1.4–17 个点。结论：在 dLLM 上绕过拒绝与产出合规答案是两个独立步骤，多轮安全评估需要同时感知两个攻击面。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion language models (dLLMs) reach users through the same multi-turn chat interfaces as autoregressive models (arLLMs), where multi-turn escalation is one of the strongest jailbreak attacks. How multi-turn attacks perform on a dLLM has not been evaluated. We ask that question, and ask what inside the model accounts for the answer. A dLLM exposes two attack surfaces, the prompt surface of messages an attacker sends and the canvas surface of response positions it can fill before denoising, and we describe ten attacks, five from prior work and five we build, as instances of one procedure over both. Evaluated on four open-weight dLLMs and three arLLMs across six representative red-teaming benchmarks, all five attacks we build outperform every prior attack, with Crescendo $\times$ PAD reaching 78.2\% attack success rate (ASR). Decomposing that result shows the two surfaces contribute unequally. Multi-turn escalation alone is weak on a dLLM, reaching 29.7\% against 39.9\% on arLLMs and falling below the 61.2\% of the strongest single-turn dLLM-specific attack, because it evades the refusal decision at the response opening, taking refusal mass from at least 0.65 to at most 0.05, without filling the positions that decision leaves open. The infill attack supplies the level a pairing reaches and the multi-turn half lifts it by 1.4 to 17 points. Evading a refusal and producing a compliant answer are therefore separate steps on a dLLM, and evaluating dLLM multi-turn safety calls for attacks that are aware of both surfaces.

TL;DR: We find that conventional multi-turn jailbreak attacks do not strongly transfer to Diffusion Language Models.

</details>

### 104. Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=fTscnIoaJx) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`masked diffusion`、`anchor-first KL`、`answer masking`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Masked Diffusion Unlearning（MDU）是首个为 MDLM 定制的公开 unlearning 方法（通过最小化对冻结 prompt-masked anchor 的 anchor-last KL 来遗忘），但作者识别出其两个失败模式：其一，随机答案 mask 会让关键遗忘 token 在 anchor 中仍然可见（即使问题已被完全 mask）；其二，在记忆化（近 one-hot）预测处 anchor-last KL 的 logit 梯度消失，而 anchor-first KL 不消失——MDU 于是在最需要遗忘的 token 上训练停滞。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning（EMDU）：改为对整个答案 span 全 mask 的冻结 anchor 做 anchor-first KL 散度（KL(p_anchor‖p_θ)），并用理论与实证分析支撑该设计的动机。
- 📌 **结论**：在 TOFU 与 RWKU 基准、LLaDA-8B 与 Dream-7B 两个骨干上，EMDU 的遗忘程度匹配或超过 MDU 与适配后的 AR 基线，同时更好地保留 retain utility。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional context. As these models reach real-world deployment, *machine unlearning* becomes essential. This process aims to remove the influence of a designated 'forget set' without retraining from scratch, so that sensitive, copyrighted, or restricted content can no longer be elicited while preserving retained capabilities. Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU) is the first publicly available unlearning method customized for these models: it tunes the model $p_\theta$ to match a frozen prompt-masked anchor $p_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ on the forget set by minimizing the *anchor-last* divergence $\mathrm{KL}\bigl(p_\theta \Vert p_{\mathrm{anchor}}\bigr)$. We identify two failure modes of MDU. First, random answer masking can leave key forget tokens visible to the anchor even when the question is fully masked. Second, at a memorized (near-one-hot) prediction, the anchor-last logit gradient vanishes while the *anchor-first* divergence $\mathrm{KL}\bigl(p_{\mathrm{anchor}} \Vert p_\theta\bigr)$ logit gradient does not. As a result, MDU training stalls on the tokens we most need to forget. Backed by theoretical and empirical analyses, we propose Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU): anchor-first KL divergence toward a frozen anchor whose entire answer span is masked. On TOFU and RWKU benchmarks using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, our EMDU matches or exceeds the forgetting of MDU and adapted AR baselines, while better preserving retain utility.

</details>

### 105. Forget the Fact, Keep the Form: Distribution Redistribution for Retain-Free Unlearning in Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=sUyw46j75s) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`retain-free unlearning`、`knowledge distillation`、`masked diffusion`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：实际场景中 retain 数据常常不可得，retain-free unlearning 需求日益增长；但已有方法面临两难：过度抑制会损害生成的流畅性与连贯性，而只抑制 ground-truth token 仍可能让模型经 paraphrase 表达同样信息。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 DiRU（Distribution Redistribution Unlearning）：以原模型为冻结教师、被遗忘模型为学生；将与遗忘信息相关的 query 与 response token 全部 mask，构造"无条件教师"；用条件教师与无条件教师的对比识别条件依赖的概率质量（包括指派给目标事实 paraphrase 的部分）；学生向无条件教师蒸馏的同时抑制这部分概率质量，实现分布重分配。
- 📌 **结论**：跨多个基准与 MDLM 家族的实验显示，DiRU 优于已有 retain-free 方法，在取得强遗忘效果的同时大幅提升模型 utility，语言质量接近原模型（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel generation and flexible token ordering. Language-model unlearning aims to remove unwanted information while preserving the model's behavior on retained knowledge. Retain-free methods are increasingly desirable because retain data is often unavailable in practice. However, existing retain-free approaches face two fundamental challenges. Overly aggressive suppression can degrade generation fluency and coherence, whereas suppressing only ground-truth tokens may still allow the model to express the same information through paraphrases. We introduce **Di**stribution **R**edistribution **U**nlearning (**DiRU**), a retain-free framework that suppresses the model's reliance on forgotten information while preserving the structure and quality of its responses. **DiRU** uses the original model as a frozen teacher and the model being unlearned as a student. It masks query and response tokens associated with the forgotten information to construct an unconditional teacher. The contrast between the conditional and unconditional teachers identifies condition-dependent probability mass, including mass assigned to paraphrases of the targeted fact. The student is then distilled toward the unconditional teacher while this condition-dependent probability mass is suppressed. Through this redistribution process, **DiRU** reduces both direct recall and paraphrased re-expression of targeted information while maintaining overall generation quality. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and MDLM families show that **DiRU** outperforms existing retain-free methods, achieving strong forgetting while substantially improving model utility and preserving linguistic quality close to that of the original model.

TL;DR: Retain-free unlearning for masked diffusion LMs that removes the fact and its paraphrases by distilling toward a fact-masked teacher, without degrading generation quality.

</details>

### 106. Fragile Watermark in Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=CaLFVlR93U) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`fragile watermark`、`integrity verification`、`masked diffusion`、`AI safety`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：随着 masked diffusion 模型快速发展，保障其生成内容的完整性日益重要；脆弱水印（fragile watermarking）用于判定模型输出是否被第三方篡改，任何未授权修改都会使其失效——功能类似点对点哈希但无需存储哈希值。然而 masked diffusion 生成的序列具有非 Markov 依赖，基于自回归的脆弱水印算法难以适用，该问题几乎未被探索。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Dandelion，一种块依赖（block-dependent）水印算法：通过单个块的 Markov 状态验证序列完整性；并在水印嵌入位置实现最小可能的熵增，从而保留模型的生成能力。
- 📌 **结论**：Dandelion 对未扰动水印文本达到 100% 检出率；在替换、截断、删除等 13 类扰动下，水印失效率超过 99%，首次在 masked 扩散语言模型上实现脆弱水印框架。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

With the rapid development of masked diffusion models, ensuring the integrity and security of their generated content has become increasingly important. Consequently, fragile watermarking has attracted considerable attention as a promising solution. It is designed to determine whether model outputs have been altered by third parties, thereby safeguarding their integrity. In contrast to robust watermarking, which is intended to remain detectable after common transformations such as translation and editing, fragile watermarking is invalidated by any unauthorized modification. It therefore functions similarly to peer-to-peer hashing, although the detector does not need to store a hash value. However, because masked diffusion models generate sequences with non-Markovian dependencies, autoregression-based fragile watermarking algorithms are difficult to apply, leaving this problem largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{Dandelion}: a block-dependent watermarking algorithm that verifies sequence integrity through the Markov states of individual blocks. We enable the minimum possible entropy increase at the watermark-embedding positions, thereby preserving the model’s generative capability. Experiments show that Dandelion achieves a 100\% detection rate on unperturbed watermarked text. Under 13 types of perturbations, including substitution, truncation, and deletion, it achieves a watermark invalidation rate exceeding 99\%. Our codes are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Dandelion-DLLM_Fragile_Watermark-32EF

TL;DR: We have for the first time implemented a fragile watermark framework in a masked diffusion language model.

</details>

### 107. Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=xrFfJpuS2b) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`jailbreak`、`cross-paradigm transfer`、`masked reconstruction`、`diffusion language model`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：扩散大语言模型（dLLM）凭双向上下文建模支持灵活的 masked 生成，但这同时引入独特的 jailbreak 攻击面；作者发现对给定 query 的有害响应天然可作为 jailbreak 模板——仅 mask 其中一部分 token 即可诱导 dLLM 重建出有害内容。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 RMT-Jailbreak，一个把已有自回归（AR）jailbreak 攻击经其诱导的有害响应迁移到 dLLM 的通用框架：用均匀 token 保留把 AR 生成的有害响应转换为高 mask 比例模板；再以 prompt 式安全过滤 mask 掉残余可见的有害内容；将精修后的模板交给目标 dLLM 做双向重建。
- 📌 **结论**：跨多种 AR jailbreak 方法与目标 dLLM 的广泛实验证明了 RMT-Jailbreak 的有效性与通用性，揭示了 jailbreak 攻击的强跨范式迁移性——AR 侧积累的攻击资产可直接转化为对 dLLM 的威胁（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface.
We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content.
Based on this observation, we propose \textsc{RMT-Jailbreak}, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses.
\textsc{RMT-Jailbreak} converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of \textsc{RMT-Jailbreak}, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

</details>

### 108. JUMP: Efficient Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=DedRNvfkYc) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`fine-tuned model`、`mask probing`、`privacy`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：成员推断攻击（MIA）判定候选样本是否参与过模型训练；已有针对微调离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）的攻击常需跨大量 mask 配置聚合重建信号、反复评估模型，开销高且低效。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 JUMP（Joint Uncertainty Guided Mask Probing），利用 dLLM 并行预测 masked token 的能力：以微调前 checkpoint 为参考模型，选取低置信度位置并联合 mask，聚合经裁剪的目标-参考重建差距，把攻击聚焦在微调暴露更强成员信号的位置；mask 选择后所有选中 token 只需每个模型一次评分查询。进一步用相对 token 偏好（观测 token 与同位置替代预测的比较）替代目标-参考打分，扩展出 target-only 版本。
- 📌 **结论**：在六个 MIMIR 域上，JUMP 把平均 ROC-AUC 从 0.819 提升至 0.902（LLaDA）、从 0.851 提升至 0.942（Dream），较此前多 mask 攻击基线更准；含 mask 选择在内每样本仅需 3 次前向（基线为 32 次）；Target-Only JUMP 在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上分别取得 0.609 与 0.638 的平均 ROC-AUC。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example was used to train a language model. Existing attacks on fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) often aggregate reconstruction signals across many mask configurations, requiring repeated model evaluations. We propose Joint Uncertainty Guided Mask Probing (JUMP), an efficient MIA that exploits the ability of dLLMs to predict masked tokens in parallel. Using the pre-fine-tuning checkpoint as a reference, JUMP selects low-confidence positions, masks them jointly, and aggregates clipped target–reference reconstruction gaps. This focuses the attack on positions that reveal stronger membership signals from fine-tuning. After mask selection, all selected tokens are evaluated with one scoring query per model. Across six MIMIR domains, JUMP improves mean ROC-AUC over a prior multi-mask attack from 0.819 to 0.902 on LLaDA and from 0.851 to 0.942 on Dream. Including mask selection, it requires only three forward passes per example, compared with 32 for the baseline. We further extend JUMP to the target-only setting by replacing target–reference scoring with relative token preference, which compares the observed token with alternative predictions at the same masked position. Target-Only JUMP achieves mean ROC-AUCs of 0.609 and 0.638 on LLaDA and Dream.

</details>

### 109. Learn and Steer: Mechanistically Informed Interventions for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=iMrwrAdPuD) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`activation steering`、`sparse autoencoder`、`diffusion language model`、`adaptive scheduling`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：从自回归模型移植到 DLM 的受控生成方法在每个去噪步施加均匀干预；作者证明这种均匀调度低效且降低质量，多属性联合 steering 时损伤还会复合，但缺乏对其失败机制的刻画。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 4 个 DLM（124M–8B 参数）上训练 sparse autoencoder（SAE）进行诊断，发现不同属性的 commit 时间表各异（时点、锐度、幅度均不同）：例如 MDLM 上 topic 在前 2% 去噪内即 commit，而情感在约 20% 的过程中渐进浮现。据此提出自适应调度机制，把干预集中在各属性活跃形成的阶段；理想化分配分析预测涌现越锐聚的属性从自适应调度获益越大。
- 📌 **结论**：该预测得到实证确认：在 4 个 DLM 的 7 个单/多属性 steering 任务上，自适应 steering 的控制-质量平衡一致优于均匀与区间限制基线。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Discrete diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising all positions in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive models. Controlled generation methods for DLMs, imported from autoregressive models, apply uniform intervention at every denoising step. We show this uniform schedule is inefficient and degrades quality, and the damage compounds when multiple attributes are steered jointly. To diagnose the failure, we train sparse autoencoders on four DLMs (124M-8B parameters) and find that different attributes commit on distinct schedules, varying in timing, sharpness, and magnitude. For instance, topic commits within the first 2\% of denoising on MDLM, whereas sentiment emerges gradually over 20\% of the process. 
Motivated by these profiles, we propose an adaptive scheduling mechanism that concentrates intervention where each attribute is actively forming. An idealized allocation analysis predicts that attributes with more sharply concentrated emergence benefit more from adaptive scheduling, a prediction we confirm empirically. Across seven single- and multi-attribute steering tasks on four DLMs, adaptive steering consistently improves the control-quality balance over uniform and interval-restricted baselines.

</details>

### 110. Localized Recall-Capped Unlearning for Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=T5I5uQQEbi) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`causal mediation`、`localized update`、`gradient capping`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：DLM 的权重空间（weight-space）unlearning 基本未被探索；实证显示已有目标要么以牺牲通用能力为代价压制目标知识，要么保留 utility 但遗忘不足。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：识别出更新位置（update location）与梯度控制（gradient control）是这些失败的两个关键因素，提出 LRCU（Localized Recall-Capped Unlearning）：用因果中介（causal-mediation）定位选取 3 个连续 transformer block，仅更新这些 block；采用带截断的 per-token 交叉熵——每 token 交叉熵超过 cap 后即不再贡献遗忘梯度。LRCU 无需参考模型，更新参数不足 10%，在 LLaDA 上较全模型基线平均每步加速 1.5×。
- 📌 **结论**：在两个 DLM 骨干上的 WMDP-bio、WMDP-cyber、RWKU、TOFU 四个基准中，LRCU 取得与已有方法竞争的遗忘-utility 折中，凸显更新位置与梯度控制对有效 DLM unlearning 的重要性。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive language models. Unlearning is needed to remove unwanted knowledge from trained models, yet weight-space unlearning in DLMs remains largely unexplored. Empirically, existing objectives either suppress target knowledge at the expense of general capability or preserve utility with insufficient forgetting. We identify update location and gradient control as two key factors underlying these failures. Our method, Localized Recall-Capped Unlearning (LRCU), uses causal-mediation localization to select three consecutive transformer blocks. It updates only these blocks using capped per-token cross-entropy, with each token contributing zero forgetting gradient once its cross-entropy exceeds the cap. LRCU requires no reference model and updates less than 10\% of parameters, with a 1.5$\times$ average per-step speedup over the compared full-model baselines on LLaDA. Across WMDP-bio, WMDP-cyber, RWKU, and TOFU on two DLM backbones, LRCU achieves a competitive forgetting-utility trade-off compared with existing methods. These results highlight the importance of update location and gradient control for effective DLM unlearning. We will release an Open-DLU codebase upon acceptance for weight-space unlearning in DLMs, together with unlearned checkpoints to support further research.

TL;DR: We propose LRCU, an efficient unlearning method for diffusion language models that balances forgetting and utility while updating less than 10% of parameters, with a 1.5× average per-step speedup.

</details>

### 111. Machine Unlearning for Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=AIvW4QpdVI) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`masked diffusion`、`forward KL`、`unconditional anchor`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLaDA、Dream 等 MDLM 已达到与 AR 大模型相当的性能，但其 unlearning 设计必须考虑其独特机制：微调使模型在各 masked response 位置上的预测从 prompt-masked 无条件分布转向 prompt 条件分布——如何指定这些位置的目标预测是 MDLM unlearning 的关键设计考量。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Masked Diffusion Unlearning（MDU）：从扩散视角重新审视特定知识的学习过程，在每个 masked response 位置最小化从 prompt 条件预测到冻结的 prompt-masked 无条件 anchor 的前向 KL 散度，并引入温度缩放参数控制隐私-效用折中。
- 📌 **结论**：在标准基准与多个 MDLM 骨干上，MDU 相对所评估的 unlearning 基线取得强遗忘性能（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Recent masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), such as LLaDA and Dream, have achieved performance comparable to autoregressive large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, which generate text sequentially, MDLMs generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions in parallel. During fine-tuning, MDLMs learn to recover responses from masked response states conditioned on a prompt, thereby shifting their predictions from a prompt-masked unconditional distribution toward a prompt-conditional distribution. Given this distinct generative and fine-tuning mechanism, specifying the target predictions at masked response positions is an important design consideration for MDLM unlearning.
In this paper, we propose **Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU)**, an unlearning framework for MDLMs, by revisiting the process of learning specific knowledge in terms of diffusion. Specifically, MDU minimizes a forward KL divergence from the prompt-conditional prediction to a frozen prompt-masked unconditional anchor at every masked response position, with a temperature scaling parameter to control the privacy-utility trade-off. Our empirical results on standard benchmarks and MDLM backbones show that MDU achieves strong unlearning performance compared with the evaluated unlearning baselines.

</details>

### 112. Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=PsrmEN6HHg) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`backdoor defense`、`trigger detection`、`masked diffusion`、`self-distillation`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：已有研究表明 MDLM 易受后门攻击——输入含攻击者触发器时，后门模型产出恶意目标输出（如恶意代码），其余行为正常；但 MDLM 的后门防御仍基本未被探索。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 UNMASK，首个 MDLM 防御框架，同时完成检测含触发器输入、定位触发器 token、从被攻陷模型中移除后门三件事；利用触发器的特异性（specificity）与支配性（dominance）两个基本性质为每个输入 token 赋可疑度分，并借助 MDLM 并行 token 预测与任意位置 token 重建两项独有能力高效计算；另附支持该设计的理论分析。
- 📌 **结论**：在跨 2 种攻击 × 4 个模型的 40 个设置中，UNMASK 在 5% 假阳率下检出 99.3% 的含触发器输入（最强适配基线仅 54.8%），触发器定位精度超 99%，并把平均攻击成功率从 95% 降至 1%，同时基本保留干净输入上的模型 utility。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models because they can predict multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating tokens sequentially. However, recent studies have shown that MDLMs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks: when an input contains an attacker-chosen trigger, a backdoored model generates a targeted output, such as malicious code, while otherwise behaving normally. Despite this threat, backdoor defenses for MDLMs remain largely underexplored. We present UNMASK, the first defense framework for MDLMs that detects trigger-containing inputs, localizes the trigger tokens, and removes the backdoor from the compromised model. UNMASK exploits two fundamental properties of backdoor triggers, specificity and dominance, to assign a suspiciousness score to each input token. By leveraging two distinctive capabilities of MDLMs, parallel token prediction and token reconstruction at arbitrary positions, UNMASK computes these scores both effectively and efficiently. We further provide a theoretical analysis supporting the design of UNMASK. Evaluations across 40 settings spanning two attacks and four models show that UNMASK detects 99.3\% of trigger-containing inputs at a 5\% false-positive rate, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline, which achieves 54.8\%. UNMASK also achieves over 99\% trigger-localization accuracy and reduces the average attack success rate from 95\% to 1\%, while largely preserving the model's utility on clean inputs.

TL;DR: UNMASK detects and localizes backdoor triggers in masked diffusion language models using first-step predictions, then mitigates their effects through self-distillation.

</details>

### 113. Multi-Bit Watermarking for Discrete Diffusion Language Models via Bitwise Evidence Feedback

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Uh2vvMhjmA) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`watermarking`、`multi-bit message`、`bitwise evidence feedback`、`discrete diffusion`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）带来语言生成新范式，但可靠的多比特水印嵌入与恢复仍困难：迭代去噪涉及部分 masked 的非因果上下文，且各消息比特的证据累积不均匀。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 BEFMark，用比特级证据反馈（bitwise evidence feedback）在去噪全程自适应嵌入：通过上下文感知的多层投票从部分 masked 序列中抽取比特证据，并估计候选 token 在不完整上下文下的期望证据贡献；该反馈引导对生成分布做 KL 正则化更新——增强支持较弱的比特、同时惩罚对基模型预测的偏离。
- 📌 **结论**：在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 及多个数据集上，BEFMark 提升比特恢复精度，并在 LLaDA 上带来额外精确消息恢复增益；文本编辑下恢复鲁棒性改善，同时保持有竞争力的 log-perplexity 与下游任务表现。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a new paradigm for language generation, but reliable multi-bit watermark embedding and recovery remain challenging. Iterative denoising involves partially masked, non-causal contexts and uneven evidence accumulation across message bits. This work focuses on embedding multi-bit messages during dLLM generation and recovering them from the resulting text. We propose BEFMark, a watermarking framework that uses bitwise evidence feedback to adapt embedding throughout denoising. BEFMark extracts bitwise evidence from partially masked sequences through context-aware multi-layer voting and estimates candidate tokens’ expected evidence contributions under incomplete contexts. This feedback guides a KL-regularized update of the generation distribution, strengthening weakly supported bits while penalizing deviation from the base model’s predictions. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across multiple datasets demonstrate improved bit recovery accuracy, with additional exact-message recovery gains on LLaDA-8B-Instruct. BEFMark also improves recovery robustness under text editing while maintaining competitive log-perplexity and downstream task performance.

</details>

### 114. Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=T42s43m0cc) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`targeted bias injection`、`activation steering`、`closed-loop control`、`denoising trajectory`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：AR 解码器只在提交答案的那一步暴露其分布一次，而 dLLM 在提交前的每个去噪步都暴露；答案在多个去噪步内保持可修改，能访问内部激活的对手可以持续观察模型产出指定答案的概率并动态调整干预强度——这一新控制通道未被研究。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：研究 targeted bias injection：用比例-积分（PI）控制器在去噪过程中追踪目标答案概率、即时调整 steering 向量强度，把冻结 dLLM 拉向对手选定的人口学答案。在正确答案是弃权的 BBQ 歧义问题与 SocialStigmaQA 上评估，并与固定强度、逐样本固定强度等基线对照。
- 📌 **结论**：BBQ 上把 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 对目标群体的偏好从 1.8 提升至 16.7 个百分点（超最强固定强度 steering 基线三倍以上）；SocialStigmaQA 上污名化答案的选择率从 17.6% 升至 58.1%；换用其他人口学目标最多移位 37 个百分点，单次攻击单卡约 40 分钟。同等平均强度的恒定 steering 效果差得多且损坏近三倍输出；作者呼吁偏见审计应覆盖 serving 栈而非仅冻结模型。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively
denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before
it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution
once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step
before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this.
Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an
adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the
model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention
accordingly. Building on this observation, we study \emph{targeted bias injection}, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary.
The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that
tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the
strength of a steering vector on the fly.
On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our
attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from
1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest
fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the
selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6\% to 58.1\%.
Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up
to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU.
On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant
steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps
produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many
outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls
well short.
Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel
in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather
than the frozen model alone. We will make our code publicly available.

</details>

### 115. Pre-Execution Trajectory Control against Jailbreaks In Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=inx00ppCEs) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`jailbreak defense`、`inference-time control`、`trajectory monitoring`、`adaptive decoding`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：dLLM 在生成中反复修订 token 分布，使安全失败在有害内容显现在最终输出之前即可观测；作者发现成功 jailbreak 往往进入可检测的"执行前"（pre-execution）短时程轨迹集中状态：分布更新对齐、局部变异减少、不确定性坍缩——现有防御未利用这一信号。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 SafeBasin，免训练的推理时防御，由两部分组成：Trajectory Geometry Monitoring（TGM）计算以去噪进度与 warm-start 视野为条件、经良性校准的集中度评分；触发后 Adaptive De-contraction Control（ADC）施加轨迹缩放的切向去对齐、条件熵恢复与保格式选择性重 mask，并将受控分布送入下一去噪转移。
- 📌 **结论**：在 4 个 dLLM 上，面对扩散原生与通用 jailbreak、近期黑盒攻击及自适应 expectation-over-transformation 搜索，SafeBasin 在保持标准 utility 的同时降低攻击成功率；分析显示有用的执行前 recall 与 token 级轨迹转移，对响应长度与 EOS 时机影响有限，但对极短有害补全保护较弱，存在有限反应时间边界。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) repeatedly revise token distributions
during generation, exposing safety failures before harmful content becomes
visible in final outputs. We find that successful jailbreaks often enter a
detectable pre-execution regime of short-horizon trajectory
concentration, marked by aligned distribution updates, reduced local
variation, and collapsing uncertainty. We propose SafeBasin, a
training-free inference-time defense that combines Trajectory Geometry
Monitoring (TGM) with Adaptive De-contraction Control (ADC). TGM
computes a benign-calibrated concentration score conditioned on denoising
progress and warm-start horizon. Once triggered, ADC applies
trajectory-scaled tangent de-alignment, conditional entropy restoration, and
format-preserving selective remasking, and feeds the controlled distribution
into the next denoising transition. Across four dLLMs, diffusion-native and
general jailbreaks, recent black-box attacks, and adaptive
expectation-over-transformation searches, SafeBasin reduces attack success
while preserving standard utility. Further analyses show useful
pre-execution recall, token-level trajectory diversion, limited effects on
response length and EOS timing, and weaker protection for extremely short
harmful completions, revealing a finite-reaction-time boundary.

TL;DR: We propose SafeBasin, a training-free inference-time defense that detects pre-execution trajectory concentration in dLLMs and conditionally redirects denoising dynamics to reduce jailbreak success while preserving benign utility.

</details>

### 116. ReDiffMark: Post-Hoc Text Watermarking by Local Re-Diffusion

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=vMVVyPYZk9) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`post-hoc watermark`、`localized re-diffusion`、`entropy-gated editing`、`text watermarking`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：post-hoc 水印对闭 API 输出、RAG 检索段落与已发布文档至关重要，但要求最小改动原文且大规模部署时计算高效；已有稀疏编辑方案依赖规则式字节信号，信号稳定性差、效率低；全重写方案信号强却改写大部分 token，文本改动大且速度慢。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：观察到 dLLM 可填补这一鸿沟，提出基于局部化 re-diffusion 的 ReDiffMark：针对可用上下文熵与稀疏编辑位置识别两大难点，采用熵门控编辑配合密钥种子的指数最小（Gumbel）采样；检测端为重放式、surprisal 加权的检测器——在校准零假设下用同一 dLLM 重跑收到的文本。
- 📌 **结论**：跨多个 dLLM 家族、文本源与段落长度的实验显示，ReDiffMark 在低编辑率下实现高单段检出率，且仅需恒定的两次前向开销，兼顾信号强度、文本保真与部署效率。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Post-hoc watermarking embeds detectable signals into existing text, a capability crucial for closed-API outputs, RAG-retrieved passages, and published documents. However, such methods must minimally alter the original text while remaining computationally efficient for large-scale deployment. Existing sparse-editing schemes preserve the text but suffer from poor signal stability and low efficiency due to rule-based byte signaling; conversely, full-rewriting schemes carry strong signals but rewrite most tokens, leading to significant text alteration and slow speeds. We observe that discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) can bridge this gap. To this end, we propose **ReDiffMark**, a watermarking paradigm based on *localized re-diffusion*  for text that is stored or served verbatim or with light edits. 
We address challenges regarding available contextual entropy and the difficulty of identifying sparse edit locations through entropy-gated editing with key-seeded exponential-minimum (Gumbel) sampling, employing a *replay-based*, surprisal-weighted detector that re-runs the same dLLM on the received text under a calibrated null hypothesis.
Extensive experiments across dLLM families, text sources, and passage lengths show that **ReDiffMark** attains high single-passage detection at low edit rates with a constant two-forward-pass cost.

</details>

### 117. TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Dv97ivGjui) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`watermark`、`token pair`、`watermark forgery`、`masked diffusion`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：masked-diffusion 语言模型并行、无固定顺序地填充 masked 位置，而多数实用文本水印假设从左到右生成、以先前 token 为新 token 加密——在扩散模型中这些 token 可能仍被 mask；固定 green list 无需上下文，但会在每个位置偏爱同一批 token，攻击者比较水印/无水印文本的 token 频率即可恢复列表，伪造出提供方检测器也接受的水印文本。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 TANGO，把每个新 token 关联到一个已 unmask 的邻近 token：密钥将词表切分为颜色类，新 token 偏向由密钥与邻近 token 颜色共同决定的颜色——水印因此嵌入在 token 对中；因受偏爱颜色逐位置变化，token 频率保持接近无水印文本；检测只需文本与密钥，且不依赖任何 unmask 顺序假设。
- 📌 **结论**：在两个 masked-diffusion 模型上，TANGO 几乎检出所有未编辑的水印文本与多数已编辑文本，且伪造固定 green list 的频率攻击对 TANGO 失效，同时避免了可被统计区分的 token 频率偏移。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present **TANGO**, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in *pairs* of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay close to those of unwatermarked text. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.

TL;DR: We introduce TANGO, a watermarking method for diffusion language models that embeds the watermark in token pairs.

</details>

### 118. TIDEmark: Joint Token Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=wPnu90ms5m) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`watermarking`、`multi-marginal optimal transport`、`distortion-free`、`joint token watermarking`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：自回归水印通常逐 token 操作；DLM 经由连续步骤并行更新多个位置，而已有 DLM 适配方法只改编边信息生成、其余水印组件仍与 AR 版本相近，未利用并行生成来联合水印多个 token、在不改变各 token 分布的前提下强化检测。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 TIDEmark，借助多边际最优传输（multi-marginal optimal transport）一次性在多个 token 分布上构造水印：以 token 对水印分协调 token 选择，并证明对所记录 token 边际的理想无失真（distortion-free）保证；通过树结构交互图结合信念传播（BP）与 Sinkhorn 熵正则传输使联合水印可算——固定候选集尺寸与边信息状态数时，每次求解的计算复杂度随联合水印 token 数线性而非指数增长。
- 📌 **结论**：在摘要、问答与代码生成任务上，TIDEmark 可强化水印检测；结果还提示水印施加时机会影响生成质量与检测之间的平衡。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Watermarks for autoregressive language models typically operate one token at a time. Diffusion language models (DLMs) instead generate text through successive steps that update multiple token positions in parallel. Many existing methods adapt side-information generation to DLMs while leaving the other watermarking components similar to their autoregressive counterparts. In this work, we exploit parallel token generation to watermark multiple tokens jointly, aiming to strengthen detection without changing their individual distributions. To construct a watermark over several token distributions at once, we leverage multi-marginal optimal transport and introduce TIDEmark (**T**ransport-based **I**nteraction for **D**istortion-free **E**mbedding of water**mark**s). TIDEmark coordinates token choices using token-pair watermark scores, and we prove an ideal distortion-free guarantee for the recorded token marginals. We make joint watermarking computationally tractable through a tree-structured interaction graph, combining belief propagation (BP) with the Sinkhorn algorithm for entropy-regularized transport. For fixed candidate-set sizes and a fixed number of side-information states, the computational complexity per solver pass scales linearly rather than exponentially with the number of jointly watermarked tokens, matching token-level optimal transport’s dependence on token count. Experiments on summarization, question answering, and code generation show that TIDEmark can strengthen detection. TIDEmark results suggest that when the watermark is applied can affect the balance between generation quality and watermark detection.

TL;DR: TIDEmark jointly watermarks DLM tokens via multi-marginal optimal transport, with an ideal token-marginal preservation guarantee, computed efficiently on a pairwise tree-structured interaction graph.

</details>

### 119. Uncommitted Drafts Track Words, Not Knowledge: Evasion and Representation Monitoring in Diffusion LMs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=1ueGhmCmE1) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`monitorability`、`model organisms`、`sandbagging`、`representation monitoring`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：masked DLM 在每个去噪步持有对整个未提交答案的分布（whole-canvas draft），近期工作将其视为自回归模型没有的内在可监控性来源；作者追问：监视该草稿能看到什么，这种监视能否经受针对它的对抗训练。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 Qwen3-0.6B-diffusion 与 LLaDA-8B 上构建首批 DLM 秘密保守（secret-keeping）、sandbagging 与信念（belief）model organisms，系统比较草稿级词监控、黑盒文本监控与晚层表征监控在各对抗压力下的表现。
- 📌 **结论**：草稿追踪的是模型正在写的文本（含将被抑制的词）而非塑造文本的知识：秘密即文本主题时，masked 位置读出者以 0.72–0.92（chance 0.05）命名该词、去噪第 2 步即完成（黑盒需 8–24 步）；文本与知识分离时草稿监控自然失败——sandbagger 的草稿持有其将发出的错误答案（0.22–0.52）。对受同等训练的 decoy 对照，词惩罚可把秘密的草稿信号关闭 0.52–0.71 而发出的提示仍有信息量；但知识并未消失——晚层表征仍可读（删除晚层方向使行为从 0.97 降至 0.12），解码期封锁该词的全部 token 也不影响概念本身（0.667 vs 0.684）。结论：草稿监视器看的是词，知识在表征里，应监视概念而非词。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

A masked diffusion language model holds, at every denoising step, a distribution over its entire uncommitted answer—a whole-canvas draft that recent work reads as an intrinsic monitorability affordance with no autoregressive counterpart. We ask what a monitor of that draft can see, and whether it survives training against it. We build the first secret-keeping, sandbagging, and belief model organisms in diffusion LMs, on Qwen3-0.6B-diffusion and LLaDA-8B.

The draft tracks the text a model is writing—including words it will suppress—not the knowledge that shapes that text. Where the secret is the text's topic, a reader of masked-position mass names a word the model emits in under 12% of runs at 0.72–0.92 (chance 0.05), and names it by denoising step 2, while a black-box reader of the committed text needs 8 to 24 steps. Where text and knowledge diverge, the draft fails with no adversary at all: a sandbagger's draft holds the wrong answer it will emit (0.22–0.52) and the correct one only at chance, and a model that acts on an unstated belief in 70% of its answers, never writing the word, trips a word-level draft monitor in just 14% of them at a 5% false-alarm rate.

Against a decoy arm given identical training, a word penalty closes the secret's draft signal by 0.52–0.71 while the emitted hints stay informative, and halves the belief organism's word monitor without changing its behaviour. The knowledge is not lost: it stays legible in late-layer representations—where penalty and decoy are indistinguishable at every layer—and deleting a late-layer direction removes the behaviour (0.97 → 0.12, against 0.92 for a random direction). And the concept lives upstream of the token: in a companion organism that states the belief, blocking every token of the word at decoding—identical weights, identical seeds—leaves the dog-specific ideas untouched (0.667 against 0.684, difference -0.02 [-0.14, +0.11]) against floors of 0.009 and 0.000. Draft monitors watch words; the knowledge is in the representation. Monitor concepts, not words.

TL;DR: A diffusion LM's uncommitted draft previews the text it will write, not the knowledge behind it — so word-level draft monitors close cheaply under pressure, and miss sandbagging and unstated beliefs with no adversary at all.

</details>

### 120. Watermarking Continuous Diffusion Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=6SzEZJld4O) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`watermarking`、`continuous diffusion`、`anchor steering`、`provenance`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：已有文本生成水印聚焦自回归与离散扩散语言模型，连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）的水印化完全未被探索。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 COMPASS（Continuous-Latent Output Marking for Provenance via Anchor Steering and Scoring），免训练、专为 CDLM 设计：在隐扩散空间构造密钥相关的目标/非目标 anchor 表征，在选定去噪窗口内把与非目标 anchor 关联的隐向量 steer 向目标 anchor 集；检测仅需候选文本——用 CDLM 的编码器重编码，并测量所得隐表征与密钥定义目标 anchor 的对齐程度。
- 📌 **结论**：对 SOTA CDLM（Cola 与 ELF-L）生成的内容实现鲁棒检测且保留高质量输出；生成期既不需微调也无需额外神经网络评估，提供高效实用的 CDLM 溯源框架（摘要为定性结论，未给出具体数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Existing watermarking methods for text generation focus on autoregressive and discrete diffusion language models, leaving continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce COMPASS (Continuous-Latent Output Marking for Provenance via Anchor Steering and Scoring), a training-free watermark designed specifically for CDLMs. COMPASS constructs key-dependent target and non-target anchor representations in the latent diffusion space and, during a selected denoising window, steers latent vectors associated with non-target anchors toward the target anchor set. Detection requires only the candidate text. The detector re-encodes the text using the CDLM’s encoder and measures whether the resulting latent representations align with the target anchors defined by the watermark key. We show that this design provides robust detection of content generated by state-of-the-art CDLMs, namely Cola and ELF-L, while preserving their high-quality outputs. Furthermore, COMPASS requires neither model fine-tuning nor additional neural-network evaluations during generation, providing an efficient and practical framework for provenance tracing in CDLMs.

TL;DR: We design the first watermarking scheme tailored for continuous diffusion language models.

</details>

### 121. WHEN TOKEN-LEVEL DIVERGENCE MISRANKS PROMPT-INJECTION ROBUSTNESS

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=HNkOvbXTb2) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`prompt injection`、`KL divergence`、`robustness evaluation`、`agent security`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：masked DLM 在每个输出位置都暴露预测分布，使 clean run 与 prompt 注入 run 之间的 KL 散度成为比较解码器的便捷分数；作者追问：该分数能否按 prompt injection 鲁棒性正确给解码器排序。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在 Dream-7B 与 LLaDA-8B 上，研究模板化 record-lookup 案例与 AgentDojo 中 48 个单动作工具案例，对每个输出位置在其被固定的步骤取 KL 并平均；再以独立变化标签长度与要求答案格式的控制实验、以及减去配对良性便签所致 KL 的修正分数，检验排序的稳定性。
- 📌 **结论**：在 32 个主 lookup 案例上，提升 EOS logit 的 Dream 平均 KL 仅 0.080 nats 但 9 例跟随注入；而对攻击者目标 token 加惩罚（假定目标已知的 oracle）KL 达 1.101 nats 却 0 例跟随——KL 主要来自保留正确标签但丢掉周边句子的答案；跨 4 个 Dream 解码器，所有 decision-blind 分数与攻击计数的秩相关为 −0.40。结论：离开决策规则，逐位置散度无法识别决策保持；KL 分数只有在知道哪些输出 token 决定行动后才对安全性有意义。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Masked diffusion language models expose a predictive distribution at every output position, which makes the Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence between a clean run and a prompt-injected run a convenient score for comparing decoders. We ask whether this score can rank decoders by their robustness to prompt injection. We study Dream-7B and LLaDA-8B on templated record-lookup cases and on 48 single-action tool cases in AgentDojo, averaging the KL of each output position at the step where that position is fixed. On the 32 primary lookup cases, Dream with a raised end-of-sequence (EOS) logit has mean KL 0.080 nats and follows the injection in 9 cases, whereas Dream with a penalty on the attacker’s target tokens, an oracle that assumes the target is known, has 1.101 nats and follows it in 0. Most of this KL comes from answers that keep the correct label but drop the sentence around it. A control that varies label length and requested answer format independently orders these two decoders correctly, but across its four Dream decoders every decision-blind score we tested has rank correlation −0.40 with attack counts, including the mean after subtracting the KL caused by a matched benign note, which repairs the focal comparison in both panels. Changed tokens still carry almost all of the KL; which of them matter depends on the decision rule. We show that per-position divergences cannot identify decision preservation without the decision rule, and give a margin condition under which stable decision-relevant tokens preserve an authorized action. A KL score says something about safety only once we know which output tokens decide the action.

TL;DR: Token-level KL divergence can misrank prompt-injection robustness in diffusion language models because predictive sensitivity does not identify which output changes determine the downstream action.

</details>
