### 122. A Few Bits Break Forgetting: Bit-Flip Relearning Attack against Machine Unlearning

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=lWNXJFIYXn) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`machine unlearning`、`bit-flip attack`、`relearning attack`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Machine unlearning 旨在移除模型中的指定知识，但已有 relearning 攻击显示被遗忘知识可经微调恢复，且这类攻击依赖稠密参数修改与模型更新能力，容易被部署期完整性校验发现、实用性受限。能否仅靠极少的运行时比特级修改实现再学习是关键开放问题。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 BFRA（Bit-Flip Relearning Attack），跨任务、跨 unlearning 方法，通过极少量比特翻转实现免微调 relearning。将再学习建模为约束离散优化：最大化被遗忘知识的恢复、同时约束保留效用的下降。针对比特更新稀疏且离散的难点，采用渐进比特翻转策略，结合 First-Order Candidate Selection 与 Trial-Loss Bit Picking 高效定位有效翻转。
- 📌 **结论**：在 3 个任务、14 个模型-数据集设定、12 种 unlearning 方法上，BFRA 仅用几十个比特翻转即可大幅恢复被遗忘知识并保持高保留效用。结果揭示比特级稀疏修改构成 machine unlearning 鲁棒性的新攻击面。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Machine unlearning (MU) is an emerging paradigm to remove specified knowledge from trained models. Despite significant progress, recent studies reveal that unlearned knowledge can be recovered through relearning attacks, raising concerns about MU’s robustness. However, existing relearning attacks typically rely on fine-tuning and model update capability for dense parameter modifications, making them detectable by deployment-time integrity verification and less practical. This raises a critical question: can relearning attacks be achieved through only minimal runtime bit-level modifications? As bit-level updates are sparse and discrete, two challenges arise: balancing relearning with utility and efficiently identifying effective bit flips. Existing bit-flip attacks mainly degrade model behavior, which fundamentally differs from relearning and fails to address the challenges. In this paper, we propose **BFRA**, a **B**it **F**lip **R**elearning **A**ttack that is applicable across tasks and MU methods, enabling fine-tuning-free relearning through minimal bit flips. To balance relearning and utility, BFRA formulates relearning as a constrained discrete optimization problem that maximizes forgotten knowledge recovery while constraining retain utility drop. To improve efficiency, BFRA adopts a progressive bit-flip strategy combining First-Order Candidate Selection and Trial-Loss Bit Picking. Extensive experiments across 3 tasks, 14 model-dataset settings, and 12 MU methods show that BFRA substantially recover forgotten knowledge with only a few dozen bit flips while keeping high retain utility.

TL;DR: We uncover a new vulnerability of machine unlearning and propose BFRA: a few bit flips can recover forgotten knowledge without fine-tuning.

</details>

### 123. A Released LoRA Adapter Names the Document It Was Trained On

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=u82w02YBmy) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`training data extraction`、`LoRA`、`privacy leakage`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Hugging Face 上公开的 LoRA adapter 已超过 13 万个，任何下载者都无法得知其训练数据。已有权重研究只能产出训练数据的标量或文字描述，生成式攻击在源文本上 ROUGE-2 低于 9%，据此认为从 adapter 抽取训练数据极其困难。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：证明发布的 adapter 可以指认它训练时所用的具体文档：方法从约 57 万候选文档中为全部 256 个五步训练的 held-out adapter 检索出训练文档，在数百万个 shortlist 负例上误报率仅 0.01%；同一设定下贪心解码无法逐字复现任何文档，说明指认不依赖文本可恢复。进一步把信号溯源到规范不变乘积 ΔW = A^⊤B：仅基于 dW 的 kernel（不需要基座模型、tokenizer 或前向传播）即可在 16 个候选中把训练文档排到 C-AUC 0.897。
- 📌 **结论**：在第二个基座模型上端到端重拟合后，方法仍指认全部文档，而解码至多复现 1/256；到八十步训练后贪心解码才能恢复文档，单 adapter 混合多文档训练会稀释指认信号。表明发布 adapter 即可能泄露其训练文档，隐私评估必须从模型输出扩展到模型权重。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

LoRA adapters are low-rank factors smaller in size compared to the base models they are fine-tuned on. Over 130,000 LoRA adapters are publicly posted on Hugging Face alone. Anyone who downloads an adapter receives it without knowing the data it was fine-tuned on. Prior studies of these weights have produced a scalar or a verbal description of the training data, plus a generative attack reports ROUGE-2 below 9% on the source text, thereby concluding that extraction is extremely difficult. In this work, we show that a released adapter identifies the exact document it was fine-tuned on. Our method retrieves that document from roughly 570k candidates for all 256 held-out adapters trained for five steps and shows a 0.01% false positive rate across millions of shortlisted negatives. In that same setting, greedy decoding reproduces no document verbatim, so identification does not require the text to be recoverable. On a second base model, we refit the method end-to-end and it again identifies every document, while decoding reproduces at most one of 256. We trace the signal to the gauge-invariant product $\Delta W = A^\top B$. A kernel over dW alone with no base model, tokenizer or forward pass, ranks the training document at C-AUC 0.897 among 16 candidates. We also measure the bounds of this method. We see that by eighty steps greedy decoding can recover the document and training one adapter on several documents dilutes which one is named. More broadly, our work shows that publishing an adapter can disclose the document behind it and privacy assessments must extend from a model's outputs to its weights.

</details>

### 124. Amplifying Privacy Attacks on Tabular Foundation Models via a Stolen Surrogate

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=sGVZRmZQzK) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`tabular foundation model`、`model stealing`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：表格基础模型（TFM）在结构化数据上取得 SOTA，且通常经 in-context learning 用敏感下游数据适配，由此带来的隐私风险尚未被充分理解。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：展示仅查询（query-only）的攻击者可先偷取代理模型再放大隐私攻击：在没有任何 in-context 数据分布样本、不知上下文长度、无写权限的条件下，攻击者发送随机查询，把公开 TFM checkpoint 适配到答案上得到高保真代理；随后可任意条件化、无限制地查询代理，在其上运行成员推断、属性推断与性质推断等标准隐私攻击。
- 📌 **结论**：跨数据集、TFM 骨干、上下文长度与输出格式的分析显示，偷取加隐私攻击的组合均可泛化，且任务越难成功率越高。把输出限制为预测标签仍挡不住模型偷取，但可阻止分类任务上的隐私攻击；回归任务仍持续泄露私人信息。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on structured data. The fact that these models are usually adapted for their sensitive downstream tasks by in-context learning raises the question of privacy risks. We show that even a query-only adversary can extract a significant amount of private information from the context examples by first stealing a surrogate of the preconditioned model and then running privacy attacks on the copy. Without a single sample from the in-context data distribution, without knowledge of the context size, and without any write access to the context, the adversary sends random queries, adapts a public TFM checkpoint to the answers, and obtains a high-fidelity surrogate. The adversary can then condition on arbitrary contexts and query the surrogate without any restrictions. We show that the surrogate can significantly amplify the risks of standard privacy attacks, including membership inference, attribute inference, and property inference. We analyze our method across various settings, including different datasets, TFM backbones, context sizes, and output formats. We find that the combination of stealing and privacy attacks generalizes over these settings, and that its success grows with task difficulty. Restricting the output to the predicted label is still vulnerable to theft, but prevents privacy attacks on a classification task, whereas private information from regression still leaks. Our anonymous codebase is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/tfm-priv-attack-0BFC.

TL;DR: We steal a deployed adapted tabular foundation model with random queries and use the resulting surrogate as a reference model to amplify membership, attribute, and property inference on the private in-context data.

</details>

### 125. ATTENMIA: READING MEMBERSHIP OFF THE ATTENTION MAPS OF LANGUAGE MODELS

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=JmDIjrokvf) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`attention`、`white-box`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 的成员推断攻击（MIA）带来训练数据隐私风险，但多数已有 MIA 从模型输出（log 概率或生成文本）取信号；注意力机制对模型内信息流的重要作用提示成员签名可能直接体现在注意力模式中。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出白盒 MIA AttenMIA 的两个变体：Transitional 特征捕捉跨层注意力变化、Perturbation 特征度量输入编辑下的注意力偏移，各配轻量监督分类器把特征转为成员分数。在为规避已知分布陷阱而构造的 MIMIR 基准上评测，覆盖 7 个域、3 种 Pythia 规模，并用逐域留出协议与监督式 hidden-state 对照剥离分布捷径。
- 📌 **结论**：AttenMIA (Perturbation) 在 21 个设定中 20 个取得最高 ROC AUC，域平均 AUC 0.83-0.85（最强基线 0.71）；逐域留出协议下 Transitional 变体在三种模型规模上全部最佳，平均 0.73 AUC、26.7% TPR@1%FPR，而监督式 hidden-state 对照仅 0.54，证明优势来自注意力特征本身。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language models (LLMs) can reveal through attacks such as Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) whether a sequence appeared in their training data, creating privacy risks. Many existing MIAs for LLMs derive their signal from model outputs. Motivated by recent research showing the important role attention plays in information flow within a model, in this paper, we instead ask whether membership signatures are visible in the model’s attention patterns. We introduce AttenMIA, a white-box MIA with two variants: Transitional features capture cross-layer attention changes, while Perturbation features measure attention shifts under input edits. Each variant uses a lightweight supervised classifier to convert its features into membership scores. We evaluate on MIMIR, a benchmark constructed to reduce known distributional pitfalls in membership evaluation. Across seven domains and three Pythia model sizes, AttenMIA (Perturbation) achieves the highest ROC AUC in 20 of 21 settings, with domain-averaged AUCs of 0.83–0.85, compared with 0.71 for the strongest evaluated baseline. When each domain is held out from attack training and selection, AttenMIA (Transitional) performs best among the evaluated methods across all three model sizes, averaging 0.73 ROC AUC and 26.7% TPR@1%FPR across domains and models. Under the same protocol, a supervised hidden-state control achieves an average AUC of 0.54, showing that the advantage arises from attention features. GPT-2 fine-tuning experiment shows that cross-layer transitional attention features, and perturbation-response features have different attention gradients for members and non-members. These results substantially improve on SoTA membership inference attacks, and demonstrate that self-attention provides a useful signal for training-membership inference that transfers across the evaluated domains.

</details>

### 126. Auditing of Unlearning Algorithms

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=qNaZE6FrhA) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`machine unlearning`、`privacy auditing`、`differential privacy`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：评估 unlearning 算法是否真正移除 forget set 的影响仍是开放难题，论文声称的 certified unlearning 证书缺乏可证伪的外部检验手段。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出假设检验式审计器：用成员推断攻击计算 certified unlearning 的 zCDP 参数 ρ 的高置信经验下界（并直接审计 Gaussian DP 参数 μ），拒绝候选 ρ 即证明所声称证书不可能成立。威胁模型为黑盒，攻击者额外观测初始化与每个 epoch 的洗牌顺序。
- 📌 **结论**：CIFAR-100 上，model clipping、rewind-to-delete 等 certified 方法的下界与其声明一致，而 Hessian-based、交替 descent-ascent、BadTeacher、DELETE 等 uncertified 方法常给出大下界、暴露 forget set 的显著残余影响；审计还扩展到 Shakespeare 语料并规模化到 Llama-3.2-1B/TOFU，为驳斥 unlearning 声明提供了实用工具。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Evaluating whether an unlearning algorithm has truly removed the influence of its forget set remains an open challenge. We introduce a hypothesis-testing auditor that uses membership-inference attacks to compute high-confidence empirical lower bounds on the zero-concentrated differential privacy (zCDP) parameter $\rho$ of certified unlearning, with a direct audit of the Gaussian
differential privacy parameter $\mu$ as well; rejecting a candidate $\rho$ establishes that a claimed certificate cannot hold. Our bounds are computed under a black-box threat model in which the adversary additionally observes the initialization and the per-epoch shuffling order. On CIFAR-100, certified methods such as model clipping and rewind-to-delete yield small lower bounds consistent
with their stated guarantees, whereas uncertified methods---including Hessian-based unlearning, interleaved descent--ascent, ascent on the forget set, fine-tuning on the retain set, and class-based forgetting methods such as BadTeacher and DELETE---often yield large lower bounds, revealing substantial residual influence of the forget set. Hessian-based unlearning is certified only for convex losses, and that certification does not transfer to the nonconvex networks we study. We further audit uncertified methods on Shakespeare and scale our evaluation to Llama-3.2-1B  on TOFU, a dataset of fictitious authors. Overall, our auditor provides a practical tool for refuting unlearning claims.
across model architectures, datasets, and scales.

TL;DR: We introduce a membership-inference auditor that lower-bounds how indistinguishable an unlearned model is from a retrained one, letting claimed unlearning certificates be rejected with high confidence.

</details>

### 127. Certificates Expire: Durable Unlearning for Large Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=HEgzQdcyAt) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`relearning attack`、`certified unlearning`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：Machine unlearning 在发布时通过检查确认知识已抹除，但后续对抗微调可移动参数、恢复通过检查的知识；相同的发布时输出并不固定恢复成本，对采样攻击的抵抗也不能覆盖预算内所有轨迹——发布时行为与持久性之间存在分离。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：先证明这一分离并把缺失信息定位在落点几何中，再提出 PLATEAU 框架：Directional Measure Estimation 在发布点读取 forget-loss 裕度、方向梯度范数与规定邻域上的一致负曲率界；Barrier Certification 把有效界转为闭式安全半径与完整更新步数的整数预算，覆盖声明类内所有可容许轨迹与评估目标而无需实际运行攻击；Certified Durability Training 进一步用半径依赖正则化已有 unlearning 目标并重新评估发布点。
- 📌 **结论**：在 TOFU、MUSE、WMDP-bio 上以匹配的遗忘与效用做共同声明，PLATEAU 取得最大认证预算并在 TOFU 与 MUSE 上恢复最慢，且 51 个方法-基准单元格全部在预算内未被恢复。持久性由此成为发布参数本身的属性，任何 unlearning 流程都可用同一组几何量评估。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Machine unlearning removes designated knowledge from a trained language model, with release-time checks assessing whether the requested knowledge erasure has been achieved. Durable unlearning faces a distinctive obstacle: subsequent adversarial fine-tuning moves the released parameters and can recover knowledge that passed those checks. Identical release-time outputs need not fix recovery cost, while resistance to sampled attacks does not certify every trajectory within a budget. To address these, we first establish a separation between release-time behavior and durability, locating the missing information in the geometry of the landing point. We then design PLATEAU, a framework that converts this geometry into a certified budget of fine-tuning updates. Within this framework, Directional Measure Estimation reads the forget-loss margin and directional gradient norm at release together with a uniform negative-curvature bound over a prescribed neighborhood. Barrier Certification then converts valid bounds into a closed-form safety radius and an integer budget of complete updates, covering every admissible trajectory and evaluation objective in the declared class without running attacks. In addition, Certified Durability Training uses the radius dependencies to regularize existing unlearning objectives, followed by re-evaluation of the updated release. Under a common declaration on TOFU, MUSE and WMDP-bio at matched forgetting and utility, PLATEAU attains the largest certified budget and the longest recovery on TOFU and MUSE, and every one of the 51 compared method–benchmark cells stays unrecovered within its budget. Together, the separation and certificate make durability a property of the released parameters: any unlearning procedure can be assessed through the same geometric quantities, with a guarantee expressed in the complete updates an adversary can take.

TL;DR: A certificate checked at release says nothing about later fine-tuning; PLATEAU certifies, in closed form, how many fine-tuning updates an unlearned release survives and trains the release to enlarge that budget.

</details>

### 128. CINDER: Twin-Referenced Training for Relearning-Resistant Unlearning

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=MrbsY6Iy4J) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`machine unlearning`、`relearning attack`、`meta-learning`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：通过自身评估的 LLM unlearning 方法常被 forget set 上的几步微调撤销；作者主张抗再学习的正确参照不是不可恢复，而是从未见过 forget 数据训练的 retain-only twin，并直接针对 twin 训练。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：CINDER 在训练内部模拟攻击者自身的攻击类——对 forget facts 的随机一半做全参数微调（一阶元梯度），通过锚定在 twin 攻击后下限的 softplus 惩罚抑制留出一半的恢复；评估采用方法级非劣性检验：以两次独立重训的差距为预指定裕度，要求覆盖全部八个轴。
- 📌 **结论**：0.5B 规模 16 个语料种子上，CINDER 攻击后恢复仅比 twin 高 0.08 nats（单侧 95% 界 0.21、裕度 0.36），比 NPO 低 1.17 nats；分析锁定后在 16 个新语料上复现（+0.16 nats）。预注册八轴协议下 15/16（新语料 16/16）种子未被拒绝再学习，五个基线家族至多 4 个；消融表明 floor、全参数内层攻击与事实级划分均必要，且从预训练基座取的 floor 与 twin 的同样有效。1.5B/3B 上 12 个种子均未被拒绝，但付出效用代价。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

LLM unlearning methods that pass their own evaluations are routinely undone by a few steps of fine-tuning on part of the forget set. We argue the right reference for resistance is not "unrecoverable" but a retain-only twin — a model trained without the forget data — and train against it directly. CINDER simulates the attacker's own attack class inside training (full-parameter fine-tuning on a random half of the forget facts, first-order meta-gradient) and penalizes recovery of the held-out half through a softplus penalty anchored at the twin's post-attack floor. We evaluate with the hypotheses the right way round: method-level non-inferiority to the twin at a pre-specified margin — the spread between two independent retrains — across corpora, with every axis required. On sixteen corpus seeds at 0.5B, CINDER's post-attack recovery exceeds the twin's by 0.08 nats (one-sided 95% bound 0.21, margin 0.36), 1.17 nats below NPO (95% CI 0.94–1.39); on sixteen fresh corpora generated after the analysis was fixed, +0.16 nats (bound 0.29), 1.16 below NPO. It is non-inferior on six of eight axes; on the circuit criterion and utility non-inferiority is not shown. A frozen, preregistered eight-axis protocol, used as a screen, agrees: relearning is not rejected on 15 of 16 seeds (16 of 16 fresh) against at most 4 for five baseline families, and no axis on 8 of 16 (3 of 16 fresh, C1 rejecting eleven) against at most 2. Ablations over eight to sixteen seeds show that the floor, the full-parameter inner attack and the fact-level split are each needed, that a floor taken from the pretrained base — no twin at training time — works as well as the twin's, and that adding our floor to MUDMAN brings it within the margin. At 1.5B and 3B relearning is not rejected on any of twelve seeds, but utility is paid for. We report what this does not show: a pass of a finite battery bounds nothing, the objective overshoots its floor, and a twin, though not needed for training at 0.5B, is still needed to evaluate.

TL;DR: Training against a simulated relearning attack, anchored to a floor rather than zero, makes unlearned LLMs recover no more than a retain-only twin (non-inferiority on 16+16 corpora), 1.2 nats less than NPO; the floor need not come from a twin.

</details>

### 129. COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=2e1uTFJpBK) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`vision language model`、`noise calibration`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：视觉大语言模型（VLLM）日益部署于隐私敏感领域；已有最强灰盒 MIA 依赖熵统计或生成式描述，需要昂贵的响应生成且成员分离度有限；基于扰动的方法又只关注大扰动，小扰动下的成员行为缺乏理解。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：在精细分辨率上系统刻画 VLLM 在全量级受控高斯扰动下的成员行为，发现最优扰动幅度与成员信号方向随模型-数据对变化：许多设定下未被研究的低噪声区产生比大扰动更强的分离，且成员发散更低、常规分数方向被反转。据此提出 COMPASS：用分布宽松匹配的已知非成员参照集自适应校准扰动幅度与分数方向；以 Rényi 归一化 KL 与 Rényi 散度为实例，对信息量最大的图像 logit 位置做 max-k 聚合。
- 📌 **结论**：在 LLaVA v1.5-7B、MiniGPT-4、HuluMed-32B（覆盖预训练、指令微调与医学影像数据）上持续优于基线：通用域评估 AUC 最高 0.88；分布匹配的医学评估中达 0.64 AUC，而最强基线仍在随机水平。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Vision large language models (VLLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising concerns about the exposure of their training data. The strongest existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) against VLLMs commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly response generation while providing limited membership separation. In contrast, perturbation-based methods measure how model responses change when images are perturbed, but have mainly focused on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. In this work, we systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across the full range of noise levels at fine resolution. Our analysis reveals that both the optimal perturbation magnitude and the direction of the membership signal vary across model–dataset pairs. For many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime produces stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members and thereby reversing the conventionally observed score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. Motivated by this finding, we propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Rényi-normalized KL divergence and Rényi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5–7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS consistently outperforms baselines. Under general-domain evaluations, COMPASS achieves AUCs of up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.

</details>

### 130. DELETECERT: Counterfactual Certificates for Deletion in Persistent Agent Memory

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=DiDL4aIWW1) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`tool`、`machine unlearning`、`agent memory`、`privacy auditing`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：从持久语言 agent 的记忆里删除一条记录不等于删除其影响：一个用户工件会被派生成摘要、嵌入、图边、画像、技能、缓存计划、发给其他 agent 的消息乃至参数更新，删掉原始行后这些衍生态仍然留存。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：以反事实方式定义删除——仅当部署 agent 的行为等同于从未观测过该工件的世界中的 agent 时才算删除，残余影响定义为相对 never-seen agent 的超额风险。围绕该定义构建 DELETECERT：类型化工件血缘图、在风险预算与效用下限下决定每个后代删除/重算/保留的闭包，以及限定范围的审计来界定超额风险并报告是否达标；并证明忠实重算可精确复原 never-seen 世界、最小成本闭包 NP-hard、有限探测集无法认证最坏情形等结果。
- 📌 **结论**：合成结构基准上仅删原始记录会留下 0.45 超额风险；审计界在全部 6285 个审计案例上成立（其中 1827 个报告删除失败），贪心规划器在 76% 的案例上找到计划。在 LLM 写入的记忆上，闭包会误删无关内容、并漏掉跨两个会话陈述的记录，审计均如实报告失败。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Deleting a record from an agent's memory is not the same as deleting its
influence. A persistent language agent turns one user artifact into summaries,
embeddings, graph edges, profiles, skills, cached plans, messages to other agents
and sometimes parameter updates; removing the original row leaves this derived
state in place. We define deletion counterfactually: an artifact $x$ is deleted,
on a declared probe law, when the deployed agent behaves like the agent of the
world that never observed $x$, and residual influence is the excess risk over
that never-seen agent. Around this definition we build \method: a typed
artifact-lineage graph, a closure that deletes, recomputes or keeps each
descendant under a risk budget and a utility floor, and a scoped audit that bounds
excess risk under the declared law and reports whether the bound meets the target.
We prove that faithful recomputation reproduces the never-seen world exactly and
degrades gracefully in total variation, that the audit's bound is valid for a
fixed post-deletion state, that minimum-cost closure is NP-hard, and that no
finite probe set certifies worst-case equivalence. On a synthetic structural
benchmark, deleting the raw record leaves $0.45$ excess risk; the audit's bound
held on all $6285$ audited cases, $1827$ of which report a failed deletion, and
the greedy planner found a plan on $76\%$ of cases, while the exact optimum of
its own problem exists on all of them. On memory written by a language model, the
closure removes a record held in one session but loses unrelated content it
deletes rather than recomputes, and misses a record stated across two sessions
until its detector reads the parts and its scope covers every root; the audit
reports each failure. The benchmarks are a structural simulator and a small
language-model world, and every number describes them.

TL;DR: Deleting a memory record may leave its influence in derived agent state. DELETECERT traces this lineage, selectively deletes or recomputes descendants, and audits residual risk against a never-seen counterfactual agent.

</details>

### 131. Diana: Calibrating the Per-Token Null for Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned LLMs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=3Y7jslvpCm) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`fine-tuning`、`privacy auditing`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：对语言模型的 MIA 在领域微调后变得复杂：token 相对预训练模型的 log 概率增益可能反映领域级学习而非对目标序列本身的记忆，使 reference-based 攻击的误报膨胀。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出即插即用的校准 Diana（Distribution-Informed Attacks with Null Adjustment）：观察到非成员时目标模型自身的下一 token 分布近似领域分布，故从观测增益中减去 target 加权平均增益（centering）；在建模假设下中心化增益对非成员条件均值为零、对成员为正；再除以正则化增益方差得到校准增益。整个过程只需目标与预训练模型的 log 概率，无需辅助数据或额外训练，可接入任意 reference-based 攻击并沿用其聚合规则。
- 📌 **结论**：在六个语料上，Ratio+Diana 在 0.1% FPR 下的平均 TPR 是 Ratio 的 4.2 倍，并在每个语料上超越所有被评估的已有攻击。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Membership inference attacks on language models detect whether a specific text was included in the training data. Fine-tuning on a domain complicates this task: an increase in a token’s log-probability over the pre-trained model, which we call its gain, may reflect domain-level learning rather than memorization of the target sequence itself, inflating false positives in reference-based attacks. We introduce *Diana* (Distribution-Informed Attacks with Null Adjustment), a plug-and-play calibration that isolates memorization from domain adaptation. Our two key observations are: (i) for non-members, the target model’s own next-token distribution approximates the domain distribution. This motivates centering: subtracting the target-weighted mean gain over possible next tokens from the observed gain. (ii) Under our modeling assumptions, the centered gain has zero conditional mean for non-members and positive conditional mean for members. To account for differences in background variability, *Diana* divides the centered gain by the regularized gain variance to obtain a calibrated gain. Hence, *Diana* requires only the log-probabilities of the target and pre-trained models—no auxiliary data or additional training—and integrates with any reference-based attacks, which then aggregate the calibrated gains under their original rules. Across six corpora, *Ratio*$+$*Diana* achieves $4.2\times$ the mean true-positive rate of *Ratio* at a $0.1\%$ false-positive rate and outperforms all evaluated prior attacks on every corpus.

TL;DR: DIANA turns a fine-tuned LLM’s own predictive distribution into a per-token null for membership inference, substantially improving low-FPR detection without auxiliary data or additional training.

</details>

### 132. Fooled by Fine-Tuning: Why Memorization Audits of Code-Completion Models Need Controls

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=lV3nwd3dll) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`memorization auditing`、`code completion`、`membership inference`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：代码模型的记忆审计通常向训练数据注入 canary 再测量模型对它们的偏好，却往往不评估可比的非成员样本；这种做法可能产生看似可信实则误导的泄露结论。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：对微调代码模型做受控审计——超过 11000 个 canary、多攻击者家族、多检查点与对照组，识别出三类反复出现的失败模式：大的参考模型暴露分数不能区分注入 canary 与从未注入的对照（即使有匹配语料参照）；基于补全的似然比成员测试对成员与非成员反应相似、实际检测的是微调而非成员关系；当置信界为与安全声明不同的 estimand 计算时抽取保证被显著高估。阳性对照实验证实这些并非审计管线本身失效；论文还修正了动机该审计的信息论证书中一个 vacuous 的加性界表述，并指出 reference-ratio 审计的逐点似然比并不直接估计证书所需的散度，因此不作认证声明。
- 📌 **结论**：主张更严格的记忆审计方法论：必须引入匹配的非成员对照、匹配参照、逐工具的阳性对照与 estimand-aware 报告，否则针对代码模型的泄露声明不可靠。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Memorization audits of code models commonly inject canaries into training data and measure how strongly the resulting model prefers them, often without evaluating comparable non-members. We show that this practice can produce convincing but misleading conclusions. Through a controlled audit of fine-tuned code models with more than $11{,}000$ canaries, multiple attacker families, checkpoints, and controls, we identify three recurring failure modes. First, large reference-model exposure scores do not necessarily distinguish injected canaries from never-injected controls, even with a matched-corpus reference. Second, a completion-based likelihood-ratio membership test can respond similarly to members and non-members, effectively detecting fine-tuning rather than membership. Third, extraction guarantees can be substantially overstated when confidence bounds are computed for a different estimand than the security claim being made. Positive-control experiments confirm that these findings are not simply failures of the auditing pipeline. We further revisit the information-theoretic certificate motivating our audit. We correct a vacuous additive bound formulation, but show that the pointwise likelihood ratios computed by reference-ratio audits do not directly estimate the divergence required by such a certificate; accordingly, we make no certification claim. Our results motivate a stricter methodology for memorization auditing based on non-member controls, matched references, per-instrument positive controls, and estimand-aware reporting.

TL;DR: Common memorization audits of fine-tuned code models can mistake fine-tuning effects for membership; matched non-member controls, positive controls, and estimand-aware reporting are necessary to support reliable leakage claims.

</details>

### 133. From Unfamiliar to Familiar: Detecting Pre-training Data via Gradient Deviations in Large Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Tf1YsEjRBw) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`detection`、`pre-training data detection`、`gradient deviation`、`benchmark contamination`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 预训练数据检测对版权争议与 benchmark 污染至关重要；已有方法主要依赖似然统计特征或微调前后的启发式信号，前者易受语料词频偏置影响，后者强依赖微调数据的相似度。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：从优化视角观察到训练中样本由陌生变熟悉的过程体现为梯度行为的系统差异：熟悉样本更新幅度更小、更新位置不同且更新更集中。据此提出 GDS——用梯度剖面刻画样本在 FFN 与 Attention 模块上参数更新的幅度、位置与集中度，揭示成员与非成员数据的一致区别，再送入轻量分类器做二分成员推断。
- 📌 **结论**：在五个公开数据集上 GDS 取得 SOTA，且跨数据集可迁移性优于强基线；对成员与非成员梯度分布的进一步分析验证了方法机理。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Pre-training data detection for LLMs is essential for addressing copyright concerns and mitigating benchmark contamination. Existing methods mainly focus on the likelihood-based statistical features or heuristic signals before and after fine-tuning, but the former are susceptible to word frequency bias in corpora, and the latter strongly depend on the similarity of fine-tuning data. From an optimization perspective, we observe that during training, samples transition from unfamiliar to familiar in a manner reflected by systematic differences in gradient behavior. Familiar samples exhibit smaller update magnitudes, distinct update locations, and more concentrated updates. Based on this insight, we propose GDS, a method that identifies pre-training data by probing Gradient Deviation Scores of target samples. Specifically, we first represent each sample using gradient profiles that capture the magnitude, location, and concentration of parameter updates across FFN and Attention modules, revealing consistent distinctions between member and non-member data. These features are then fed into a lightweight classifier to perform binary membership inference. Experiments on five public datasets show that GDS achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved cross-dataset transferability over strong baselines. Further analyses reveal distinct gradient distributions between members and non-members, validating our methodology.

TL;DR: We propose GDS, a gradient deviation score-based method, to identify LLMs' pre-training data via gradient profile features and address copyright and benchmark contamination issues with superior detection.

</details>

### 134. Learning to Detect Training Data via Active Reconstruction

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=m8EG1AeLW9) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`active reconstruction`、`reinforcement learning`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 训练数据检测通常被表述为 MIA 问题，但多数 MIA 在固定权重上被动操作（log 似然或文本生成）；作者假设训练数据比非成员更可重构，这一可重构性差异可被主动利用于成员推断。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出主动数据重构攻击 ADRA：借助 RL 会锐化权重中既有行为的发现，用 on-policy RL 主动诱导模型重构给定文本——从目标模型初始化策略并微调，为其设计重构度量与对比奖励；自适应变体 ADRA+ 在候选数据池上同时改进重构与检测。评估覆盖预训练、后训练与蒸馏三类设定。
- 📌 **结论**：在 14 个评估设定上，最佳方法平均比最强可用 loss 基线高 11.2 AUROC、比所有被评估基线中最强者高 6.8 点；ADRA+ 在 BookMIA 上超过 Min-K%++ 18.8 点、在 AIME 上超 7.6 点。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Detecting LLM training data is generally framed as a membership inference attack (MIA) problem. However, most MIAs operate passively on fixed model weights, using log-likelihoods or text generations. In this work, we introduce **Active Data Reconstruction Attack** (ADRA), a family of MIAs that actively induces a model to reconstruct a given text through training. We hypothesize that training data are *more reconstructible* than non-members, and the difference in their reconstructibility can be exploited for membership inference. Motivated by findings that reinforcement learning (RL) sharpens behaviors already encoded in weights, we leverage on-policy RL to actively elicit data reconstruction by finetuning a policy initialized from the target model. To effectively use RL for MIA, we design reconstruction metrics and contrastive rewards. The resulting algorithms, ADRA and its adaptive variant ADRA+, improve both reconstruction and detection given a pool of candidate data. Across pre-training, post-training, and distillation, our best method improves over the strongest available loss-based baseline by 11.2 AUROC points on average across 14 evaluation settings, and the strongest of all evaluated baselines by 6.8 points. As a highlight, ADRA+ improves over Min-K%++ by 18.8 points on BookMIA and 7.6 points on AIME.

TL;DR: Training data is more reconstructible than non-members; rewarding an LLM with on-policy RL for reconstructing candidate texts turns this gap into a stronger membership inference attack.

</details>

### 135. M-Drift: Membership Inference via Gradient-Induced Mechanistic Drift

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=rq8vbbiKNX) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`mechanistic interpretability`、`diffusion model`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：VLM 与扩散模型常在 web 级数据上训练，难以判断某个样本是否参与过训练，需要能审计模型内部记忆信号的白盒成员推断方法。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 M-Drift：对候选样本施加一次小幅可逆的 loss 增大梯度上升扰动，测量损失、内部表示与跨模态交互的相应变化作为成员证据——VLM 上捕捉表示与 cross-attention 漂移，扩散模型上跨采样时间步与噪声实现聚合去噪漂移；再用稀疏特征投影定位受干预影响最大的内部方向。
- 📌 **结论**：在多个 VLM 与扩散骨干上，M-Drift 在低误报区间持续优于强输出型与梯度型基线，说明干预诱导的表示漂移为现代生成模型的记忆审计提供了有用且可解释的信号。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Vision-language models (VLMs) and diffusion models are often trained on large web-scale datasets, making it difficult to determine whether a particular example was used during training. We introduce M-Drift, a white-box membership inference framework that uses a model's response to a small, reversible gradient-ascent perturbation as membership evidence. For each candidate example, M-Drift applies a single loss-increasing nudge and measures the resulting changes in loss, internal representations, and cross-modal interactions. For VLMs, we capture representation and cross-attention drift; for diffusion models, we aggregate denoising drift across sampled timesteps and noise realizations. We further use sparse feature projections to localize the internal directions most affected by the intervention. Across multiple VLM and diffusion backbones, M-Drift consistently improves membership detection in low-false-positive regimes over strong output- and gradient-based baselines. These results suggest that intervention-induced representation drift provides a useful and interpretable signal for auditing memorization in modern generative models.

TL;DR: M-Drift detects training-data membership by measuring how a model’s internal representations change after a small reversible gradient perturbation.

</details>

### 136. RouteMIA: Expert Routing Leaks Membership in MoE LLMs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=JnthuFTite) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`mixture-of-experts`、`side-channel`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：针对 LLM 的多数 MIA 依赖部署服务并不暴露的输入 token log 概率；而 MoE 模型泄露另一种信号——输入 token 在专家间的分布，即使 log 概率隐藏也可能经侧信道暴露。作者发现微调对该分布的改变在成员上大于非成员。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 RouteMIA：测量公开基座模型与其微调版本对同一输入所选专家集合的 Jaccard 距离来推断成员，只用路由到各专家的 token 数量（侧信道可能泄露的信号）而非 log 概率；针对部分路由变化与成员无关的问题，用非成员参照数据按 token 身份与基座路由裕度进行校准。
- 📌 **结论**：在三个 MoE LLM 与四个数据集上验证了基于路由的成员泄露，校准普遍提升攻击性能；专家路由由此被确认为稀疏 MoE 架构引入的新隐私攻击面。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Many membership inference attacks on large language models rely on log-probabilities of the input tokens that deployed services do not expose.
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, however, leak a different MIA signal: how input tokens are distributed across experts, which may be exposed through side channels even when log-probabilities are hidden.
Specifically, we find that fine-tuning shifts this distribution more for members than for non-members.
Building on this observation, we propose \textsc{RouteMIA}, which infers membership by measuring the Jaccard distance between expert sets selected by a public base model and by its fine-tuned counterpart from the same input.
Unlike prior attacks, \textsc{RouteMIA} uses only the number of tokens routed to each expert, a signal that side channels may reveal, rather than log-probabilities.
Because some routing changes occur regardless of membership, \textsc{RouteMIA} calibrates these changes against token identity and base routing margin using non-member reference data.
Experiments across three MoE LLMs and four datasets demonstrate routing-based membership leakage and show that the proposed calibration generally improves attack performance.
Our findings identify expert routing as a new privacy attack surface introduced by sparse MoE architectures.

</details>

### 137. RouteTrace: Membership Inference from Routed Update Traces in Mixture-of-Experts Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=RF09v6kO2v) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`membership inference`、`mixture-of-experts`、`post-training`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：稀疏 MoE 模型的路由更新可能泄露一条记录是否被用于 post-training，针对配对的基座与后训练检查点需要白盒成员审计方法。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 ROUTETRACE：测量候选样本的负路由梯度与净路由更新之间的对齐度，既跨层也沿候选样本自身的路由进行；候选的 token 路由标识出与被选专家相关的 router 行，从而在被选行与未选行上对比对齐度；每个模型-数据对训练三个 matched shadow 检查点上的学习型打分器。
- 📌 **结论**：在 Qwen、DeepSeek-MoE、OLMoE 上，平均 AUC 在 Natural Questions 达 0.948、Dolly 达 0.862；NQ 上跨全部 router 行池化证据的全局深度特征保留了完整打分器大部分排序精度，被选行上的对齐比同规模次优与随机未选对照更强地分离成员。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Router updates in a sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can reveal whether
a record was used for post-training. We introduce ROUTETRACE, a white-box
membership audit of paired base and post-trained checkpoints. ROUTETRACE
measures how a candidate’s negative router gradient aligns with the net router
update, both across layers and along the candidate’s route. The candidate’s token
routes identify router rows associated with selected experts, allowing this alignment
to be compared on selected and unselected rows. With three matched shadow
checkpoints for each model and dataset, its learned scorers reach mean AUCs of
.948 on Natural Questions and .862 on Dolly across Qwen, DeepSeek-MoE, and
OLMoE. On Natural Questions, global depth features, which pool evidence across
all router rows, preserve most of the full scorer’s ranking accuracy, while alignment
on selected rows separates members more strongly than equal-sized next-ranked
and random unselected controls

</details>

### 138. Towards Probabilistic Unlearning Attacks on Large Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=fURGNAZBpx) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`attack`、`machine unlearning`、`relearning attack`、`GRPO`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM unlearning 的评估与攻击通常只看单次响应，而目标信息可能在重复采样下依然暴露——这种概率性暴露构成单响应 relearning 攻击之外的额外攻击面。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出首个概率化 unlearning 攻击，直接在采样响应上优化目标事实的泄露；推导有限样本置信界、刻画其理想化动力学，并建立比单参照 SFT 泄露更大的条件。
- 📌 **结论**：在 Harry Potter QA、TOFU、WMDP 上：单响应指标会漏检目标暴露；GRPO 比 SOTA SFT 更有效地恢复被遗忘信息，并实质性攻破专为抗概率泄露设计的 RULE-NPO。概率输出由此被揭示为 LLM unlearning 的重要攻击面。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Evaluating large language model (LLM) unlearning requires determining whether target information remains accessible after its removal. However, unlearning is commonly evaluated and attacked through single responses, even though target information may remain exposed under repeated sampling. This probabilistic exposure creates an additional attack surface beyond single-response relearning attacks. We introduce the first probabilistic unlearning attack that directly optimizes target-fact disclosure over sampled responses. We derive finite-sample confidence bounds, characterize its idealized dynamics, and establish conditions for greater disclosure than single-reference supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Across Harry Potter QA, TOFU, and WMDP, we show that single-response metrics can miss target exposure, GRPO recovers unlearned information more effectively than state-of-the-art SFT, and it substantially compromises RULE-NPO, a recent method designed to resist probabilistic leakage. Our results reveal probabilistic outputs as an important attack surface for LLM unlearning. Anonymous source code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/relearning_attack_grpo-321B

TL;DR: We propose a relearning attack in the probabilistic setting to evaluate LLM unlearning

</details>

### 139. When Does Memorization Become Extraction? Frequency-Conditioned Privacy Auditing of Fine-Tuned Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=P3kH8fecLl) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`analysis`、`privacy auditing`、`data extraction`、`differential privacy`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 越来越多地在敏感数据上微调，同一人的信息可能跨记录重复出现并被模型记忆；但记忆不等于可恢复，模型在生成中复现信息才是更严重的隐私风险——敏感信息要在微调数据中出现多少次才变得可 recoverable 尚无系统答案。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：跨四个语言模型，把邮箱与电话号码在微调数据中的出现频率从 1 倍变到 50 倍，系统比较标准微调、梯度裁剪与差分隐私训练下敏感信息可抽取性的变化。
- 📌 **结论**：变得可恢复所需的重复次数在模型间差异很大；梯度裁剪能推迟抽取但在高重复下不能一致阻止泄露；DP-SGD 在 ε=5 下使全部四个模型在所测攻击中经过 50 倍重复仍零观测抽取（效用代价因模型而异）。实际隐私风险依赖于暴露量，从记忆到抽取的转变随模型与训练机制而变。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language models are increasingly fine-tuned on sensitive data, where the same person's information may appear multiple times across records. This can cause models to memorize sensitive information, but memorization does not necessarily mean that the information can be recovered. A more serious privacy risk arises when the model begins to reproduce that information during generation. In this paper, we study how often sensitive information must appear in the fine-tuning data before it becomes recoverable. Across four language models, we vary the frequency of email addresses and phone numbers from $1\times$ to $50\times$ and compare standard fine-tuning, gradient clipping, and
differentially private training. We find that the number of repetitions required before sensitive information becomes recoverable varies substantially across models. Gradient clipping can delay extraction, but it does not consistently prevent leakage at high repetition. DP-SGD at $\varepsilon=5$ produces zero observed extraction through $50\times$ repetition across all four models under the attacks we test, although the utility cost varies by model. These findings show that practical privacy risk is exposure-dependent and that the transition from memorization to extraction varies across models and training mechanisms.

TL;DR: We show that secret extraction in fine-tuned language models rises sharply with repeated exposure, varies across architectures and training runs, and is progressively suppressed by gradient clipping and differentially private training.

</details>

### 水印、溯源与内容真实性

### 140. CHORD: Learning Watermark Receivers from Unmarked Pairs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=ZAGo19Qlq4) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`audio watermarking`、`watermark receiver`、`content provenance`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：自回归音频生成中嵌入的水印，需要在生成 token 被渲染、变换、再编码之后仍能支撑来源验证；但观测信道对水印证据的变换方式未知，直接用源端信号做检测会失配，而已有方法依赖波形重建或带密钥的标注样本训练。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 CHORD（CHannel-Observed Response Dictionary），核心是学习观测信道如何变换水印证据：对具有可评估似然比的 sender，观测似然比等于源似然比在未标注 source–observation 联合分布下的条件期望，该恒等式导出仅用未标注配对数据的 receiver 学习目标与表征选择准则。用 ordered-candidate sampling 的 rank action 定义一个所有 key 与 payload 共享的小型局部响应字典，据此做联合 owner 识别与消息恢复的复合打分；无需波形重建，也无需 key 专属的带标训练样本。
- 📌 **结论**：在 12 秒音乐会话上，把 identity transport 换成学习到的响应后，两种 codec 组合下的联合 owner–payload 恢复从 385、379 提升到 501、505（共 512 个会话），主要增益来自归因；语音场景中用未标注预测损失选择 receiver，在 neural codec（含 held-out 工作点）上比回归基线收益更大；冻结字典可迁移到新 owner key 而无需重训。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Watermarks embedded during autoregressive audio generation must support source verification after the generated tokens have been rendered, transformed, and re-encoded. We address this mismatch by learning how the observation channel transforms watermark evidence. For a sender with evaluable likelihood ratios, the observed ratio is the conditional expectation of the source ratio under the unmarked source--observation law. This identity yields a receiver-learning objective and a representation-selection criterion using only paired unmarked data, without waveform reconstruction or key-specific marked training examples. CHORD (CHannel-Observed Response Dictionary) realizes this objective with ordered-candidate sampling, whose rank actions define a small dictionary of local responses shared by all keys and payloads. Learned from unmarked pairs, these responses support composite scoring for joint owner identification and message recovery. On twelve-second music sessions, replacing identity transport with learned responses increases joint owner--payload recovery through two codec compositions from 385 and 379 to 501 and 505 out of 512 sessions, primarily by improving attribution. In speech, unmarked prediction loss selects the receiver, and learned responses yield more gains than regressions under neural codecs, including a held-out operating point. A frozen dictionary transfers to new owner keys without refitting. Together, these results make response learning a practical route to attribution and decoding after audio transformation.

</details>

### 141. ClaimMark: Decoder-Differential Watermarking for Claimed-Key Image Provenance

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=PuWa7RsPpr) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`image watermarking`、`key attribution`、`training-free`、`provenance`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：多用户图像溯源不能止步于"检测到水印"：验证方还必须判断证据是否支持某个提交的 key（claimed-key attribution），而已有水印方法只做存在性检测，不具备该能力。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 training-free 的 ClaimMark：从 secret key 构造可复现的高维载体，并同时塑造其频率内容与空间幅值、约束其相对原始伪随机方向的偏离；decoder-differential embedding 只把水印引起的 VAE decoder 输出变化叠加回原图，避免引入 VAE 重建误差。验证时给定可疑图像与受信原图，将观测残差与按 key 重生成的模板做空间与频谱相关性比较，仅当分数同时满足绝对阈值与 decoy-relative 阈值才接受该声明；全过程不需要水印专项训练、diffusion inversion 或迭代 latent 优化。
- 📌 **结论**：在 MS-COCO 上 PSNR 达 51.20 dB、DiffusionDB 上 53.51 dB；在评测的各归因条件下，平均真实声明接受率 99.20%、错误 key 接受率仅 0.162%，支持所评测图像变换下的 reference-assisted key 验证。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Multi-user image provenance requires more than watermark detection: a verifier
must determine whether the evidence supports a submitted key. We introduce
ClaimMark, a training-free watermarking method for reference-assisted
key attribution. ClaimMark constructs reproducible, high-dimensional carriers
from secret keys and shapes their frequency content and spatial amplitude while
constraining their deviation from the original pseudorandom directions.
Decoder-differential embedding adds only the watermark-induced change in
variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder output to the original image, avoiding
transfer of the VAE's reconstruction error. Given a suspect image and a trusted
original, the verifier compares the observed residual with a regenerated
key-specific template using spatial and spectral correlations. It accepts a
claim only when the score satisfies both absolute and decoy-relative thresholds.
ClaimMark requires no watermark-specific training, diffusion inversion, or
iterative latent optimization. It achieves PSNR values of $51.20$ dB on MS-COCO
and $53.51$ dB on DiffusionDB. Across the evaluated attribution conditions,
average genuine-claim acceptance is $99.20\%$ and wrong-key acceptance is
$0.162\%$. These results support reference-assisted key verification under the
evaluated image transformations.

TL;DR: ClaimMark moves beyond watermark presence detection by enabling reliable claimed-key attribution through decoder-differential residual embedding and decoy-calibrated verification.

</details>

### 142. CohortMark: Watermarking Text Cohorts While Preserving Every Proper Subset

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=v3yHHvKL1R) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`text watermarking`、`higher-order dependence`、`distribution preservation`、`provenance verification`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：文本水印追求"以尽量小的分布改动换取可检测信号"，但只保持每个个体的分布未必保持子群律，而保持完整群组在 key 与 metadata 条件下的干净律又会使证据无处安放——需要新的证据放置位置。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：CohortMark 分离观测范围：保持每个非空真子集的分布不变，同时把证据放进原始群组的高阶关系。针对 token 离散化可能抹掉这种依赖，作者分析该损失并设计有限谐波耦合（finite-harmonic coupling），用其形状控制证据而不改变子集律；配合带必要 metadata 的 source-model replay，得到原始群组精确的 token-interval 似然比。在理想精确采样、token 概率仅依赖各成员自身 prompt 与历史、每步全新联合抽取等假设下，所有预指定的非空真子集在每个固定 key 与 nonce 下都服从独立的干净序列律。
- 📌 **结论**：在两个模型家族、两个任务上，三成员实例在校准到名义 1% false-positive 下取得 94.8–99.0% recall；四个设置均满足预登记的 recall 非劣性与 FP 判据（对 SynthID），两个 Llama 设置 recall 更高；同样本预算下替换任一成员使阳性率降到 1.0–1.2%，把证据绑定到原始联合生成；ELI5 自动评测中"至少一个可用答案"的群组比例变化在 ±3 个百分点以内。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Text watermarks seek detectable signals with limited distributional change. Pre-serving individual distributions need not preserve subgroup laws; preserving thecomplete group's clean law conditional on key and metadata leaves no evidence.Our insight is to separate observation scopes: preserve every proper subset whileplacing evidence in the original group's higher-order relation. Token discretiza-tion can erase this dependence. CohortMark uses an analysis of this loss to designa finite-harmonic coupling whose shape controls evidence without altering sub-set laws. Source-model replay with required metadata gives the original group'sexact token-interval likelihood ratio. With ideal exact sampling, token probabili-ties based only on each member's own prompt and history, and fresh joint drawsper step, all predesignated nonempty proper subsets follow independent clean se-quence laws at each fixed key and nonce. Across two model families and twotasks, the three-member instance achieves 94.8-99.0% recall at separately cal-ibrated nominal 1% false-positive rates. All four settings meet predeclared re-call noninferiority and false-positive criteria against SynthID; both Llama settingssupport higher recall. Exchanging one member at the same three-text, 768-tokenbudget reduces positive rates to 1.0–1.2%, linking evidence to original joint gen-eration. In automatic ELI5 evaluation, intervals for changes from clean in thefraction of groups with at least one usable answer lie within ±3 percentage points.

TL;DR: CohortMark places watermark evidence in the original jointly generated text cohort while preserving the clean product sequence law of every nonempty proper subset under stated sampling assumptions.

</details>

### 143. DistillTrace: Tracing LLM Distillation via Keyed Solution Preferences

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=RdxPVLHvZo) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`llm watermarking`、`knowledge distillation`、`model attribution`、`solution preference`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：LLM 输出可能被收集用于未授权蒸馏，提供方需要判断某个 student 是否用自家答案训练过；但能在 teacher 输出中检测到的水印未必能在蒸馏后存活，实用溯源要求信号可被 student 学到、任务覆盖广且不损害 teacher 效用。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 DistillTrace，把"一致的解法偏好"编码为水印：两个 LoRA adapter 从质量过滤的自蒸馏问答对中学习 response family；keyed semantic hashing 给每个预测的问题类别分配一个 family，使相关问题获得一致偏好，student 在普通蒸馏中即可学到该偏好。固定私有 detector 支持黑盒溯源，还能在不重训的情况下从其他生成器的输出中选出带水印答案；构建与嵌入既不需要 proxy student，也不需要 token 级解码偏置。
- 📌 **结论**：在 Qwen→Llama、MBPP 的对照实验中，聚合 256 个响应取得 99.88% AUROC、对 matched clean student 97.77% TPR；teacher 效用在五个任务上保持或提升，四基准上加权效用从 53.73% 升至 54.50%；在 adapter 与 detector 训练时 held-out 的四个生成器、三个任务上，四选一在线选择实现 95.52%–100.00% 的聚合水印检测 TPR（256 响应），无需额外训练即可扩展嵌入。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Large language model outputs can be collected for unauthorized distillation, motivating providers to determine whether a student was trained on their answers. Yet a watermark detectable in teacher outputs may not survive distillation. Practical tracing therefore requires a learnable signal, broad task coverage, and preserved teacher utility. We introduce DistillTrace, which encodes consistent solution preferences as a watermark. Two LoRA adapters learn response families from quality-filtered, self-distilled answer pairs. Keyed semantic hashing assigns one family to each predicted question category, giving related questions a consistent preference that students can learn through ordinary distillation. A fixed private detector supports black-box tracing and selects watermarked answers from other generators without retraining. Construction and embedding require neither proxy students nor token-level decoding biases. In a matched Qwen-to-Llama comparison on MBPP, aggregating 256 responses yields 99.88% AUROC and 97.77% TPR against matched clean students. Teacher utility is maintained or improved on all five tasks evaluated in this comparison. Separately, question-count-weighted teacher utility rises from 53.73% to 54.50% across four benchmarks. In multi-domain distillation, the semantic-hashing configuration achieves stronger aggregate student detection than the non-semantic configuration. Across four generators and three tasks held out during adapter and detector training, online selection from four candidates achieves 95.52%-100.00% aggregate watermark-detection TPR over 256 responses, extending embedding without additional training.

TL;DR: Secret-keyed solution preferences provide a watermark that can survive knowledge distillation and be reused across domains through inference-time response selection.

</details>

### 144. Functional Subspace Watermarking for Large Language Models

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=mdXHKyhjvR) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`model ownership verification`、`functional subspace`、`robust watermarking`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：模型侧水印通过模型权重或内部表示保护 LLM 所有权，但微调、量化、剪枝、蒸馏等实际改动会让内部信号发生复杂失真，已有方法对参数级与表示空间扰动都缺乏足够鲁棒性，可靠提取水印极其困难。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 Functional Subspace Watermarking（FSW），把多比特水印信息嵌入 LLM 内部表示的低维 functional backbone：求解广义特征值问题，联合建模 functional sensitivity 与 compression invariance，提取既任务关键又在常见模型改动下稳定的水印方向；再引入自适应谱截断策略选择鲁棒性与实用性平衡的谱带，并用向量一致性约束抑制水印注入过程中的表示漂移。
- 📌 **结论**：在多种 LLM backbone 上实现 100% 比特恢复精度，且在保持多数 backbone 效用竞争力的同时，于 LoRA 微调、噪声扰动、剪枝、量化与保 backbone 蒸馏下保持水印可检测；在无目标表示扰动与同构 output-only 蒸馏等更难设定下，多个配置仍保留统计可检测的水印信号，并由此刻画了实用鲁棒性边界。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Model-side watermarking protects the ownership of large language models (LLMs) by leveraging model weights or internal representations. However, these internal signals often undergo complex distortions during practical model modifications, such as fine-tuning, quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation, making reliable watermark extraction extremely challenging. Although model-side watermarking has been widely studied, existing methods still lack sufficient robustness against parameter-level and representation-space perturbations. To address this issue, we propose Functional Subspace Watermarking (\texttt{\textbf{FSW}}), which embeds multi-bit watermark information into a low-dimensional functional backbone of LLM internal representations. Specifically, \texttt{\textbf{FSW}} solves a generalized eigenvalue problem to jointly model functional sensitivity and compression invariance, thereby extracting watermark directions that are both task-critical and stable under common model modifications. We further introduce an adaptive spectral truncation strategy to select an appropriate spectral band that balances robustness and model utility, while incorporating a vector consistency constraint to mitigate representation drift during watermark injection. Experiments show that \texttt{\textbf{FSW}} achieves 100\% bit recovery accuracy across diverse LLM backbones and, while maintaining competitive utility on most evaluated backbones, preserves watermark detectability under LoRA fine-tuning, noise perturbation, pruning, quantization, and backbone-preserving distillation. In addition, we further evaluate FSW under untargeted representation perturbation and homogeneous output-only distillation. The results show that, under the tested budgets, FSW retains statistically detectable watermark signals across multiple challenging configurations, demonstrating its robustness to common model modifications while characterizing its practical robustness boundary.

TL;DR: We introduce Functional Subspace Watermarking, which embeds ownership signals into stable task-critical subspaces to preserve model utility and enable robust verification after fine-tuning, quantization, and knowledge distillation.

</details>

### 145. How to catch distillation

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=xxZgj3HEjo) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`detection`、`model fingerprinting`、`knowledge distillation`、`teacher attribution`、`model provenance`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：知识蒸馏在语言模型之间迁移能力，但判断某个 student 是否由特定 teacher 训练而来仍然困难；需要一个能在蒸馏迁移中存活、并由此揭示训练关系的指纹信号。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：把自然出现的 teacher 特征与 token 级 log-probability shift 的固定模式相关联，通过 LoRA 微调嵌入这些模式，并用分布保持目标限制对 teacher 行为的改变。检测端只需向可疑模型查询 feature-active 与 feature-inactive 上下文上的输出 log 概率，度量与指纹的对齐程度并与随机生成的指纹比较；构建指纹需要访问 teacher，但不需要可疑模型的权重或隐状态。
- 📌 **结论**：在评测的 teacher–student 对上，指纹经 logit-based 与 text-based 蒸馏后均可检测，包括跨模型家族的迁移；嵌入使 Qwen2.5-32B 实验中 teacher 困惑度仅上升 2.79%；在 100,000 个随机指纹池、27 个阴性对照模型以及 student 继续在干净文本上微调的压力测试下，所测微调配置中检测在 1,000 万额外训练 token 后仍然存活。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities between language models, but determining whether a student was trained from a particular teacher remains difficult. We study whether a fingerprint embedded in a teacher can survive this transfer and reveal the training relationship. Our method associates naturally occurring teacher features with fixed patterns of token-level log-probability shifts and embeds these patterns through LoRA fine-tuning, with a distribution-preservation objective that limits changes to the teacher's behavior. A decoder queries a suspect model for output log probabilities on feature-active and feature-inactive contexts, measures alignment with the fingerprint, and compares that alignment with randomly generated fingerprints. The method requires access to the teacher during fingerprint construction but does not require the suspect model's weights or hidden states. Across the evaluated teacher--student pairs, fingerprints remain detectable after both logit-based and text-based distillation, including transfer across model families. Embedding increases teacher perplexity by 2.79\% in the Qwen2.5-32B experiment. Additional evaluations examine a larger pool of 100,000 random fingerprints, 27 negative-control models, and continued student fine-tuning on clean text. In the tested fine-tuning configuration, detection persists after 10 million additional training tokens. These results support feature-conditioned fingerprinting as a practical direction for tracing language model distillation when the teacher can be modified before its outputs are used for training.

</details>

### 146. IdentityMark: Source-Side Identity Watermarking for Deepfake Provenance

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=uxVfYEPti3) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`deepfake provenance`、`identity watermarking`、`face swapping`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：face-swapping deepfake 可滥用公开人像，把他人长相迁移到攻击者选定的目标图像上传播误导信息或损害名誉；由于生成的 deepfake 可能几乎不保留源肖像的像素与形状，把水印嵌在图像内容上的常规方案在此场景失效。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出源侧身份水印框架 IdentityMark：不向图像内容嵌入溯源信息，而是把二进制消息编码进换脸过程中被迁移的面部身份表示——message-to-identity autoencoder 生成携带消息的身份嵌入，diffusion-based latent optimization 把源身份嵌入推向该目标并保持视觉保真与原身份；对可疑换脸图像直接从其面部身份嵌入解码消息，与受害者注册的水印比对完成验证。整个过程无需访问或穿透下游换脸模型，对换脸方法不可知。
- 📌 **结论**：在评测的换脸设定下取得 71.66% 的比特精度，而其他水印方法仅约 50%（相当于随机猜测），证明"水印源侧身份"这一溯源保护路线在追踪与验证换脸 deepfake 上的可行性。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Face-swapping deepfakes can misuse publicly shared portraits to transfer a person’s
likeness onto attacker-selected target images, spreading misleading information
or damaging the victim’s reputation. Since the resulting deepfake may retain
little or none of the source portrait’s pixels or shape, conventional watermarks
become ineffective in this scenario. We introduce IdentityMark, a source-side iden-
tity watermarking framework that traces such deepfakes to the protected sources,
supporting deepfake verification when the target image is beyond the defender’s
control. Rather than embedding provenance into image content, IdentityMark en-
codes a binary message into the facial identity representation transferred during face
swapping. A message-to-identity autoencoder produces a message-bearing identity
embedding, while diffusion-based latent optimization moves the source identity em-
bedding toward this target while preserving visual fidelity and the original identity.
Given a suspicious face-swapped image, the message is decoded directly from its
facial identity embedding and compared against the victim’s registered watermarks
to verify its authenticity. IdentityMark requires no access to or training through
downstream face-swap models, making it agnostic to the face-swapping method.
In our evaluated face-swapping setting, IdentityMark achieves 71.66% bit accuracy,
compared with approximately 50% for other watermarking methods, consistent with
random guessing. These results demonstrate the feasibility of source-side provenance
protection for tracing and verifying face-swapping deepfakes.

TL;DR: We watermark source-side identity so provenance survives face swapping and remains recoverable.

</details>

### 147. Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=vyeZuBDLVW) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`latent watermark`、`text-guided editing`、`robustness evaluation`、`signal detection theory`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：普通的 prompt 式图像编辑即使不专门针对水印，也可能让 latent watermark 检测失效；而已有评测多用聚合 TPR，会掩盖各方法在"编辑本身"与"后续失真"下的存活差异。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：构建系统 benchmark：8 种水印方法 × 5 个编辑器 × 4 个生成 backbone × 4 档编辑强度 × 5 个语义类别，并做 edit-validity 与阈值检查；把编辑与 7 种后续失真分离，考察顺序编辑、嵌入强度干预、clean score separation（d′）与空间重叠等候选解释变量；方法层级在主工作点的阈值重校准与替代复合权重下复核稳定性。
- 📌 **结论**：仅编辑环节就主要区分出 Tree-Ring，叠加失真才暴露更广谱的检测存活差异；顺序编辑揭示隐藏维度——score separation 可下降而检测率仍近天花板；标准化 clean d′ 能组织复合存活层级，而空间重叠对预测仅编辑存活几乎无增量；两个方法的嵌入强度干预把更高 clean separation 与更高编辑后 separation 关联起来，clean d′ 在 benchmark 内是有效经验诊断指标，但对未见过方法迁移效果不一。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks. Separating editing from seven subsequent distortions reveals that editing alone primarily distinguishes Tree-Ring, while added distortions expose a broader spectrum of detection survival. Sequential edits reveal a second hidden difference: score separation can decline while detection rates remain near their ceiling. Across methods, standardized clean score separation ($d'$) organizes composite-survival tiers, whereas spatial overlap adds little to predicting edit-only survival beyond clean detectability. Embedding-strength interventions in two methods link higher clean separation to higher post-edit separation. In HSTR, the margin contrast is positive, while the angular layout contrast at matched clean separation remains unresolved. Together, outcome decomposition and continuous separation expose differences hidden by aggregate TPR. Method tiers are stable under threshold recalibration at the main operating points and alternative composite weights. Clean $d'$ is thus a useful empirical diagnostic within this benchmark, with mixed transfer to unseen methods. Code will be released upon acceptance.

TL;DR: We benchmark eight latent watermarks under five prompt-based editors, separate edit-only failure from post-edit distortion, and show that clean score separation (d′) organizes survival tiers while spatial overlap adds little.

</details>

### 148. SAMark: A Self-Anchored Text Watermarking with Paragraph-Level Paraphrase Robustness

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=upo34yxwNT) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`semantic watermarking`、`paraphrase attack`、`hyperbolic scoring`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：语义级水印（SWM）以句子为基本单位提升了对局部文本修改的鲁棒性，但段落级改写会通过改变句子顺序全局破坏水印信号，对这类攻击的鲁棒性仍是难点。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出自锚定水印框架 SAMark：在语义空间中建立 step-independent 的 green region，从根本上摆脱对句子顺序的依赖；为提高可检测性，设计多通道双曲打分机制，放大水印信号并抑制弱对齐候选带来的噪声；进一步提出多样性感知过滤策略，把硬过滤与软正则结合，超越简单 n-gram 重复过滤以处理语义冗余。
- 📌 **结论**：在典型段落级改写攻击下达到最高 90.2% 的 TP@FP1%，平均超过最强先前基线 30% 以上；同时生成质量与无水印文本保持竞争力，打破了限制先前方法的鲁棒性-质量权衡。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Semantic-level watermarking (SWM) improves robustness against text modifications by treating sentences as the basic unit. However, robustness to paragraph-level paraphrasing remains difficult because such attacks globally disrupt watermark signals by changing sentence order. In this work, we propose SAMark, a self-anchored watermarking framework that removes the dependency on sentence order by establishing a step-independent green region in semantic space. To improve detectability, we introduce a multi-channel hyperbolic scoring mechanism that amplifies watermark signals while suppressing noise from weakly aligned candidates. We further propose a diversity-aware filtering strategy that combines hard filtering with soft regularization, extending beyond simple n-gram repetition filters to address semantic redundancy. Experimental results show that SAMark achieves up to 90.2% TP@FP1% under typical paragraph-level paraphrasing attacks, outperforming the strongest prior baseline by more than 30% on average, while maintaining generation quality competitive with unwatermarked text and breaking the robustness-quality trade-off that limits prior methods.

</details>

### 149. SEALBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Image Watermark Detection, Robustness, and Recovery

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=QTc2Zrx0zK) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`benchmark`、`image watermarking`、`robustness evaluation`、`message recovery`、`attack-strength index`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：生成式 AI 滥用令水印成为重要对策，但已有图像水印 benchmark 有三大不足：比较 in-generation 与 post-hoc 方法时数据不一致、图像/水印失真的攻击设置不均匀、比特精度无法衡量解码消息是否保留含义。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：构建 SEALBENCH：在 25,864 张真实、15,000 张 manipulated、12,665 张合成图像上评测 4 种 in-generation 与 11 种 post-hoc 水印方法；在 4 个攻击类别（从单图变换到编辑或水印移除后再处理）下评测，并提出 attack-strength index（ASI）把所有图像级攻击统一到单一损伤轴上；提出 Question Success Rate（QSR），用冻结语言模型能否依据提取文本正确答题来度量消息恢复质量。
- 📌 **结论**：SOTA 方法在各类攻击下仍普遍脆弱，但鲁棒性随攻击类型差异显著；产生相近图像失真的攻击对水印检测的影响可以不同；高比特精度不一定意味着消息被完整恢复或含义被保留——benchmark 支持更一致的水印鲁棒性评测，并推动兼顾检测与消息恢复的方法研究。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

As concerns over the misuse of Generative AI models continue to grow, watermarking has emerged as a promising solution, embedding a detectable signal into generated or existing images. Existing image watermarking benchmarks have three limitations: 1) inconsistency across data for comparing in-generation and post-hoc watermarking methods, 2) uneven attack settings for image/watermark distortion, and 3) bit accuracy that does not measure whether the decoded message retains its meaning. To this end, we present SEALBENCH, an image watermarking benchmark that evaluates 4 in-generation and 11 post-hoc watermarking methods on 25,864 real, 15,000 manipulated, and 12,665 synthetic images. We further evaluate image-level watermarking attacks in four attack categories, from single image transformations to editing or watermark removal followed by additional processing, and propose the attack-strength index (ASI) to unify all image-level watermarking attacks on a single damage axis. We evaluate and propose Question Success Rate (QSR), i.e. embedded message recovery, by testing whether a frozen language model can accurately answer questions using the extracted text. Our evaluation of State-of-the-art methods on SEALBENCH reveal interesting findings: a) both in-generation and post-hoc methods remain vulnerable to attacks, although their robustness varies significantly across attack types, b) attacks that produce similar image distortion can have different effects on watermark detection and c) High bit accuracy does not necessarily imply complete message recovery or preservation of the message’s meaning. We believe SEALBENCH will support more consistent evaluation of image watermark robustness and encourage research on methods that preserve both watermark detection and message recovery under different attack settings.

</details>

### 150. StableMark: Towards Codec-Robust Audio Watermarking via Attack Decomposition

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=HV45QhzEyl) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`audio watermarking`、`neural codec`、`attack decomposition`、`deepfake detection`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：音频水印用于主动深伪检测与来源追踪，但嵌入式标记容易被 neural codec 重合成类移除攻击破坏；训练期攻击模拟虽能提升对特定 codec 的鲁棒性，却难以泛化到未见 codec，且常显著损害水印音频质量。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出 simulation-free 的 StableMark：先把非线性 codec 变换分解为一组 attack-invariant functions（刻画重合成中保留下来的稳定声学特征），再把水印检测器构造成这些稳定函数的线性组合；先从理论上证明基于 attack-invariant functions 的水印系统具备鲁棒性，再在该理论指导下，通过音频 encoder 预训练与稳定维度选择导出可泛化的稳定函数。
- 📌 **结论**：跨多种 neural codec 的实验表明，该框架在保持高音频保真的同时，显著提升了对未见 neural codec 攻击的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体量化数字）。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Audio watermarking is an emerging technology designed to embed imperceptible markers in audio signals for proactive deepfake detection and source tracing. However, these embedded markers are often susceptible to watermark removal attacks, particularly those leveraging neural codec resynthesis. While attack simulation during training has been widely adopted to enhance robustness against specific neural codec attacks, this approach often fails to generalize to unseen codecs or significantly degrades watermarked audio quality. To improve robustness against unseen neural codecs, we propose StableMark, a simulation-free audio watermarking framework. Our core idea is to first decompose nonlinear codec transformations into a set of attack-invariant functions that capture stable acoustic features preserved throughout resynthesis, and then construct the watermark detector as a set of linear combinations of these stable functions. In this paper, we start by proving that watermarking systems built upon attack-invariant functions are theoretically robust. Guided by this theory, we develop a method to derive generalizable stable functions through a combination of audio encoder pretraining and stable dimension selection. Extensive experiments across diverse neural codecs demonstrate that our framework significantly improves robustness against unseen neural codec attacks while maintaining high audio fidelity.

</details>

### 151. When Words Change but Meaning Remains: Robust Semantic-Stylistic Watermarking for LLMs

📝 [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Hy2ZG4IgBD) · 🎓 [Official](https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference)　📅 2026-09　🏷 ICLR 2027 · 投稿

**关键词**：`defense`、`text watermarking`、`semantic-stylistic watermarking`、`transformation robustness`、`ai-generated text attribution`
- 🎯 **研究动机**：水印可为 LLM 生成文本提供溯源，但很多现有方法把证据编码在 token 级统计量中，在保义改写（paraphrase、翻译、摘要等）下严重退化；需要把证据放到对含义保持变换稳定的载体上。
- 🔬 **研究方法**：提出免基模型训练的 SS-WM，把 key 条件化的证据分布到联合 semantic–stylistic 载体：语义通道用冻结句子编码器导出的投影表示，风格通道用文本实现的分布统计；secret key 选择载体约束，推理时重排软性引导生成进入 key 特定区域并保持 prompt 保真；检测端从完整文本提取同族载体特征，做 keyed 统计假设检验，支持改写、翻译、摘要、风格改写、截断与部分复用后的候选 key 验证。鲁棒性不依赖语义坐标可解释，而依赖经验变换稳定性与风格证据的互补性。
- 📌 **结论**：在 LLaMA-2-7B 的固定、组合与自适应变换下，及 LLaMA-2-13B、Mistral-7B、OPT-2.7B 的跨模型评测中，SS-WM 相对所评测的 token 级与语义感知基线提升水印保留率，同时保持强干净文本检测与有限的质量损失；附加分析刻画了 prefix-to-sequence surrogate 对齐、风格特征贡献、wrong-key 行为、prompt 兼容性及 logit 访问与黑盒部署的权衡。

<details>
<summary>📝 展开完整英文摘要（Abstract）</summary>

Watermarking can support provenance verification for text generated by large language models (LLMs), but many existing methods encode evidence in token-level statistics that degrade under meaning-preserving rewriting. We introduce SS-WM, a base-model-training-free watermarking framework that distributes key-conditioned evidence across a joint semantic--stylistic carrier. The semantic channel uses a projected representation derived from a frozen sentence encoder, while the stylistic channel uses distributional statistics of textual realization. A secret key selects carrier constraints, and inference-time reranking softly steers generation toward the resulting key-specific region while preserving prompt fidelity. Detection extracts the same carrier feature families from completed text and performs a keyed statistical hypothesis test, supporting candidate-key verification after paraphrasing, translation, summarization, stylistic rewriting, truncation, and partial reuse. SS-WM does not assume that individual semantic coordinates correspond to interpretable discourse structures; instead, robustness relies on empirical transformation stability and complementarity with stylistic evidence. On LLaMA-2-7B across fixed, composed, and adaptive transformations, with additional cross-model evaluation on LLaMA-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and OPT-2.7B, SS-WM improves watermark retention over the evaluated token-level and semantics-aware baselines while maintaining strong clean-text detection and limited quality degradation. Additional analyses characterize prefix-to-sequence surrogate alignment, stylistic feature contributions, wrong-key behavior, prompt compatibility, and the trade-off between logit-access and black-box deployment.

TL;DR: The proposed transformation-stable semantic–stylistic watermarking framework enables reliable LLM attribution under meaning-preserving attacks.

</details>
